AllPackage.description: Our Kashmir tour package 5 nights 6 days is put together to give you the most satisfying blend of sightseeing, relaxation, and genuine cultural charm that Kashmir is so well known for. The journey begins in Srinagar with a peaceful Shikara ride on Dal Lake, then takes you through the golden meadows of Sonmarg and the stunning alpine landscapes of Gulmarg where the world-famous Gondola ride is an experience all on its own, before continuing to the beautiful Pahalgam with its scenic valleys and the lovely Lidder River flowing right through it. You then return to Srinagar to take a leisurely stroll through the gorgeous Mughal Gardens and spend a truly memorable night on a deluxe houseboat that brings the whole Kashmir experience full circle. Whether you are travelling with family, your partner, or simply someone who loves nature, this is one Kashmir holiday that will stay with you for a very long time.
AllPackage.name: Kashmir Heavenly Himalayas & Dal Lake Majesty
AllPackage.shortDescription: Enjoy the very best of our Kashmir 5N/6D Tour Package with peaceful Shikara rides on Dal Lake in Srinagar, the sweeping open meadows of Gulmarg, the breathtaking glaciers of Sonmarg, and the serene riverside charm of Pahalgam, all while staying in comfortable hotels and a traditional houseboat for a truly complete and authentic Kashmiri experience.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Scenic Kashmir valley with winding road, grassy meadows, and snow capped Himalayan mountains.

AllPackage.description: Forget the standard vacation, this is the 7 Day Leh Ladakh journey you've probably been dreaming about. We're pushing boundaries here, navigating the kind of rugged, high altitude passes that make your heart race, specially the legendary Khardung La and Chang La, gaze out at the impossibly blue waters of Pangong and Tso Moriri, and spend time exploring ancient monasteries, quiet local villages, and the truly unique culture that makes Ladakh unlike anywhere else on earth. Along the way there is offbeat trekking, incredible photography opportunities, and the pure thrill of navigating some of the most rugged and scenic roads you will ever drive on. You will be staying in cozy guesthouses, camps, or charming boutique hotels that carry a strong local flavor, with experienced drivers and private transfers making sure every leg of the journey goes smoothly. Whether you are a thrill-seeker, a nature lover, or a photographer chasing the perfect shot, this trip delivers an adrenaline-filled and deeply cultural experience through India's most breathtaking high-altitude landscapes.
highlights: Visit Pangong Lake & Tso Moriri Lake
Local village visits and cultural experiences
Offbeat road adventure with rugged mountain scenery
inclusions: 6 nights in guesthouses, camps, or boutique hotels
Private airport transfers & road transport in Leh-Ladakh

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh
activities: Take it easy on your first day in Leh and give your body the time it needs to acclimatize to the high altitude before diving into the adventures that lie ahead. Keep things light and enjoyable with a gentle visit to the historic Leh Palace, the serene and stunning Shanti Stupa, and a relaxed stroll through the colorful local market where the vibrant sights and sounds of Leh give you a wonderful first taste of this incredible destination.

itinerary.title: Leh - Nubra Valley
activities: Set off on an exhilarating drive via the legendary Khardung La Pass, one of the highest motorable roads in the world, where the breathtaking views and the sheer sense of achievement of crossing it make for an experience you will never forget. Once you arrive in the Nubra Valley, check into your guesthouse or camp and take a moment to soak in the stunning surroundings. Head out to the ancient Diskit Monastery for a peaceful and spiritually enriching visit, and then make your way to the unique sand dunes at Hunder, where the otherworldly landscape feels like nothing you have ever seen before.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley Exploration
activities:
Spend your day immersing yourself in the warm and genuine hospitality of the local villages, where cultural interactions and conversations with the friendly locals give you a truly authentic and heartfelt glimpse into the unique way of life in this remote and beautiful region. If you are up for a little extra fun, hop onto a camel and take a leisurely ride across the stunning sand dunes for an experience that feels wonderfully surreal against the dramatic Himalayan backdrop.

As the evening settles in, find a quiet spot and turn your gaze towards the sky for some breathtaking stargazing, where the clear mountain air and absence of city lights reveal a canopy of stars that is simply jaw dropping.

itinerary.title: Nubra - Pangong Lake
activities:
Set off on a scenic and memorable drive through the stunning Shyok Valley, a journey of around 6 to 7 hours that winds through some of the most dramatic and awe inspiring landscapes you will ever lay eyes on. Take your time at the various scenic viewpoints along the way, each one offering a different and breathtaking perspective of the rugged terrain surrounding you.

As the evening arrives, reach the iconic Pangong Lake and find a quiet spot to sit back and watch the sun dip below the horizon, painting the sky and the shimmering blue waters in the most spectacular colors imaginable.

itinerary.title: Pangong - Leh
activities:
Wake up early and step outside to witness the sunrise over the magnificent Pangong Lake, where the golden morning light dancing across the crystal clear blue waters creates a moment so beautiful and peaceful that it feels almost unreal. Soak it all in before packing up and beginning the scenic drive back to Leh, a journey of around 5 to 6 hours that offers its own share of stunning landscapes along the way.

Once you arrive back in Leh, the rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own relaxed pace, whether that means unwinding quietly or heading out for a leisurely browse through the local market.

itinerary.title: Leh - Tso Moriri Lake
activities:
Set off early for a full day excursion to the breathtaking Tso Moriri, a journey of around 6 to 7 hours that takes you through some of the most remote and stunningly beautiful landscapes in all of Ladakh. Once you arrive, spend your time soaking in the serene and untouched beauty of the lake, where the still waters reflecting the surrounding mountains create a scene that feels almost too perfect to be real. Wander through the nearby villages and get a genuine feel for the simple and peaceful way of life in this remote corner of the world.

Settle in for an overnight stay at a cozy camp or guesthouse near the lake, falling asleep to the sound of complete and utter silence under a sky full of stars.

itinerary.title: Departure from Leh
activities: After soaking in the serene morning views of Tso Moriri one last time, begin your drive back to Leh, letting the stunning Ladakhi landscapes accompany you on this final stretch of your incredible journey. Once you arrive, you will be comfortably transferred to the airport for your onward flight home, carrying with you a heart full of breathtaking memories from one of the most extraordinary destinations on earth.

AllPackage.name: Ladakh Ultimate Road Expedition
AllPackage.shortDescription: Set off on a 7-day Leh-Ladakh road trip that takes you through towering high-altitude passes, crystal clear lakes, ancient monasteries, and some of the most jaw-dropping landscapes you will ever witness on an adventure this unforgettable.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Pangong Lake with rugged brown mountains and clear blue water in the scenic landscape of Ladakh.

AllPackage.description: Explore the beauty of the Himalayas with our Leh-Ladakh Adventure Packages, deisgned for the travellers who wants thrills and feel most alive in the heart of nature. Fondly known as the Land of High Passes, Ladakh is a place where rugged mountains, impossibly blue lakes, ancient monasteries, and adrenaline-packed experiences all exist in perfect harmony. In Ladakh everyday brings a new adventure and different view of the mountains. For travelers who wants to enjoy the adventure there are very exciting adventure activities like trekking from Markha Valley and white-water rafting on the fast-flowing Zanskar River. Those who are interested culture, they can visit beautiful Buddhist monasteries such as Hemis Monastery, Thiksey. Our packages take care of comfortable stays, local transport, necessary permits, and guided experiences so you can focus entirely on making memories. Whether you are chasing bike rides, mountain treks, river rapids, or simply a journey that stirs something deep inside you, a Leh-Ladakh tour is the kind of adventure that stays with you for the rest of your life.
AllPackage.name: Ladakh Ultimate Himalayan Expedition
AllPackage.shortDescription: Book the most thrilling Leh-Ladakh adventure packages featuring epic bike trips, camping by Pangong Lake, unforgettable Nubra Valley tours, and heart-pumping Zanskar rafting for a Himalayan journey that truly stays with you for a lifetime.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Snow covered rugged mountains and rocky valley landscape in the high altitude region of Ladakh.

AllPackage.description:
Four days in Shimla turned out to be just the right amount of time to take in everything this place quietly offers, from the natural beauty and rich cultural heritage to the kind of experiences that remind you why Himachal Pradesh's hill stations have always had such a hold on people.

The itinerary is designed for a leisurely pace, allowing you to soak in the mountain scenery, visit local attractions, and see the well-known sights without the pressure of a tight schedule.

You will explore the iconic Mall Road, the thrilling Kufri Adventure Park, the peaceful forests of Mashobra, and the scenic Naldehra golf course, all while enjoying ziplining, yak rides, relaxed walks through apple orchards, and cozy evenings around a bonfire that feel like pure magic. Whether you are travelling as a couple, with family, or a group of friends, this itinerary offers a good mix of relaxation and adventure. You can enjoy street food of Shimla and can try adventure and fun activities like zorbing and paragliding without feeling rushed. It makes the trip exciting, enjoyable and memorable .

With private transfers, beautifully located hotels, and carefully chosen activities throughout, this Shimla holiday is set up to give you a Himalayan getaway you will genuinely never forget.
highlights: Walk through Shimla Mall Road & The Ridge
Adventure activities at Kufri Fun World
AllPackage.name: Shimla Elite Hills & Adventure Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Discover Shimla alongside the charming destinations of Kufri, Mashobra, and Naldehra for a wonderfully well-rounded trip that blends sightseeing, light adventure, great shopping, and a warm dose of local cultural vibes.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Toy train on winding railway track through scenic hills and trees in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh.

AllPackage.description: This 7-day Comprehensive Goa Tour brings together adventure, relaxation, and cultural exploration in a way that feels genuinely satisfying from the very first day to the last. You ease into the trip with a relaxing day at the beach, then set off to explore North Goa's most loved beaches and historic forts before making your way to the absolutely stunning Dudhsagar Waterfalls surrounded by lush natural beauty. From there you will discover the quieter, beaches of South Goa, enjoy exciting island trips, and enjoy the adventure activities snorkeling and scuba diving, and wrap things up with a leisurely day spent shopping, treating yourself to a spa session, or simply soaking up the sun by the shore. For anyone who wants to experience Goa in its entirety, this package covers nature, adventure, culture, and pure relaxation all in one unforgettable trip.
highlights: North Goa beaches and historic forts (Calangute
Island adventures with snorkeling and scuba diving
Perfect for a complete Goa experience
inclusions: Sightseeing, excursions, and transfers as per itinerary
Dudhsagar Waterfalls visit with jeep safari and spice plantation tour
Island trip with snorkeling/scuba diving and lunch

itinerary.title: Arrival & Beach
activities: Upon arriving at the airport or railway station, you will be warmly picked up and transferred comfortably to your hotel or resort for a smooth and relaxed check-in. Once you have settled in and freshened up, head out for a refreshing swim or a leisurely stroll along the nearby beach, letting the warm sun, gentle waves, and salty sea breeze wash away any tiredness from the journey. The evening is completely yours to unwind and enjoy at your own relaxed pace, soaking in the beautiful coastal atmosphere that makes this destination so wonderfully inviting.

itinerary.title: North Goa Beaches & Forts
activities:
After breakfast, hit the road and spend your day exploring some of Goa's most iconic and beloved destinations, starting with the historic Fort Aguada and then making your way through the stunning beaches of Sinquerim, Calangute, Baga, Anjuna, and Vagator, each one offering its own unique character and charm that makes Goa such a wonderfully diverse destination. If you are feeling adventurous, try your hand at some optional water sports along the way for an extra dose of excitement and fun.

Head back to the hotel afterwards and enjoy a well deserved rest.

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar Waterfalls & Nature
activities:
After breakfast, gear up for an exciting full day excursion to the magnificent Dudhsagar Waterfalls, one of India's most stunning and powerful waterfalls that is guaranteed to leave you completely awe struck. On the way, make a wonderful stop at a local spice plantation where the heady aromas of exotic spices and the fascinating insight into their cultivation make for a truly enjoyable and memorable experience.

Head back to the hotel in the evening and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: South Goa Beaches & Quiet Vibes
activities:
After breakfast, head out and spend your day discovering the quieter and more serene side of Goa, exploring the stunning beaches of Palolem, Colva, or Agonda, where the calm and unhurried atmosphere feels like a world away from the busier northern shores. Find your perfect spot on the soft sandy beach and soak in the beauty of the surroundings as the day gently unfolds around you. As the sun begins to dip towards the horizon, settle in for a breathtaking South Goa sunset that paints the sky and the shimmering shoreline in the most spectacular colors imaginable.

Head back to the hotel and enjoy a relaxing and peaceful evening at your own comfortable pace.

itinerary.title: Island Adventures & Underwater Exploration
activities:
After breakfast, get ready for an absolutely incredible full day adventure as you head out to the stunning Grande Island or one of the smaller surrounding islands, where the crystal clear waters and vibrant marine life create an underwater world that is genuinely breathtaking. Spend your time snorkeling, diving into a scuba session, and capturing the magical underwater world through photography that will make for the most stunning holiday memories. A delicious beachside lunch or BBQ is included along the way, making the whole experience feel wonderfully relaxed and complete.

Head back to the hotel in the evening and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day / Shopping / Spa
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, take your morning slow and treat yourself to some optional spa treatments that leave you feeling completely refreshed and rejuvenated, or simply find your perfect spot on the beach and soak up the warm Goa sunshine at your own relaxed pace. When you are ready, head out to the local markets and browse through the colorful stalls for some unique souvenirs and keepsakes that will remind you of this wonderful trip long after you return home. The evening is completely yours to enjoy however your heart desires, whether that means a beachside stroll, a quiet dinner, or simply unwinding and soaking in the last few beautiful moments of your Goa experience.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, take your morning slow and savour those last few precious moments of your beautiful Goa getaway before checking out of the hotel. When the time comes, settle into a comfortable transfer to the airport or railway station, heading home with a heart full of sun soaked, adventure filled, and wonderfully unforgettable Goa memories that will stay with you for a very long time.

AllPackage.name: Goa Coastal Paradise Experience
AllPackage.shortDescription: Dive deep into everything Goa has to offer, from sun-soaked beaches, historic forts, and stunning waterfalls to island escapes, underwater adventures, laid-back leisure, vibrant shopping, and blissful spa indulgence all in one trip.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Waves crashing against rocky shoreline with open Arabian Sea horizon on scenic Goa coast.

AllPackage.description: If you are looking for real adventure in India, the Andaman Islands are the place to be. Forget just sitting on the sand, this 4 day trip is all about getting into the water. We have packed the schedule with the water. This 3N/4D Andaman Adventure Package puts all the action front and center, from scuba diving at Elephant Beach and sea walking at North Bay to kayaking through glowing mangroves, jet skiing, banana rides, and high-speed boating that keeps your heart racing from morning till evening. Whether you are a complete beginner, a non-swimmer, or an experienced diver, every activity comes with trained instructors and proper safety measures so you can push your limits with total confidence against a backdrop of stunning tropical scenery. The Andamans are so much more than just pretty beaches and this trip is your chance to find that out for yourself.
exclusions: Optional add-on activities (night dive, game fishing)
highlights: banana ride & sofa ride for pure fun
Glass bottom boat ride for soft adventure lovers
inclusions: All listed adventure activities with instructors
Safety gear (life jackets, helmets, wetsuits, scuba kit)

itinerary.title: Havelock Underwater Thrills
activities: Get ready for an absolutely incredible underwater adventure as you head out for a scuba diving session at the stunning Elephant Beach or Nemo Reef, where the vibrant coral formations and diverse marine life create a world beneath the surface that is genuinely breathtaking. Spend some time snorkeling in the shallow coral waters and marvel at the colorful sea creatures that dart around you in the most magical way. If you want to capture the experience and take the memories home with you, an optional underwater photoshoot is available and is absolutely worth it.

itinerary.title: Sea Walking & Kayaking
activities: Strap on your helmet and take a fascinating sea walk at North Bay or Havelock, where strolling along the ocean floor and coming face to face with the incredible underwater world is an experience unlike anything else you have ever tried. Head out for a memorable kayaking session through the serene mangroves, choosing between a beautiful sunset paddle or an enchanting night kayaking experience where the magical bioluminescence lights up the water around you in the most otherworldly way. Round off your action packed day with an exhilarating jet skiing session near Corbyn's Cove or Havelock that sends you speeding across the sparkling waters with a huge smile on your face.

itinerary.title: Speed & Splash Adventures
activities: Gather your friends or family and hop onto a banana boat for a wonderfully fun and laughter filled ride that is guaranteed to create the best memories. Follow it up with the hilariously thrilling sofa ride, also known as the crazy couch, where the high speed twists and turns keep everyone screaming with excitement. Take a thrilling speed boat ride along the stunning Andaman coast, where the wind in your hair and the sparkling blue waters all around you feel absolutely incredible. Round off your day with a fascinating glass bottom boat ride that gives you a stunning window into the vibrant and colorful reef world below without even getting wet.

itinerary.title: Departure / Add-ons
activities: For those looking to take their underwater experience to the next level, an optional deep sea scuba dive with PADI certification is available and promises to be one of the most thrilling and unforgettable experiences of your entire trip. If you have planned ahead, game fishing or a night dive can be arranged with advance booking for an extra dose of adventure that truly sets your Andaman experience apart. Before you wrap up and head out, lace up your shoes and trek your way to one of the islands hidden secret beaches, a perfect and peaceful final memory to carry home with you.

AllPackage.name: Andaman Island Explorer Experience
AllPackage.shortDescription: Jump headfirst into Andaman's thrilling side with scuba diving, snorkeling, kayaking, sea walking, and speed boating all packed into one exciting 3N/4D adventure trip.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Winding coastal road through lush forest beside turquoise sea on Andaman Islands shoreline.

AllPackage.description: Our Malaysia Tour Package for 5 days is all about giving you a great holiday. Its with fun sights, adventures, and local culture. We'll take you to the best spots in Kuala Lumper, it includes the famous Petronas Twin Towers and the Sultan Abdul Samad Building . Next up is a scenic cable car ride to Genting Highlands, where the cooler mountain air sets the perfect mood for some lighthearted entertainment and maybe even a visit to the casino! Then get ready to swap the highlands for your swimwear because a full day of splashing around at Sunway Lagoon, one of Asia's most loved theme parks, is waiting for you. We have also set aside two wonderful evenings in Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur's world-famous hub for shopping and buzzing nightlife venues that you simply cannot miss. The Malaysia Tour Package truly brings together the best of leisure, adventure, and cultural exploration, making it an ideal getaway for families, couples, or groups who want to come home with memories worth cherishing.
inclusions: Airport transfers from Kuala Lumpur International Airport
Entry to Sunway Lagoon Theme Park

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kuala Lumpur
activities:
Touch down at Kuala Lumpur International Airport where our representative will be right there to greet you and take you smoothly to your hotel for check-in. Once you have settled in, the evening is all yours to explore the vibrant local streets at your own comfortable pace and get a real feel for the city. End your first night in style with a dinner at the famous Jalan Alor Food Street, where the authentic Malaysian flavors and buzzing atmosphere make it an experience worth savoring.

Head back to the hotel and enjoy a restful overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Kuala Lumpur City Tour & Batu Caves
activities:
After breakfast, head out and dive straight into the heart of Kuala Lumpur as you visit some of its most iconic landmarks, including the magnificent Petronas Twin Towers, the stunning Sultan Abdul Samad Building, and the historically rich Independence Square. Make your way over to the remarkable Batu Caves, a revered Hindu shrine nestled inside a dramatic limestone hill that is as visually striking as it is spiritually significant. The evening is completely free, so take your pick between some leisurely shopping or soaking up the city's vibrant nightlife.

Head back to the hotel and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Batu Cave & Genting Highlands Tour
activities:
Set off on a refreshing drive up to the cool and breezy Genting Highlands, where the mountain air alone feels like a welcome change of pace. Hop onto the scenic cable car and enjoy a breathtaking ride up to the hilltop resort, taking in the lush green views along the way. Once up there, lose yourself in the excitement of indoor theme parks, browse through sprawling shopping malls, and explore the many entertainment hubs that keep the energy buzzing all day long. If you are feeling lucky, the famous Genting Casino is right there for those who want to try their hand at a bit of fun.

As the day wraps up, make your way back down and return to Kuala Lumpur for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Fun at Sunway Lagoon Theme Park
activities:
After breakfast, get ready for an absolutely thrilling day as you head over to Sunway Lagoon, one of Asia's most beloved theme parks. Spend the day going wild on exciting water slides, splashing around in the wave pools, taking on amusement rides, and exploring the various adventure zones that cater to every level of thrill seeker. Whether you are visiting as a couple or with family, there is something here for everyone that will keep the smiles and laughter going all day long.

As the evening arrives, make your way back to the hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Kuala Lumpur.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kuala Lumpur
activities: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and make the most of your remaining time with some last minute shopping at the vibrant Bukit Bintang or the charming local markets nearby. When the time comes, you will be comfortably transferred to Kuala Lumpur Airport, where you board your flight home carrying a heart full of wonderful Malaysian memories that will stay with you long after the trip is over.

AllPackage.name: Malaysia Grand Discovery
AllPackage.shortDescription: Experience the very best of Southeast Asia with our specially curated 4 Nights and 5 Days Malaysia Tour Package. This journey is designed to give you a perfect blend of modern city life, refreshing mountain air, exciting theme park fun, taking you from the iconic Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur all the way to Genting Highlands and Sunway Lagoon for a wonderfully balanced mix of culture, adventure, and pure leisure.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Petronas Twin Towers illuminated at dusk with Kuala Lumpur skyline and city lights in Malaysia.

AllPackage.description:
Honestly, if you've been looking for a trip that gives you a little bit of everything — this is it.

This 5-day Pattaya and Bangkok package is the kind of holiday you'll still be talking about months after you get back. It's not just a tour. It's an experience that moves between beach vibes, city energy, ancient temples, and wild adventures — all packed into five beautiful days in Thailand.

Your journey kicks off in Pattaya, and trust me, this city knows how to make a first impression. One evening you're sitting in a glittering theatre watching the world-famous Alcazar Show — a dazzling performance that genuinely leaves you speechless. The next morning you're on a speedboat cutting through the Gulf of Thailand, heading out to Coral Island where the water is so clear and blue it almost doesn't look real. Spend your time swimming, relaxing on the sand, or just soaking in that feeling of being completely free.

Then comes Bangkok — and what a city it is.

You'll walk through some of the most breathtaking places in all of Southeast Asia. The Grand Palace will make your jaw drop. Wat Arun, especially at golden hour, looks like something straight out of a painting. Good food, gentle river breeze, glittering city lights all around you. It's the kind of moment you want to freeze in time.

The trip saves one of its best surprises for last. It's the perfect way to close out an unforgettable trip.

Five days. Two incredible cities. Memories that'll last a lifetime.
exclusions: Personal expenses such as tips, laundry, and shopping
Optional water sports at Coral Island
highlights: Dazzling Alcazar Cabaret Show in Pattaya
Bangkok city sightseeing with temples and Gems Gallery
Romantic Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise
Wildlife encounters at Safari World & Marine Park
inclusions: 4 nights stay in superior category hotels
Coral Island tour with speedboat and Indian lunch
Pattaya to Bangkok transfer with city tour enroute
Entry to Golden Buddha, Mini Reclining Buddha & Gems Gallery
Safari World & Marine Park with buffet lunch

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok – Transfer to Pattaya
activities: Touch down at Bangkok Airport where our friendly representative will be right there to greet you and make you feel welcome from the very first moment. You will then be comfortably transferred to Pattaya by private vehicle, and once you arrive, check into your hotel and take some time to settle in. The evening is all yours, so step out, wander around, and get a feel for the local surroundings at your own comfortable pace.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Alcazar Show & Coral Island Tour
activities:
After a good breakfast at the hotel, get ready for a fun packed day as you are picked up for the Coral Island tour. A speedboat whisks you away to the gorgeous Koh Larn, where you can try exciting water sports like parasailing and snorkeling, or simply kick back and relax on the pristine white sandy beaches. After all the fun, head back to Pattaya and enjoy a satisfying lunch at a local Indian restaurant before returning to the hotel to freshen up.

As the evening arrives, make your way to the famous Alcazar Cabaret Show, a vibrant and spectacular performance that is well worth watching. Head back to the hotel afterwards and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Bangkok – City Tour & River Cruise Dinner
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel and settle into your private vehicle for a smooth transfer to Bangkok. Upon arrival, soak in the city's rich heritage with visits to the magnificent Golden Buddha Temple and the fascinating Mini Reclining Buddha Temple. Round off the daytime exploration with a leisurely stop at Gems Gallery for some enjoyable shopping.

As evening sets in, board the elegant Chao Phraya Princess for a truly memorable dinner cruise. Indulge in a delicious buffet spread accompanied by live music and wonderful cultural performances, all while gazing at the gorgeous night views of Bangkok's iconic skyline. Afterwards, head to your hotel and enjoy a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok – Safari World & Marine Park
activities:
After breakfast, gear up for a thrilling full day adventure at Safari World. Begin with an exciting drive through Safari Park, where lions, giraffes, zebras, and many other incredible animals wander freely all around you. Head over to Marine Park next and enjoy a wonderful lineup of shows, including the beloved Dolphin Show, the hilarious Orangutan Show, and the high energy Spy War Stunt Show. Take a moment to feed the giraffes up close, a genuinely delightful experience that you will not forget in a hurry. A generous buffet lunch served within the park keeps you fueled and ready for more fun throughout the day.

As the day wraps up, make your way back to your Bangkok hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bangkok
activities: After a relaxed breakfast, check out of the hotel and take in those last precious moments of your Thailand trip. Your transfer to Bangkok Airport will then whisk you away for your flight home, leaving you with a heart full of beautiful memories that will surely last a lifetime.

AllPackage.name: Thailand Tropical Delight
AllPackage.shortDescription: Explore the very best of Thailand with this incredible 5-day Pattaya and Bangkok tour package that perfectly blends adventure, culture, and relaxation. Take in the dazzling Alcazar Show, soak up the sun on a Coral Island tour, wander through iconic temples like the Grand Palace and Wat Arun, sail along the Chao Phraya River on a romantic Dinner Cruise, and spend a thrilling day at Safari World & Marine Park for a Thailand holiday you will truly never forget.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Wat Arun temple rising beside the Chao Phraya River in Bangkok at sunset, glowing in warm tropical light under a soft sky.

AllPackage.description: Our Kerala tour package 6 nights 7 days brings together Munnar's misty tea gardens, the golden sandy beaches of Kovalam, the soul-soothing houseboat experience on Alleppey's backwaters, and the rich colonial heritage of Cochin into one beautifully balanced trip. You will get to walk through fragrant spice plantations, enjoy a peaceful wildlife boating experience at Periyar, drift along palm-lined canals on a tranquil houseboat cruise, and explore the fascinating cultural sights that Kochi has to offer around every corner.
exclusions: Entry fees, permits and optional activities (Ayurvedic spa, cultural shows).
Personal expenses, tips, laundry & phone calls
highlights: Relaxing Alleppey houseboat cruise through Kerala backwaters
inclusions: Private transfers & sightseeing as per itinerary
Houseboat cruise charges and local taxes
Pickup & drop at Cochin Airport/Railway Station

itinerary.title: Arrival — Cochin to Munnar
activities:
Upon arriving at Cochin Airport or Railway Station, you will be warmly welcomed and settled into a comfortable transfer towards the beautiful hill station of Munnar. The drive itself is an absolute treat, winding through fragrant spice plantations, lush rubber estates, and sprawling tea gardens with plenty of scenic stops along the way that make the journey feel like the holiday has already begun. Check into your hotel and give yourself some time to relax and soak in the stunning hill views that surround you on all sides. The evening is yours to enjoy at your own pace, whether that means a gentle short walk or simply gazing out over the gorgeous tea gardens as the day comes to a close.

Enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
activities:
Head out for a wonderful day of exploration starting with a visit to the stunning Eravikulam National Park, where the rare and fascinating Nilgiri Tahr can be spotted roaming freely in their natural mountain habitat, a sight that is genuinely thrilling and memorable. Make your way to the scenic Mattupetty Dam and enjoy a relaxing boating session on the beautiful reservoir before stopping at the fun Echo Point and the serene Kundala Lake for some wonderful photo opportunities that capture the natural beauty of Munnar perfectly. Round off your day with a leisurely walk through the sprawling tea plantations and a fascinating visit to a local tea factory, where the entire tea making process comes alive in the most engaging and aromatic way imaginable.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Kovalam
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel and begin your drive towards the beautiful Kovalam and Trivandrum region, with plenty of scenic photo stops and spice garden views along the way that make the journey a genuinely enjoyable and memorable one. Once you arrive at the stunning Kovalam, check into your beach resort and give yourself some time to settle in and soak up the warm coastal atmosphere. The evening is completely yours to enjoy, so head down to the gorgeous Kovalam Beach, watch the sun dip into the horizon in a blaze of stunning colors, and treat yourself to some delicious local seafood that is as fresh as it gets.

Settle in for a relaxing overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Kovalam / Trivandrum Sightseeing
activities:
Spend your morning soaking in the rich cultural heritage of the region, starting with the magnificent Padmanabhaswamy Temple, where even the outer view of this legendary and architecturally stunning shrine is genuinely awe inspiring. Continue to the fascinating Napier Museum and the nearby Art Gallery, where the wonderful collections offer a captivating glimpse into the artistic and historical richness of Kerala. Head back to the coast and spend a relaxed afternoon at the beautiful Kovalam Lighthouse Beach, where a leisurely walk along the promenade with the sound of the waves and the sea breeze is wonderfully refreshing. If you are in the mood for some extra pampering or fun, an optional Ayurvedic massage or beach activities are available at an extra cost and are well worth treating yourself to.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Kovalam.

itinerary.title: Kovalam to Alleppey — Houseboat Cruise
activities:
After breakfast, hit the road and make your way to the enchanting Alleppey, where a beautiful traditional houseboat will be ready and waiting to welcome you aboard by noon. Glide gently through the serene backwaters and make a wonderful stop at the charming Pathiramanal Island and the picturesque local village banks, where the unhurried pace of life along the water is genuinely refreshing and deeply calming. Treat yourself to some freshly prepared Kerala cuisine right on board, with the exciting possibility of a fresh catch being prepared for you in the most authentic and delicious way imaginable.

Settle in and enjoy a truly special and memorable overnight stay on the houseboat, drifting peacefully along the backwaters under a sky full of stars.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Munnar
activities:
After a leisurely morning cruise along the peaceful backwaters, disembark from the houseboat and begin your drive towards the beautiful hill station of Munnar. Check into your hotel upon arrival, settle in comfortably, and give yourself some well deserved rest after the journey. As the evening sets in, head out and explore the charming Munnar town or browse through the colorful local markets at your own relaxed pace, soaking in the cool hill air and vibrant local atmosphere.

Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Cochin — Departure
activities: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and begin your drive towards Cochin, with some time along the way for a short but rewarding sightseeing stop if the schedule permits. Wander through the charming streets of Fort Kochi, admire the iconic Chinese fishing nets that have become synonymous with Kerala, and browse through the historic and atmospheric Jew Town for a final taste of Cochin's unique and layered character. When the time comes, head to Cochin Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey home, carrying with you a heart full of beautiful and unforgettable Kerala memories that will stay with you for a very long time.

AllPackage.name: Enchanting Kerala Bliss Experience
AllPackage.shortDescription: Enjoy our Kerala 6N/7D tour package that takes you through the misty hills of Munnar, the sunny shores of Kovalam, the magical backwaters of Alleppey on a traditional houseboat, and the rich heritage of Cochin, all tied together with scenic drives, fragrant spice gardens, beautiful beaches, and moments of pure cultural immersion and relaxation.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Colorful fishing boats docked along calm backwaters with coconut palm trees in scenic Kerala village.

AllPackage.description: If you are ready to experience and explore the best of Goa's nightlife, this is perfect for you. We've designed it for a people who want to dive straight into the action. Start with a laid-back beach shack party, spend your days wandering North Goa's most iconic beaches, and let loose at the best clubs once the sun goes down. Swing by the buzzing Arpora night market for some shopping, street food, and live music that keeps the energy going all night. Enjoy beach parties packed with great DJs, flowing drinks, and an incredible dance atmosphere. Built for travelers who love to travel and explore the different cities , this itinerary promises you will have non-stop fun, nights you will never forget, and a real taste of what makes Goa's nightlife so special.
exclusions: Lunch & dinner (except party snacks/drinks if included)
Club entry fees, drinks, and personal expenses
highlights: Daytime sightseeing of North Goa beaches
inclusions: 3 nights stay at hotel near North Goa beaches
Beach shack parties and night market visit
AC vehicle for local transfers as per itinerary

itinerary.title: Arrival & Beach Shack Party
activities: Upon arriving at the airport or railway station, you will be warmly picked up and transferred straight to your hotel for a smooth and comfortable check-in. Once you have settled in and freshened up, head out for an unforgettable evening at one of the famous beach shacks at Calangute or Baga, where the infectious music, refreshing drinks, and laid back beach vibes come together to give you the perfect introduction to Goa.

itinerary.title: North Goa Tour + Clubbing
activities:
After breakfast, hit the road and spend your day soaking up the best of North Goa's stunning coastline, with visits to the historic Fort Aguada and the beautiful beaches of Sinquerim, Baga, Anjuna, and Vagator, each one offering its own unique charm and energy. As the sun goes down and the night comes alive, head out to some of North Goa's most popular clubs where the music, energy, and atmosphere make for an absolutely electric night out.

Return to the hotel late night and get some well deserved rest.

itinerary.title: Beach Party & Night Market
activities:
After breakfast, take it easy and spend your day chilling on the beach or diving into some fun daytime beach activities at your own pace. As the evening kicks in, the beach comes alive with a fantastic party atmosphere, complete with pumping DJ sets and refreshing drinks that keep the energy going. Wrap up your night with a visit to the vibrant Arpora Night Market, where a lively mix of shopping stalls and delicious street food makes for a wonderfully fun and memorable experience.

Head back to the hotel and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a relaxed breakfast, take your morning slow and enjoy some quiet time to unwind and soak in those last few moments of the beautiful Goa experience. When the time comes, check out of the hotel and get comfortably transferred to the airport or railway station for your journey back home, carrying with you a heart full of sun soaked and unforgettable Goa memories.

AllPackage.name: Goa Party & Beach Vibes Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Dive into Goa's electric nightlife, sun-soaked beach parties, buzzing clubs, and lively night markets on this thrilling 4-day adventure built purely for good times.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Historic Portuguese style church building with white walls and tower under cloudy sky in Goa, India.

Relax and explore on beautiful beaches, try fun water sports at Tanjung Benoa and visit the beautiful Nusa Penida Island for unforgettable views. Spend time on gorgeous beaches, dive into exciting watersports at Tanjung Benoa, and make your way to the breathtaking Nusa Penida Island for views you will never forget. Visit spiritual temples like Tanah Lot and Uluwatu while soaking in some of the most stunning sunsets you have ever laid eyes on. Walk around Ubud and discover its culture, art villages, traditional crafts, green rice fields, and the scenic Kintamani Volcano.This Bali Tour Package perfectly designed for families, couples, and solo travelers alike who want to take in Bali's natural beauty, deep culture, and one of a kind experiences all within a single unforgettable trip.

itinerary.title: Arrival at Denpasar International Airport
activities: Touch down at Denpasar International Airport and get whisked away to your hotel for a smooth and comfortable check-in. Once you have settled in, the rest of the day is completely yours to enjoy however you like. Kick back, explore your surroundings, or simply relax and let the beautiful Bali atmosphere do its thing as you ease into your first overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Watersports Activity Tour
activities:
Head out to Tanjung Benoa Beach for an action packed morning filled with thrilling water sports that are guaranteed to get your adrenaline pumping. Afterwards, make your way over to the beautiful Nusa Dua Island and spend some time soaking in its charm and natural beauty. As the evening rolls in, treat yourself and your loved one to a romantic candlelight dinner right on the beach, with the sound of the waves and the stars above making it a truly magical experience.

Head back to the hotel and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Tour
activities:
Spend a full and exciting day exploring the stunning west side of Nusa Penida, where dramatic cliffs, crystal clear waters, and breathtaking natural landscapes make every stop feel like a once in a lifetime experience. A delicious lunch is included along the way to keep you energized as you take it all in.

Head back and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Tanah Lot & Uluwatu Temple Tour
activities:
Make your way to the iconic Tanah Lot Temple, perched dramatically on a rocky outcrop by the sea, where the views and spiritual atmosphere are genuinely awe inspiring. Continue your day with a visit to the stunning Uluwatu Temple, sitting high on a clifftop with sweeping ocean views that are absolutely breathtaking and well worth the trip.

Head back to the hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Ubud Private Pool Villa
activities:
Pack your bags and make your way to your beautiful private pool villa in Ubud, where a whole new level of comfort and tranquility awaits you. The rest of the day is entirely yours to enjoy at your own pace, so soak in the serene surroundings, take a dip in your private pool, and let the lush Ubud atmosphere melt away any stress.

Settle in and enjoy a wonderfully relaxing overnight stay at the villa.

itinerary.title: Ubud Kintamani Tour with Bali Swing
activities:
Set out for a wonderful day of exploration starting with a tour of the charming Ubud Village, where the local culture and artistic energy make it a genuinely delightful place to wander through. Head over to the magnificent Kintamani Volcano and the stunning Lake Batur, where the views are nothing short of spectacular. Round off your day with a thrilling ride on the famous Bali Swing and a relaxed stop at a local coffee plantation where you can sample some of the finest brews the island has to offer.

Head back to your private pool villa and enjoy a blissful overnight stay surrounded by the beauty of Ubud.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: When the time comes, you will be comfortably transferred from your hotel or villa straight to Denpasar International Airport for your departure. As you board your flight home, take a moment to look back on the incredible experiences and beautiful memories that Bali so generously gifted you throughout your stay.

AllPackage.name: Bali Serenity Retreat
AllPackage.shortDescription: Discover the very best of Bali with our 7-day Bali Tour Package, taking you through stunning beaches, ancient temples, exciting watersports, the charm of Ubud, and some truly relaxing private villa stays along the way.

AllPackage.description: Set off on a 5-day Luxury Egypt tour that begins in the heart of Cairo, where the Great Pyramids will leave you completely speechless and fine dining restaurants will make every evening feel like an occasion worth celebrating. From there, step aboard a luxury Nile cruise sailing from Aswan to Luxor, where timeless wonders like the Valley of the Kings, the grand Karnak Temple, and the beautiful Philae Temple are waiting to be discovered at your own pace. Throughout the journey you will be treated to lavish hotel stays, smooth private transfers, and beautifully prepared gourmet meals that add a touch of elegance to every single day. Round things off with an optional hot air balloon ride over the Nile or a leisurely browse through the local bazaars before you head home from a trip that will stay with you for the rest of your life.
exclusions: Optional balloon ride or Abu Simbel visit
highlights: Private tours of the Great Pyramids Sphinx and Valley Temple
Luxury Nile cruise from Aswan to Luxor
Visit to the Valley of the Kings and Queen Hatshepsut Temple
Sunset cruise and optional balloon ride over Luxor
Visit Khan el-Khalili Bazaar and Old Cairo landmarks
inclusions: 3 nights on a luxury Nile Cruise (full board)
All private transfers and domestic flights (Cairo → Aswan Luxor → Cairo)
Entrance fees to all mentioned sites

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo – Pyramids & Luxury Dining
activities:
Touch down at Cairo International Airport and enjoy a VIP meet and greet experience that sets the tone for a truly luxurious journey ahead. Settle into a smooth private transfer to your stunning 5 star hotel, whether that is the iconic Nile Ritz-Carlton, the elegant Four Seasons, or the sophisticated Sofitel, each one a destination in itself. Head out to witness the awe inspiring Great Pyramids of Giza, the enigmatic Sphinx, and the ancient Valley Temple, landmarks that have captivated the world for thousands of years and are even more magnificent in person. If you are feeling adventurous, hop onto a camel for a memorable ride around the pyramids that adds a wonderfully authentic touch to the experience.

As the evening arrives, treat yourself to a spectacular dinner at the elegant 139 Pavilion at the Nile Ritz-Carlton or the stunning Sequoia, where the beautiful Nile views make the meal feel even more special.

itinerary.title: Cairo → Aswan – Philae Temple & Nile Cruise
activities:
After breakfast, head to Cairo Airport and board your flight to the enchanting city of Aswan, where a luxurious Nile cruise ship will be waiting to welcome you aboard, whether that is the magnificent Sonesta St. George or the elegant Oberoi Philae. Once you have settled in and soaked up the incredible surroundings, head out to explore some of Aswan's most fascinating landmarks, including the breathtaking Philae Temple, the remarkable Unfinished Obelisk, and the impressive Aswan High Dam, each offering a fascinating glimpse into Egypt's rich and layered history. As the sun begins to dip towards the horizon, treat yourself to an optional Felucca ride on the serene Nile, where the gentle rocking of the boat and the golden evening light create a moment of pure magic.

Return to the cruise ship for a delicious dinner and a wonderfully peaceful overnight stay aboard on the beautiful Nile.

itinerary.title: Aswan → Kom Ombo → Edfu (Cruise Day)
activities:
Wake up to the most incredible breakfast experience as you dine aboard the cruise while gliding gently along the majestic Nile, with the stunning riverside scenery drifting past you in the most peaceful and beautiful way. Step ashore to explore the fascinating Kom Ombo Temple, a unique double temple dedicated to both Sobek and Horus, where the intricate carvings and rich history are genuinely captivating. Head back on board for a leisurely lunch before making your way to the magnificent Edfu Temple, arriving in style by horse drawn carriage or private car for an experience that feels wonderfully theatrical. Continue sailing towards Luxor as the afternoon unfolds, and as the evening arrives, settle in for cocktails and a gourmet dinner that sets the stage for a truly memorable night.

Round off your evening with the lively and colorful Egyptian Galabeya Party, where traditional dress, music, and dancing create an atmosphere that is as joyful and festive as it gets before retiring for a peaceful overnight stay aboard the cruise.

itinerary.title: Luxor West & East Bank – Ancient Thebes
activities:
Rise early and treat yourself to an optional hot air balloon ride over the breathtaking Nile Valley, drifting serenely above the ancient landscape as the sun rises and the world below awakens in the most spectacular fashion imaginable. Once back on the ground, set off for a truly awe inspiring day of exploration, visiting the legendary Valley of the Kings where three tombs await your discovery, with an optional visit to the iconic tomb of King Tutankhamun for those who want the full experience. Continue to the magnificent Temple of Queen Hatshepsut and the striking Colossi of Memnon, both of which are genuinely humbling in their scale and historical significance. Head back to the cruise for a relaxed lunch before venturing out in the evening to explore the extraordinary Karnak Temple and the stunning Luxor Temple, two of the most impressive ancient monuments you will ever have the privilege of standing before.

As the day draws to a close, choose to either stay on in Luxor and check into a luxury hotel for a comfortable overnight stay, or make your way back to Cairo for the next chapter of your Egyptian adventure.

itinerary.title: Return to Cairo – Shopping, Old City & Departure
activities:
Board your flight from Luxor back to Cairo and make the most of your remaining time in this extraordinary city with a visit to the vibrant and bustling Khan el-Khalili Bazaar, where the colorful stalls, aromatic spices, and unique handicrafts make for a wonderfully immersive final shopping experience. Alternatively, lose yourself in the rich history of Old Cairo with visits to the ancient Hanging Church and the magnificent Al-Azhar Mosque, both of which carry a deeply moving sense of history and spirituality. Treat yourself to a final memorable lunch at the beloved Zooba or the elegant Abou El Sid, two restaurants that perfectly capture the flavors and warmth of Egyptian cuisine.

When the time comes, settle into your private transfer to Cairo Airport and head home carrying a heart full of extraordinary and unforgettable memories from one of the most ancient and magnificent destinations on earth.

AllPackage.name: Royal Egypt Nile Heritage Journey
AllPackage.shortDescription: Indulge in a luxury Egypt tour featuring private guided explorations of Cairo's legendary pyramids, a lavish Nile cruise, and up-close visits to the magnificent ancient temples of Aswan and Luxor.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Historic mosque with domes and minarets overlooking Cairo skyline in Egypt.

AllPackage.description: If you are looking for a mix of adventure and relaxation, this 6 Day Thailand trip. We've put together an itinerary that covers the best of Pattaya and Bangkok without the usual travel stress. Next we head to Bangkok to see the city's icons. We'll visit the Grand Palace and the stunning temples of Wat Arun and Wat Pho. Its a great way to enjoy the city lights with good food and live music. Comfortable hotels with breakfast and dinner included, guided tours, and hassle-free transfers are all taken care of, so you can simply sit back and enjoy the very best of Pattaya and Bangkok.
exclusions: Personal expenses like tips and laundry

Coral Island adventure with beach time

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok – Transfer to Pattaya
activities: Touch down at Bangkok Airport where our representative will be right there to greet you with a warm and friendly welcome. From there, settle into a comfortable private vehicle for a smooth transfer to your hotel in Pattaya. Once you have checked in, take some time to relax and get comfortable before heading out in the evening to explore the vibrant local surroundings at your own pace and soak up the lively Pattaya atmosphere.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Alcazar Show
activities:
After a good breakfast at the hotel, the morning is completely yours to enjoy at your own pace. Head out and explore Pattaya's beautiful beaches or browse through the colorful local markets, taking in the sights and sounds of this vibrant city without any rush. As the evening arrives, make your way to the world famous Alcazar Cabaret Show, a dazzling and visually stunning performance that is genuinely hard to put into words.

Return to the hotel afterwards and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Coral Island Tour
activities: After breakfast, make your way to the pier and hop aboard a speedboat headed for the beautiful Coral Island, also known as Koh Larn. Once you arrive, the island greets you with its pristine beaches and sparkling clear waters that are perfect for a refreshing swim. If you are feeling adventurous, try your hand at some optional water sports like parasailing and jet ski for an extra dose of excitement. After all the fun, head back to Pattaya and sit down for a satisfying Indian lunch before returning to the hotel for some well deserved rest.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Bangkok – City Tour
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel and begin your scenic transfer from Pattaya to Bangkok. Once you arrive, dive straight into the heart of the city with a visit to the breathtaking Grand Palace and the sacred Emerald Buddha, where the sheer grandeur and intricate detail leave you genuinely speechless. Head over to Wat Pho to see the magnificent Reclining Buddha up close, and then make your way to the riverside Wat Arun temple, whose stunning spires reflected in the water make for an absolutely beautiful sight. The evening is completely yours to explore Bangkok at your own relaxed pace.

Settle into your hotel and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok – Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise
activities:
After breakfast, the day is all yours to enjoy however you please, whether that means hitting the popular shopping spots around the city or signing up for one of the optional tours on offer. As the evening rolls in, make your way to the Chao Phraya River and board a luxurious dinner cruise that sets the tone for a truly special night. Treat yourself to a generous buffet spread featuring delicious Thai and international dishes, all while enjoying live music and captivating cultural performances onboard. The stunning night views of Bangkok's glittering skyline seen from the water make the whole experience feel genuinely magical.

Head back to the hotel afterwards and enjoy a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bangkok
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and take a moment to soak in those last few precious memories of your Thailand adventure. You will then be comfortably transferred to Bangkok Airport, where you board your flight home carrying a heart full of wonderful and unforgettable experiences that this beautiful country so generously gave you throughout your stay.

AllPackage.description: This 6-day Shimla Manali Tour Package brings together nature, adventure, and relaxation in a way that makes every single day feel worth looking forward to. The journey begins as you make your way to Shimla, the beloved Queen of Hills, where Kufri, the iconic Jakhoo Temple, The Ridge, the buzzing Mall Road, and the beautiful Christ Church are all waiting to be explored at a comfortable pace. From Shimla the road takes you onward to Manali, passing through Kullu which is well known for its thrilling river rafting and stunning Himalayan scenery along the way. Once in Manali, you can look forward to an action-packed day at Solang Valley, try your hand at paragliding or skiing depending on the season, and spend unhurried time soaking in the charm of local favorites like Hadimba Devi Temple, Manu Temple, Van Vihar, and the peaceful Tibetan monasteries that give Manali its unique character.

itinerary.title: Delhi → Shimla (350 km / 7 hrs)
activities:
Get picked up from Delhi and settle in for a scenic drive as you make your way toward the charming hill station of Shimla, watching the plains gradually give way to beautiful mountain landscapes.

Upon arrival, check into your hotel, enjoy a warm dinner, and rest up for an overnight stay as your Shimla adventure officially begins.

itinerary.title: Shimla Sightseeing
activities:
Start your day with a fun trip to Kufri and Mahashu Peak, where you can enjoy a memorable horse or mule ride through the scenic surroundings, followed by some exciting activities at the Kufri Adventure Resort and Fun Campus. Head back toward Shimla and visit the hilltop Jakhoo Temple, taking the ropeway up for a ride that offers stunning views all around.

Round off your day with a leisurely stroll along The Ridge, soaking in the beauty of Christ Church and the lively Mall Road, before making your way back to the hotel for a relaxing overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla → Manali via Kullu (250 km / 7 hrs)
activities:
After breakfast, check out and hit the road toward Manali, stopping along the way to admire the impressive Pandoh Dam and, if you are up for some thrills, try your hand at river rafting in Kullu at your own cost.

Arrive in Manali by evening, check into your hotel, and wind down for a comfortable overnight stay as you prepare for the adventures that lie ahead.

itinerary.title: Manali – Solang Valley
activities:
Spend your day out in the stunning Solang Valley, trying out thrilling activities like paragliding, zorbing, and skiing depending on the season, and exploring the Him Valley Amusement and Cultural Park for a fun and memorable experience. If you are feeling adventurous, you can also opt for an excursion to the famous Rohtang Pass on a direct payment basis for some truly jaw dropping high altitude scenery.

Head back to your hotel in the evening and settle in for a well deserved overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
activities:
Spend your morning visiting some of Manali's most cherished spots, starting with the ancient Hadimba Devi Temple, followed by the peaceful Manu Temple and the natural freshwater spring at Nehru Kund. Continue your day exploring the serene Manali Gompa and the lovely Van Vihar park, soaking in the calm and greenery all around you.

As the evening rolls in, head to Mall Road for some leisurely time browsing shops and taking in the lively atmosphere before sitting down to a warm dinner and retiring for an overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali → Delhi (550 km / 12 hrs)
activities:
After a satisfying breakfast, check out and begin the scenic drive back to Delhi, letting the beautiful mountain memories sink in one last time as the landscapes slowly shift around you.

Upon reaching Delhi, get dropped off at the Airport or Railway Station, bringing to a close a truly wonderful Shimla Manali journey filled with moments you will carry in your heart for a long time to come.

Explore the charming Kufri, the scenic Kullu valley, the thrilling Solang Valley, the breathtaking Rohtang Pass, the sacred Hadimba Temple, the iconic Mall Road, and the peaceful Van Vihar on a trip that beautifully blends nature, adventure, and raw Himalayan beauty.

AllPackage.description: Experience a perfect mix of ancient history, peaceful spirituality, and beautiful beaches with our 5 night 6 days Pondicherry and Mahabalipuram tour. This trip is designed to show your some of the best spots in South India. Your journey begins in Chennai, where you get to explore beloved landmarks like Marina Beach and Fort St. George before making your way to the ancient temple town of Mahabalipuram. Finally the journey leads to Pondicherry, You can also explore its unique French style streets, colorful temples, the peaceful Sri Aurobinwo Ashram and the one of a kind community of Auroville are all waiting to be explored. With a blend of local culture, amazing architecture, and relaxing beaches this tour offers a truly memorable South Indian experience

itinerary.title: Chennai to Mahabalipuram
activities:
Start your day with a refreshing stroll along the iconic Marina Beach, the world's second longest sandy beach, where the vast expanse of golden sand and the sound of the waves set a wonderful tone for the day ahead. Make your way to the magnificent Kapaleeswarar Temple, an 8th century Dravidian style shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva, where the intricate architecture and spiritual atmosphere are genuinely awe inspiring. Head over to the historic Fort St. George, Chennai's famous British era stronghold, and spend some time walking through the Fort Museum to admire its fascinating collection of colonial relics. Visit St. Thomas Mount for breathtaking panoramic views of the city, and take a moment to admire the stunning Indo Saracenic architecture of the Ripon Building. Round off your Chennai exploration with a visit to Snake Park for its fascinating reptile exhibits and a final stop at Chennai Lighthouse before hitting the road towards Mahabalipuram.

Arrive at Mahabalipuram and check into your hotel for a well deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Mahabalipuram Sightseeing
activities:
Start your day with a visit to the magnificent Shore Temple, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that stands proudly facing the vast Bay of Bengal, its ancient stonework and serene setting making it a truly unforgettable sight. Head over to the Crocodile Park for a fascinating encounter with a diverse range of reptile species that is sure to be both exciting and educational. Round off your day by exploring the remarkable Five Rathas, a stunning collection of monolithic rock cut temples that stand as a proud testament to the brilliance of Pallava art and architecture.

Head back to your hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Mahabalipuram to Pondicherry
activities:
Begin your day marveling at the extraordinary Arjuna's Penance, one of the largest rock relief carvings in the world, depicting rich and intricate mythological scenes that are truly humbling to stand before. Make your way to Tiger's Cave, a charming rock cut shrine sitting close to the coast, and then head over to see the famous Krishna's Butter Ball, a gigantic boulder that seems to defy gravity in the most fascinating way. Wrap up your sightseeing with a visit to the Pondicherry Museum, where a wonderful collection of French and archaeological artifacts offer a fascinating glimpse into the region's layered history.

hop in the car and drive to Pondicherry, where a comfortable overnight stay awaits you.

itinerary.title: Pondicherry Sightseeing
activities:
Start your morning with a peaceful visit to the Manakula Vinayagar Temple, an ancient and deeply revered shrine dedicated to Lord Ganesha, where the warm and devotional atmosphere leaves a lasting impression. Head over to the beautiful Botanical Garden and spend some relaxed time wandering through its well manicured grounds and admiring its impressive collection of rare plant species. As the evening rolls in, make your way to the charming Promenade Beach or browse through the local markets at your own leisurely pace, soaking in the unique French influenced charm that makes Pondicherry so special.

Head back to your hotel and enjoy a restful overnight stay in Pondicherry.

itinerary.title: Pondicherry
activities:
Begin your day with a truly inspiring visit to Auroville, a remarkable international community built around the ideals of peace, harmony, and human unity, a place that feels unlike anywhere else you have ever been. Make your way to the serene Sri Aurobindo Ashram, a deeply spiritual retreat founded in 1926, where the calm and contemplative atmosphere invites you to slow down and reflect. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy freely, so wander through the charming lanes of the French Quarter and pop into some of the delightful cafes along the way for a truly relaxed and unhurried experience.

Head back to your hotel and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and begin your drive back to Chennai, taking with you a heart full of wonderful memories from your South India journey. As the miles roll by, reflect on all the incredible experiences, stunning sights, and warm moments that made this trip truly unforgettable before reaching Chennai for your onward departure.

AllPackage.name: Pondicherry & Mahabalipuram Coastal Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Explore the very best of Chennai, Mahabalipuram, and Pondicherry through our 5N/6D tour package, where ancient heritage temples, charming French colonial streets, beautiful beaches, and deeply spiritual retreats like Auroville and the Sri Aurobindo Ashram all come together beautifully..
AllPackage.imageAlt: Colorful South Indian temple gopuram with intricate sculptures under clear blue sky in Tamil Nadu.

AllPackage.description:
You will start from Srinagar, where you can see the famous lakes, visit the historic Mughal Gardens, and stay in a traditional houseboat. Then, you will travel to Gulmarg, famous for the its snow covered with mountains and scenic After that we will explore Pahalgam surrounded by beautiful pine forests and beautiful and peaceful valleys and enjoy your snow actitvites there.

You will also visit Sonmarg, which is famous for its snowy glaciers and amazing landscapes. Along the way, enjoy relaxing drives through small Kashmiri villages and take in the natural beauty around you.

This tour gives you enough time to explore, relax, and enjoy the culture and adventure of Kashmir, making your trip truly special and unforgettable.
exclusions: Gulmarg Gondola tickets (Phase 1 & 2), monument entry fees, and Shikara rides if not specified
Personal expenses (tips, laundry, mineral water, phone calls, room heater).
