itinerary.title: Arrival in Jammu & Transfer to Srinagar
activities:
Upon arriving at Jammu Railway Station, our representative will be there to meet you and get you started on a scenic drive to Srinagar. Once you reach Dal Lake, check into your deluxe houseboat and take a moment to appreciate the sheer beauty of your surroundings. As the evening settles in, hop onto a Shikara and glide across the calm waters at Nehru Park, where the sunset views are simply breathtaking.

Head back to the houseboat for a warm dinner and a truly memorable overnight stay on the lake.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Local Sightseeing
activities:
Spend your day soaking in the timeless beauty of Srinagar as you visit the stunning Mughal Gardens, including Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Cheshma Shahi, each one more gorgeous than the last. Make your way up to Shankaracharya Temple, where the panoramic views of the city are absolutely worth the climb. Round off your day with some leisurely shopping for exquisite Kashmiri carpets, shawls, and handicrafts that make for perfect souvenirs.

Head back to your hotel in Srinagar for a satisfying dinner and a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Sonmarg
activities:
Set off on a scenic drive to Sonmarg, lovingly known as the Meadow of Gold, where the landscape greets you with stunning snow capped peaks and magnificent glaciers that are truly a sight to behold. If you are feeling adventurous, hop on a pony and ride your way up to the breathtaking Thajiwas Glacier, available at a direct payment on the spot.

After a fulfilling day in Sonmarg, make your way back to Srinagar and wind down with a warm dinner and a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg
activities:
Head out on a beautiful drive to Gulmarg, a destination famous for its thrilling ski slopes and stunning alpine meadows that feel like something straight out of a postcard. Take a stroll around the world's highest golf course, a truly unique experience that is hard to find anywhere else. If you are up for it, hop onto the Gondola for a breathtaking ride up to Kongdori or Apharwat, where the views from the top are absolutely spectacular (available at an extra cost).

Settle into your hotel in Gulmarg for a cozy dinner and a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg to Pahalgam
activities:
Hit the road and enjoy a gorgeous drive that takes you past the famous Pampore saffron fields and the ancient Avantipura ruins, both of which are fascinating stops along the way. As you continue, the scenic views of the Lidder River winding through lush pine valleys make the journey feel genuinely refreshing and peaceful. Once you reach Pahalgam, the evening is yours to enjoy freely at your own pace.

Sit back, relax, and enjoy a lovely dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Sightseeing
activities:
Spend your day exploring some of Pahalgam's most stunning natural gems, including the breathtaking Betaab Valley, the serene Aru Valley, and the charming Baisaran, fondly known as Mini Switzerland. Each spot brings its own unique beauty, from dense pine forests and rolling meadows to lovely riverside picnic areas that invite you to slow down and breathe it all in. If you are feeling adventurous, try your hand at some optional horse riding or trout fishing for a little extra fun.

Head back to your hotel for a satisfying dinner and a relaxing overnight stay in Pahalgam.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam to Srinagar
activities:
Begin your drive back to Srinagar, passing through the bustling town of Anantnag along the way. Once you arrive, the evening is yours to enjoy as you please, whether that means a peaceful leisurely walk along the iconic Dal Lake or a serene visit to the revered Hazratbal Shrine, both of which carry their own special charm.

Wind down the day with a warm dinner and a restful overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities:
Take your morning slow and use the free time for some last minute shopping to pick up anything you may have missed along the way. Once you are done, check out of the hotel and get transferred comfortably to Jammu Railway Station or Srinagar Airport, wherever your onward journey takes you.

And just like that, your Kashmir adventure comes to a close, leaving you with a heart full of memories that you will cherish for a very long time.

AllPackage.name: Kashmir Grand Explorer
AllPackage.shortDescription: Dive deep into our Kashmir Tour Package 7N/8D with cozy houseboat stays, shikara rides on Dal Lake, visits to the stunning Mughal Gardens, vast meadows of Gulmarg, serene Pahalgam valleys, breathtaking Sonmarg glaciers, and some truly wonderful hidden local gems along the way.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Shikara boats glide across Dal Lake with snow covered Himalayan mountains and drifting clouds in scenic Kashmir.

AllPackage.description:
Some trips you plan. Others just pull you in. This 4-day Rishikesh Thrills tour is very much the second kind.

From the moment you arrive, there's an energy to this place that's hard to explain until you've felt it yourself. Maybe it's the roar of the Ganges, or the mountains sitting quietly in the background, or just the feeling that something exciting is always around the next corner. Whatever it is, it gets under your skin fast.

Over four days, you'll throw yourself into white-water rafting, bungee jumping, cliff jumping, and zip-lining straight across the Ganges. Between the big thrills, the pace shifts just enough to let you breathe scenic treks that lead somewhere worth going, waterfalls tucked away like the valley's best-kept secrets, and slow walks through local villages where life moves at its own quiet rhythm.

When evening comes, there's no better place to wind down than around a bonfire at your riverside camp. The flames, the sound of the river, the sky doing its thing overhead, it all adds up to the kind of moment you don't plan for but never forget. Rishikesh after dark comes alive in its own way, with cultural performances that feel less like entertainment and more like something real. The music, the movement, the warmth of it stays with you.

If the day's left your body tired and your head still spinning, the optional yoga and meditation sessions are there when you want them. No agenda, no expectations just a little space to come back to yourself before another full day ahead.

You'll sleep well too. Comfortable riverside camps and cozy boutique hotels take care of that, and private transfers handle the logistics so you're never left figuring things out on your own.

Whether you're chasing adrenaline, travelling with your closest friends, or doing this one solo. Rishikesh has a way of meeting you exactly where you are. Adventure, nature, culture, and something that feels genuinely alive. All of it, in four days, in the adventure capital of India.
highlights: White-water rafting on the Ganges (Grades II–IV)
Local village visits & street food experiences
inclusions: 3 nights in riverside camps or boutique hotels
White-water rafting, bungee jumping, zip-lining, and cliff jumping
Riverside camping with bonfire & cultural activities

itinerary.title: Arrival & Riverside Camp
activities: Upon arriving at Dehradun airport or railway station, you will be warmly picked up and transferred comfortably to your riverside camp or hotel for a smooth and relaxed check-in. As the evening sets in, make your way to the sacred Triveni Ghat and witness the mesmerizing Ganga Aarti, a deeply spiritual and visually stunning experience that sets the perfect tone for your Rishikesh adventure.

itinerary.title: Adventure Day 1
activities: Start your morning with an exhilarating white water rafting experience on the mighty Ganges, navigating through thrilling Grade II and III rapids that get the adrenaline pumping in the most incredible way. If you are feeling extra adventurous, try your hand at optional cliff jumping or zip-lining for an added rush that takes the excitement up another notch. As the evening rolls in, gather around a warm bonfire and enjoy some wonderful cultural performances that bring the magic of Rishikesh alive in the most memorable way.

itinerary.title: Adventure Day 2
activities: Kick off your morning with the ultimate rush of bungee jumping, followed by the thrilling flying fox that sends you soaring through the stunning Rishikesh landscape at breathtaking speed. Once the excitement settles, lace up your shoes and head out on a rewarding trek to some nearby waterfalls and scenic spots that showcase the natural beauty of this incredible region at its finest. As the evening arrives, take your pick between some quiet leisure time or an optional yoga and meditation session that helps you find your inner calm after an action packed day.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, make the most of your remaining morning time with an optional short trek or a charming village visit that gives you one last taste of the beautiful Rishikesh surroundings. When the time comes, settle into your private transfer to Dehradun airport or railway station, heading home with a heart full of adventure filled and utterly unforgettable Rishikesh memories that will stay with you for a very long time.

AllPackage.name: Rishikesh Thrill & Ganga Retreat
AllPackage.shortDescription: Dive into an action-filled 4-day Rishikesh tour with river rafting, bungee jumping, trekking, camping under the stars, and the deeply calming spiritual energy that flows along the sacred Ganga.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Suspension bridge over the Ganges River with scenic hills and city view in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand.

AllPackage.description: Our 4-day Goa package is built specifically for people who love the water and everything that comes with it. Forget slow sightseeing and jump straight into the action with jet skiing, parasailing, and banana rides along North Goa's beautiful beaches, plus a full day of exciting sea activities to keep the energy high. Explore the underwater world through scuba diving or snorkeling, or opt for a fun island trip with dolphin spotting and a laid-back beach BBQ to round things off. With your evenings free to kick back and relax by the shore, this itinerary is just right for anyone looking for a short but seriously thrilling Goa holiday.
exclusions: Lunch & dinner (except during island/island diving trip)
Entry fees for any additional attractions
highlights: Grande Island/Coral spotting trip with boat ride
Leisure evenings on Goa’s lively beaches
inclusions: All water sports package (jet ski, parasailing, banana ride, speed boat, bumper ride)
Scuba diving/snorkeling or island trip with equipment & lunch

itinerary.title: Arrival in Goa
activities:
Upon arriving at the airport or railway station, you will be warmly picked up and transferred straight to your hotel for a smooth check-in. Once you have freshened up, head straight out to the buzzing North Goa beaches of Calangute or Baga and dive into an exciting lineup of water sports. Try your hand at jet skiing, hop on a banana ride, or soar above the water on a parasailing adventure for a truly thrilling start to your Goa getaway.

As the evening rolls in, find a cozy spot by the beach and unwind at your own relaxed pace.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Water Sports
activities:
After breakfast, gear up for a full day of pure sea adventure that is guaranteed to keep the adrenaline pumping from start to finish. Spend your time conquering the waves on a jet ski, speeding across the water on a speedboat, soaring high above the sea on a parasailing ride, and enjoying the classic fun of banana and bumper rides that never get old. Take a well deserved break for lunch at one of the laid back beach shacks nearby before heading back out for more fun.

Return to the hotel in the evening and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Scuba Diving / Snorkeling / Island Trip
activities: After breakfast, get ready for an incredible underwater adventure as you head out for a guided scuba diving or snorkeling session, complete with a professional instructor and all the gear you need to explore the vibrant and colorful world beneath the surface. It is the kind of experience that leaves you genuinely amazed at the beauty hiding just below the waves. As the evening arrives, make your way to the laid back beach cafes of Anjuna or Vagator and spend some quality time soaking in the relaxed and bohemian vibe that these beloved beaches are so well known for.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, spend your last morning in Goa the right way, with your toes in the sand and the sound of the waves keeping you company as you soak in the beautiful beach atmosphere one final time. When the time comes, check out of the hotel and get comfortably transferred to the airport or railway station, heading home with a heart full of sun soaked and unforgettable Goa memories.

AllPackage.name: Goa Ultimate Adventure Edition
AllPackage.shortDescription: A fun-filled Goa getaway loaded with jet skiing, parasailing, scuba diving, and endless beach excitement for anyone who loves a good rush of adrenaline.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Sandy Goa beach with palm trees, waves, and tourists walking along the Arabian Sea shoreline.

AllPackage.description: Forget the usual crowded temples and basic sightseeing tours. This is 4 Days Goa package is built specifically for peoples who actually wanta an adrenaline rush. We've packed the itinerary with the best adventure sports the islands has to offer because this Goa tour package is made entirely for people who live for the thrill. Across 4 action-filled days, you will get to experience Goa's most exciting adventure sports, from parasailing and jet skiing at Calangute to scuba diving at Grande Island and kayaking through calm, scenic backwaters. If you prefer land over water, you can switch things up with ATV rides, rappelling, and ziplining through the jungle. We make sure you have certified instructors and all the right gear so you can just relax. Its the perfect mix of adrenaline and great memorie that you'll be thinking about long after you get back home.

banana boat rides at North Goa beaches

itinerary.title: Water Thrill in North Goa
activities:
Touch down and get checked into your hotel before heading straight out to the buzzing beaches of Calangute or Baga for an action packed day on the water. Try your hand at parasailing, jump on a jet ski, hop onto a banana boat, and enjoy some fun bumper rides that keep the excitement going all day long. If you are feeling adventurous, opt for a thrilling speedboat ride and keep your eyes peeled for some playful dolphins along the way.

Wind down with a relaxed evening at your own pace and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Scuba Diving & Island Adventure
activities:
Get ready for an absolutely incredible full day trip out to the stunning Grande Island, where adventure and natural beauty come together in the most spectacular way. Dive beneath the surface with a guided scuba diving session led by a professional instructor, and follow it up with an exciting snorkeling session to explore the vibrant underwater world at your own pace. Enjoy the boat transfer out to the open sea, take a refreshing swim in the crystal clear waters, and if the season is right, try your hand at some thrilling cliff jumping for that extra rush of adrenaline.

Head back to the hotel in the evening, rest up, and enjoy a satisfying dinner after a truly unforgettable day.

itinerary.title: Backwater Kayaking or Jungle Thrill
activities: Gear up for a thrilling day of jungle adventure as you take on an exciting lineup of activities including ATV rides through rugged terrain, intense paintball battles, challenging rock climbing, and heart pumping ziplining that sends you soaring through the treetops. It is the kind of day that leaves you buzzing with energy and covered in the best kind of tiredness. As the evening arrives, swap the jungle for the beach and spend your time unwinding at the laid back beach cafes or diving into the vibrant Goa nightlife at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a relaxed breakfast, if you are feeling up for one last adventure, head over to Ashwem or Palolem for an optional surfing lesson and ride the waves in true Goa style before wrapping up your trip. When you are ready, check out of the hotel and get comfortably transferred to the airport or railway station, heading home with a heart full of sun soaked, adventure packed, and thoroughly unforgettable Goa memories.

AllPackage.name: Goa Thrill & Water Sports Retreat
AllPackage.shortDescription: A 4-day Goa adventure packed with scuba diving, parasailing, kayaking, ATV rides, and enough adrenaline to keep your heart pumping from start to finish.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Silhouetted palm trees along Goa beach during vibrant sunset over calm sea horizon.

AllPackage.description: If you are looking for short but beautiful break, our Kashmir 2 Nights 3 Days tour package is perfect for you. We have kept the itinerary simple so you can actually enjoy the sights without feeliong rushed. You will get to stay in a traditional houseboat on Dal Lake and a relaxing Shikara ride, and visits to the beautiful Mughal Gardens, along with a full day out in Gulmarg where you can soak in open meadows, stunning alpine views, and even hop on a Gondola ride if you fancy it. Perfect for weekend travelers and couples who want a genuine Himalayan experience without stretching the trip too long, this package covers comfortable transfers, local sightseeing, and warm Kashmiri hospitality that makes every moment feel truly special.
exclusions: Personal expenses such as phone calls, laundry, beverages, etc.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
activities:
Upon arriving at Srinagar Airport or Railway Station, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred straight to your deluxe houseboat on the serene Dal Lake. As the sun begins to set, hop onto a Shikara and glide gently across the calm waters, soaking in the golden hues reflecting off the lake in the most breathtaking way.

Return to the houseboat for a delicious dinner and a truly unforgettable overnight stay right on the water.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Sightseeing & Gulmarg Excursion
activities:
Spend your morning exploring the breathtaking Mughal Gardens, wandering through the lush and beautifully manicured grounds of Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Cheshma Shahi at a relaxed pace. Head up to Shankaracharya Temple next, where the sweeping panoramic views of Srinagar spread out below you in the most stunning fashion. From there, drive out to the gorgeous Gulmarg and spend time strolling through the meadows, visiting the famous golf course, and enjoying an optional Gondola ride if you are up for some extra adventure.

Make your way back to Srinagar in the evening for a warm dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
activities:
Take your morning at a gentle pace, enjoying some last minute shopping or a peaceful stroll around the beautiful Dal Lake, letting the serene surroundings of Srinagar leave a lasting impression on your heart. When the time comes, check out of your accommodation and get comfortably transferred to Srinagar Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

And with that, your wonderful Kashmir adventure draws to a close, leaving you with a treasure trove of unforgettable memories that will stay close to your heart for years to come.

AllPackage.name: Kashmir with Houseboat Stay
AllPackage.shortDescription: Float across Dal Lake on a classic Shikara ride, spend your nights in a cozy houseboat, take a leisurely walk through the gorgeous Mughal Gardens, and soak in the breathtaking alpine meadows of Gulmarg on a short but soul-satisfying Kashmir escape.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Scenic Kashmir meadow with purple wildflowers, small stream, and wooden cottages under clear blue sky.

AllPackage.description: Our 5 Night 6 Days tour of Kerala tour takes you to the most beautiful place in the state. The journey starts in Munnar, where you will see green tea gardens and beautiful waterfalls, and the quiet presence of wildlife all around you, before the journey moves on to Thekkady for a walk through fragrant spice plantations and an exciting boat safari inside the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary. From there you drift gently through Alleppey's backwaters on a traditional houseboat, taking in the beauty of shimmering lagoons, green paddy fields, and the simple charm of village life along the water. The trip end in Cochin, leaving you with a heart full of fond memories of truly experiencing God's Own Country.
exclusions: Optional activities (cultural shows, elephant ride, etc.)
highlights: Spice gardens and Periyar Lake boating in Thekkady
Alleppey backwater cruise with houseboat stay
inclusions: Daily breakfast (all hotels) and all meals in houseboat
Spice plantation visit & Periyar boating tickets

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar
activities:
Upon arriving at Cochin Airport or Railway Station, you will be warmly welcomed and settled into a comfortable drive towards the stunning hill station of Munnar. The journey itself is an absolute pleasure, winding through cascading waterfalls, fragrant spice gardens, and lush tea plantations that make every mile of the drive genuinely breathtaking. Once you arrive in Munnar, check into your hotel and give yourself some time to settle in and breathe in the cool and refreshing mountain air. The evening is completely yours to enjoy at your own relaxed pace.

Enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
activities:
Head out for a wonderful day of exploration starting with the scenic Mattupetty Lake and Dam and the fun Echo Point, where the natural acoustics and stunning surroundings make for a genuinely enjoyable stop. Continue to the serene Kundala Lake and the beautifully maintained Blossom Garden before making your way to the remarkable Eravikulam National Park, home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr, where spotting these rare and fascinating creatures in their natural mountain habitat is a truly special and memorable experience. As you make your way through the day, the sweeping views of the sprawling tea plantations and scenic valleys that carpet the rolling hillsides in endless shades of green are simply impossible to take your eyes off.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady
activities:
After breakfast, head out on a scenic drive to Thekkady, where a full day of natural wonders awaits. Walk through lush spice plantations growing cardamom, cinnamon, pepper and coffee, breathing in the rich aromas all around you.

Spend some time out on the calm waters of Periyar Lake with a relaxing boat ride through the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary, then keep your eyes open as you explore the Periyar Tiger Reserve for a chance to spot some incredible wildlife. End the day with a comfortable overnight stay right in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey
activities:
Make your way to Alleppey and settle into your very own houseboat, ready for a day unlike any other. Drift slowly through the backwaters, lagoons, canals, and paddy fields while soaking in the peaceful charm of this beautiful region.

Along the way, catch glimpses of everyday village life, roadside temples, old churches, and the iconic snake boats that this place is so well known for. Sit back and enjoy freshly prepared seafood right on board before wrapping up the evening with a restful overnight stay on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Cochin
activities:
After a lovely breakfast, check out from the houseboat and begin your drive back to Cochin, carrying with you some truly memorable experiences from the backwaters.

If time is on your side, take a leisurely stroll around Fort Kochi, walk along the breezy Marine Drive, and browse through the lively local markets before wrapping up your Kerala journey.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cochin
activities:
After breakfast, gather your bags and head out for your transfer to Cochin Airport or Railway Station, marking the end of a wonderful journey through Kerala.

As you make your way home, you leave with a heart full of sweet memories and beautiful moments that this incredible land gifted you throughout the trip.

AllPackage.name: Kerala Nature & Adventure Prestige Trail
AllPackage.shortDescription: Explore the wonderful beauty of Kerala with our 5 Night 6 Days tour package that takes you through Munnar's rolling tea gardens, Thekkady's rich wildlife, and the unforgettable houseboat experience on Alleppey's serene backwaters, bringing together the very best of hills, waterways, and culture in one perfectly crafted trip.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Green farmland with coconut trees and scenic Western Ghats mountains under blue sky in Kerala.

AllPackage.description: Paradise Yatra's 5 day Kerala trip is all about slowing down and soaking in the views. If you are looking to escape the city noise and just breathe in some air, this tour package is perfect for you. we have picked some best and famous spots so you can experience the beautiful local vibe without any rush. We start with a beautiful drive to Munnar. You'll be surrounded by endless green tea gardens and mountain views that are honestly hard to put into words. where endless rolling tea estates and stunning viewpoints set the tone for everything that follows. From there you head to Thekkady, a place famous for its aromatic spice plantations and the wonderful Periyar Lake boating experience right inside the wildlife sanctuary. To wrap things up you'll spend time on a traditional houseboats in Alleppey. There is nothing quite like drifting through the backwaters, watching the coconut trees pass by, and eating authentic home cooked Kerala meals right on the boat. It is a complete Kerala holiday that fits perfectly for families, couples, and anyone who feels happiest when surrounded by nature.
highlights: Scenic drive through waterfalls & plantations (Cochin – Munnar)

itinerary.title: Cochin to Munnar
activities:
Upon arriving at Cochin Airport or Railway Station, you will be warmly picked up and treated to a truly scenic drive towards Munnar, winding through beautiful waterfalls, glistening streams, and lush plantations that make the journey feel like the holiday has already begun. Once you arrive in the charming hill town of Munnar, check into your hotel and give yourself some time to settle in and breathe in the fresh mountain air.

The evening is completely yours to enjoy at your own relaxed pace, followed by a peaceful overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing
activities:
Spend your day exploring some of Munnar's most beloved attractions, starting with the scenic Mattupetty Dam, the fun and fascinating Echo Point, the serene Kundala Lake, and the wonderfully informative Tea Museum that gives you a real insight into the world of tea making. Wander through the sprawling tea estates and spice plantations that carpet the rolling hillsides in the most stunning shades of green, a sight that is genuinely hard to take your eyes off.

Head back to your hotel in the evening and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady
activities:
Hit the road and make your way to the lush and vibrant town of Thekkady, checking into your hotel and settling in before heading out to explore. Spend time wandering through a fascinating spice plantation where the heady aromas of cardamom, cinnamon, pepper, and coffee create an experience that is truly one of a kind. As the day continues, hop onto a boat and glide across the beautiful Periyar Lake inside the renowned Periyar Tiger Reserve, keeping your eyes open for the incredible wildlife that calls this stunning sanctuary home.

Settle in for a relaxing overnight stay in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey
activities:
Hit the road and make your way to the enchanting Alleppey, where a deluxe houseboat will be waiting to welcome you aboard for one of the most unique and memorable experiences Kerala has to offer. Glide leisurely through the winding canals, past lush paddy fields and charming villages, soaking in the incredibly peaceful backwater scenery that unfolds around you at every turn. Treat yourself to delicious local Kerala meals prepared fresh onboard, adding an authentic and flavorful touch to an already magical experience.

Settle in and enjoy a truly special overnight stay on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a lovely breakfast on the houseboat, take a few quiet moments to soak in the serene backwater views one last time before checking out and beginning your journey home. You will then be comfortably transferred to Cochin Airport or Railway Station, heading back with a heart full of sweet and beautiful Kerala memories that will stay with you for a very long time.

AllPackage.name: Kerala Backwaters & Hills Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Our Kerala tour package 4N/5D takes you through Munnar's misty tea gardens, Thekkady's fragrant spice plantations and rich wildlife, and the gorgeous backwaters of Alleppey where a luxurious houseboat stay is waiting to make your trip truly unforgettable.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Traditional Kerala houseboat cruising through scenic backwaters surrounded by lush coconut palms.

AllPackage.description: This 5-day Pattaya and Bangkok package brings together adventure, culture, and entertainment in a way that never feels rushed. Pattaya kicks things off on a high note with the spectacular Alcazar Show and a thrilling Coral Island tour complete with speedboat rides and lazy hours on the beach. Bangkok then takes over with a guided temple tour through iconic landmarks like the Grand Palace and Wat Arun, an enchanting dinner cruise along the Chao Phraya River, and a final day full of laughter and wonder at Safari World and Marine Park. It is the kind of Thailand holiday that covers everything you could want and then some.
exclusions: Personal expenses such as tips, laundry, and shopping
Optional water sports at Coral Island
highlights: Dazzling Alcazar Cabaret Show in Pattaya
Bangkok city sightseeing with temples and Gems Gallery
Romantic Chao Phraya River Dinner Cruise
Wildlife encounters at Safari World & Marine Park

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bangkok – Transfer to Pattaya
activities: Touch down at Bangkok Airport where our representative will be right there to welcome you with a warm meet and greet. From there, hop into a private vehicle and enjoy a comfortable transfer to Pattaya. Once you arrive, check into your hotel and give yourself some time to settle in. The evening is completely free, so head out and explore the local surroundings at your own pace and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere Pattaya has to offer.

itinerary.title: Pattaya – Alcazar Show & Coral Island Tour
activities:
After a good breakfast at the hotel, get ready for an exciting day as you are picked up for the Coral Island tour. A thrilling speedboat ride takes you over to the beautiful Koh Larn, where you can try your hand at optional water sports like parasailing and snorkeling, or simply stretch out on the stunning white sandy beaches and soak up the sun at your own pace. Once you have had your fill of island life, head back to the hotel and freshen up before the evening.

As night falls, make your way to the famous Alcazar Cabaret Show, a dazzling and colorful performance that is genuinely entertaining. Return to the hotel afterwards for a relaxing overnight stay in Pattaya.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Bangkok – City Tour & River Cruise Dinner
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel and jump into your private vehicle for a comfortable transfer to Bangkok. Once you arrive, dive straight into the city's rich culture with visits to the stunning Golden Buddha Temple and the fascinating Mini Reclining Buddha Temple. Make a stop at Gems Gallery for some leisurely shopping before wrapping up your daytime exploration.

As the evening rolls in, board the elegant Chao Phraya Princess for a memorable dinner cruise along the river. Treat yourself to a delicious buffet dinner accompanied by live music and captivating cultural shows, all while taking in the breathtaking night views of Bangkok's glittering skyline. Afterwards, head to The Ecotel Hotel and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Bangkok – Safari World & Marine Park
activities:
After breakfast, get ready for an absolutely fun filled day as you head out for a full day excursion to Safari World. Start with a thrilling drive through Safari Park where lions, giraffes, zebras, and a whole host of other magnificent animals roam freely around you. Move on to Marine Park and enjoy a fantastic lineup of animal shows, including the crowd pleasing Dolphin Show, the entertaining Orangutan Show, and the action packed Spy War Stunt Show. Do not miss the chance to feed the giraffes up close, one of those simple experiences that genuinely puts a big smile on your face. A hearty buffet lunch served right inside the park keeps your energy going through the day.

Once the excitement winds down, head back to your Bangkok hotel and enjoy a well deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bangkok
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of The Ecotel Hotel and soak in those last few moments of your Thailand experience. Your private transfer will then take you to Bangkok Airport, where you board your flight home carrying a heart full of wonderful memories that will stay with you long after the trip is over.

AllPackage.name: Bangkok Pattaya Tropical Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Soak up the very best of Thailand on this 5-day Pattaya and Bangkok tour that keeps things exciting from start to finish. Spend a laid-back day at Coral Island, catch the dazzling Alcazar Show, wander through stunning temples, enjoy a romantic dinner cruise out on the water, and top it all off with an unforgettable day at Safari World and Marine Park where wildlife gets up close and personal.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Visitors exploring ornate temple stupas and colorful architecture at Wat Pho in Bangkok during a tropical Thailand escape.

AllPackage.name: Bali Elite Retreat
AllPackage.description:
This Bali 5 Nights 6 Days Tour Package is your chance to explore some of the most beautiful corners of the island at a pace that actually lets you enjoy it. Start your trip with exciting water sports and visit the beautiful Uluwatu. Then travel to the peaceful Ulun Danu Beratan Temple in Bedugul. After that, see the amazing volcano views in Kintamani, walk through the green rice terraces, and experience the culture of Ubud.

With a professional driver, comfortable travel, and a relaxed schedule, this Bali trip will be so enjoyable that you may not want to come back home.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Fall in love with the tropics through our Bali 5N/6D Tour Package, taking you through stunning temples, quiet beaches, cascading waterfalls, volcanic landscapes, and the breathtaking shores of Nusa Penida Island. It is the kind of trip that blends culture, adventure, and raw natural beauty in a way that genuinely stays with you long after you are back home..

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali
activities: Your Bali adventure kicks off with a pickup from Denpasar International Airport, where you will be taken straight to your hotel. Once you have checked in, the rest of the day is all yours to enjoy at your own pace. Settle in, unwind, and soak up the good vibes as you spend your first night in beautiful Bali.

itinerary.title: Bali Dolphin Dive & Water Sports + Uluwatu Temple
activities:
Kick off your day with some serious fun on the water as you enjoy thrilling banana boat rides, parasailing, and jet ski sessions that will leave you buzzing with excitement. Later, head over to the stunning Uluwatu Temple to take in its breathtaking clifftop views and catch a mesmerizing cultural dance show as the sun goes down. Round off your evening with a soothing spa treatment that melts away every bit of tiredness from the day.

Settle in for a relaxing overnight stay in Bali.

itinerary.title: Bedugul & Tanah Lot Tour
activities:
Start your day with a visit to the serene Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, beautifully perched on the edge of a lake and absolutely worth every moment spent there. Make a photo stop at the iconic Handara Gate, one of those spots that looks even better in person than in pictures. As the day winds down, head to Tanah Lot Temple and watch the sunset paint the sky in stunning colors right from the clifftop.

End the day on a high note and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Bali.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Tour (West Side)
activities:
Hop on a speedboat and make your way over to Nusa Penida for a day that is packed with some truly jaw dropping sights. Explore the dramatic cliffs of Kelingking Beach, marvel at the natural wonder of Angel's Billabong, walk along the stunning Broken Beach, and take in the crystal clear waters of Crystal Bay. Grab a delicious lunch at a laid back beachside restaurant and let the island vibes sink in.

Once you have had your fill of Nusa Penida, hop back on the speedboat and return to Bali for a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kintamani Volcano & Ubud Tour
activities:
Start your day by soaking in the natural beauty of Tegenungan Waterfall and then wander through the breathtaking Tegalalang Rice Terraces, where the lush green views are nothing short of stunning. Head over to a local coffee plantation for an interesting tour and treat yourself to a tasting of the famous Luwak coffee, an experience that is truly one of a kind. Wrap up your day by exploring the vibrant Ubud Art Market, where the local art, crafts, and cultural energy make it a joy to browse through.

Head back to your hotel and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay in Bali.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a leisurely breakfast at the hotel, it is time to say goodbye to beautiful Bali as you make your way to Denpasar Airport to catch your return flight home.

AllPackage.imageAlt: Traditional multi-tiered Balinese temple shrines at Pura Besakih surrounded by lush greenery and misty mountain views in Bali.

AllPackage.description: This Jaipur 2 Nights 3 Days Tour Package is a wonderful short trip for anyone who wants to truly feel the magic of the Pink City without needing a lot of time. Jaipur is a place that wraps you in history, culture, and color from the moment you arrive, and this trip takes you through some of its most beloved landmarks including Amber Fort, Jal Mahal, Jantar Mantar, City Palace, and Nahargarh Fort while also giving you a genuine taste of Rajasthani culture, live music, and a delicious dinner at the charming Chokhi Dhani. You will also get to visit the beautiful Birla Temple and Galta Ji Temple, and spend some enjoyable time browsing through the colorful stalls of Johri Bazaar and Bapu Bazaar for some memorable local shopping. Whether you are travelling with family, your partner, or simply treating yourself to a solo escape, this package is a fantastic way to experience Jaipur's timeless royal charm in just a few days.

AllPackage.name: Jaipur The Royal Adventure Trail
AllPackage.shortDescription: Soak in the royal charm of Rajasthan with this Jaipur 2N/3D Tour Package. Wander through Jaipur's magnificent forts, stunning palaces, ancient temples, and vibrant bustling bazaars before rounding off your trip with a truly unforgettable cultural evening at the iconic Chokhi Dhani.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Historic Rajput architecture with domes and arched corridors at City Palace in Jaipur, Rajasthan.

AllPackage.description:
Honestly? Bali might just be the best decision you ever make.
We're talking six nights, seven days, and a trip so good it'll ruin every other holiday for you in the best way possible. From the moment you land, you're not just a tourist ticking boxes. You're someone who's actually living Bali.
Spend your days out on the water, heart racing with every wave. Kick off your shoes and stroll through villages where time seems to slow down and the air smells like incense and frangipani. Stand at the edge of Kintamani and feel the sheer power of a volcano beneath your feet. Watch the sun dip behind Tanah Lot Temple while the ocean swirls around it trust us, no photo does it justice. And Nusa Penida? That turquoise water, those dramatic cliffs you'll be pinching yourself the whole time.
When the adventures wind down, you're not heading back to some forgettable hotel room. You're going back to your own private pool villa. A cold drink, warm water, and a sky full of stars, just for you.
Every morning starts with a proper breakfast. Every transfer is sorted. You won't spend a single second stressed about how to get from A to B because we've handled all of that so you don't have to.

This one's for the families making memories, the couples stealing time together, and the friends who've been saying we need a trip for way too long.
Bali is calling. It's time you answered.
exclusions: All expenses of personalised nature like phone calls, laundry, cool drinks etc.
Anything not mentioned in the “ Cost Includes”
highlights: Stay in a Luxury Private Pool Villa
inclusions: Transfer from Bali Airport to Hotel

itinerary.title: Arrival at Denpasar International Airport
activities:
Welcome to Bali, the Land of Natural Beauty! Step out of the customs area at Denpasar International Airport and you will be greeted warmly by our local representative who will take care of everything from there. Settle into a comfortable transfer to your hotel and get checked in without any fuss. The rest of the day is entirely yours to enjoy, whether you want to simply kick back and relax or head out and explore the nearby areas at your own pace.

Settle in and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Watersports Activity Tour
activities:
After breakfast, gear up for a thrilling Watersports Activity Tour that is guaranteed to get your heart racing. Head out and make the most of the exciting adventures on offer, including a fun banana boat ride, the exhilarating rush of parasailing high above the water, and the high speed excitement of a jet ski ride that leaves you buzzing with energy. Once you have had your fill of aquatic thrills, head back to the hotel and spend the rest of the evening unwinding at your own relaxed pace.

Settle in and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Tanah Lot Temple Tour
activities:
After breakfast, hop into your private transfer and head out for a wonderful half day tour to the iconic Tanah Lot Temple. Perched dramatically on a rocky formation along the beautiful coastline of Beraban Village, this temple is one of those places that genuinely takes your breath away the moment you set eyes on it. Stick around as the sun begins to dip towards the horizon and witness a truly spectacular sunset over the ocean, the kind of moment that stays with you long after you leave.

Head back to the hotel in the evening and enjoy a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Ubud & Kintamani Tour + Transfer to Private Pool Villa
activities:
After breakfast, jump into your private transfer and set off for a rich and rewarding full day tour through Ubud and Kintamani. Begin with a visit to Legong Batik where you can witness the beautiful art of traditional Batik making up close, then head over to Celuk Village, renowned for its stunning silver and gold craftsmanship. Continue to Mas Village, where the incredibly detailed wood carvings on display are a true testament to the skill and artistry of local craftsmen. Make your way to Kintamani Village next, where the sweeping views of Mount and Lake Batur are nothing short of spectacular. Round off your day with a fascinating visit to the Santi Agrowisata coffee plantation, where you can see traditional coffee making in action and sample some truly exceptional brews.

As the evening arrives, check into your beautiful private pool villa and settle in for a luxurious and relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Leisure Day at Private Villa
activities:
• Wake up at your own pace and enjoy a leisurely breakfast right at your villa, surrounded by the lush and tranquil Bali landscape. The entire day is yours to spend however your heart desires, whether that means lounging by your private pool with a good book, or stepping out to explore the nearby attractions and hidden gems at your own relaxed pace.

    Settle in and enjoy another blissful overnight stay at the villa.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Tour
activities:
After breakfast, get ready for an exciting full day adventure as you head out to the stunning Nusa Penida Island. Spend your day discovering the island's breathtaking beauty, from its dramatic cliffs and pristine beaches to the gorgeous scenic landscapes that make Nusa Penida one of Bali's most beloved destinations. Take your time soaking it all in before making your way back to Bali in the evening.

Return to your villa and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Bali
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, take your time saying goodbye to your beautiful villa and all the wonderful memories it holds. Meet your driver outside for a smooth and comfortable transfer to Denpasar International Airport, where you will be dropped off in plenty of time for your onward journey home, carrying with you a heart full of beautiful Bali memories that will last a lifetime.

AllPackage.name: Bali Royal Luxe Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Soak up everything Bali has to offer with our Bali Tour Package. Get your heart racing with exciting water sports, visit some of the island's most iconic temples, wander through the lush landscapes of Ubud and Kintamani, unwind in your very own private pool villa, and take in the raw natural beauty of Nusa Penida Island, all wrapped up in a smooth and stress-free 6 Nights / 7 Days journey.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Tanah Lot sea temple on rocky island with ocean waves and sunset sky in Bali, Indonesia.

AllPackage.description: Start your trip in Srinagar with a stay on a traditional houseboat and enjoy peaceful Shikara rides before wandering through the gorgeous Mughal-era gardens. Then feel the excitement of Gulmarg with its thrilling Gondola rides and stunning snow-covered slopes, before making your way to the lush green valleys of Pahalgam for a wonderfully serene retreat. It is a beautiful mix of sightseeing and relaxation, this package is specially designed for travellers who want to capture the true heart and soul of Kashmir's lakes, gardens, and mountains all within one unforgettable journey.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
activities:
Upon arriving at Srinagar Airport or Railway Station, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred straight to your deluxe houseboat, where the calm and beautiful surroundings of Dal Lake will instantly make you feel at ease. Settle in and then head out for a peaceful Shikara ride on the lake at Nehru Park, gliding gently across the water while taking in the stunning scenery all around you.

Return to the houseboat for a delicious dinner and a truly special overnight stay right on the lake.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Local Sightseeing
activities:
Spend the day immersing yourself in the timeless charm of Srinagar, starting with a visit to the breathtaking Mughal Gardens including Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Cheshma Shahi, each offering a unique blend of history and natural beauty. Make your way up to Shankaracharya Temple, where the sweeping views of Dal Lake below are truly hard to forget. Round off your day with a browse through a local handicrafts showroom, where beautiful carpets, shawls, and souvenirs make for wonderful keepsakes.

Head back to your hotel in Srinagar for a warm dinner and a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Excursion to Gulmarg
activities:
Set off on a scenic two hour drive to Gulmarg, a stunning destination fondly known as the Meadow of Flowers, sitting about 56 km from Srinagar. Once there, wander through the beautiful meadows, take a leisurely walk around the world's highest golf course, and if you are up for it, enjoy an optional Gondola ride that treats you to some truly jaw dropping views from above. After a wonderfully refreshing day out, make your way back to Srinagar in the evening.

Settle in for a satisfying dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities:
Take your morning at a relaxed pace, soaking in the last few moments of Srinagar by browsing through the local markets for some final shopping or simply enjoying the city's peaceful charm one last time. When the time comes, you will be comfortably transferred to the Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.

And with that, your wonderful Srinagar adventure comes to a warm and memorable close, leaving you with experiences and memories that will stay close to your heart for years to come.

AllPackage.name: Kashmir Royal Houseboat Experience
AllPackage.shortDescription: Our 3N/4D Kashmir Tour Package covers everything from Srinagar's charming houseboats and historic Mughal Gardens to the sweeping Gondola views of Gulmarg and the peaceful valleys and riverside beauty that make Pahalgam so truly special.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Shikara boats floating on Dal Lake with snow-capped Himalayan mountains and clear blue sky in Srinagar, Kashmir.

AllPackage.description: This Singapore Cruise Tour Package is put together to give you the most satisfying mix of big city sightseeing, world-class entertainment, and a genuinely luxurious cruise experience all in one trip. You will explore some of Singapore's most famous and loved attractions which including Merlion Park, Gardens by the Bay, Sentosa Island, the colorful lanes of Chinatown, and the streets of Little India, The most interesting part of this package is the luxury cruise stay, where you can do some adventure activities like rock climbing, zip lining, mini golf, waterslides, swimming pools, and live entertainment shows, all with delicious Jain food options available throughout. Bringing together Singapore's rich culture, modern wonders, and pure leisure, this package is a fantastic choice for families, couples, and groups who want a trip that truly has it all.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Singapore
activities:
Upon touching down at Singapore Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and transferred comfortably to your hotel for a smooth and hassle free check-in. Give yourself some time to settle in and recover from the journey before heading out for an optional evening cruise experience that offers a stunning first glimpse of Singapore's iconic skyline shimmering beautifully over the water.

Settle in and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Singapore City Tour & Night Safari
activities:
After breakfast, head out and dive straight into the vibrant heart of Singapore, starting with the iconic Merlion Park where the famous statue and stunning waterfront views make for a wonderful first stop. Stroll along the famous Orchard Road, make a wish at the impressive Fountain of Wealth, and then lose yourself in the colorful and culturally rich neighborhoods of Chinatown and Little India, each bursting with their own unique energy, aromas, and charm. As the evening arrives, head out for the famous Night Safari tour, a one of a kind experience that takes you up close with nocturnal wildlife in the most magical and immersive way imaginable.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Cruise Boarding
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel and get ready for an incredibly exciting shift in your accommodation as you check into your luxurious Singapore cruise and begin a whole new chapter of your trip. Once onboard, the fun never stops with a fantastic lineup of activities including a thrilling rope course, an exhilarating zip line, refreshing swimming pools, relaxing jacuzzi sessions, mini golf, and basketball, giving you plenty of ways to keep yourself entertained throughout the day. With all meals taken care of onboard, including Jain food options, you can focus entirely on having the time of your life.

Settle in and enjoy a memorable overnight stay on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Cruise Leisure Day
activities:
Spend the entire day at your own leisurely pace, soaking up everything the cruise has to offer, from the exciting onboard facilities and activities to the dazzling entertainment shows that keep the energy and atmosphere buzzing from morning to night. Whether you choose to unwind by the pool, catch a show, or simply find a quiet corner to watch the ocean drift by, the day is completely yours to enjoy however your heart desires.

Settle in for another wonderful overnight stay on the cruise.

itinerary.title: Gardens by the Bay
activities:
Welcome back to shore as you disembark from the cruise and get transferred comfortably to your hotel to freshen up and settle in. Head out to the stunning Gardens by the Bay, where the incredible Flower Dome, the breathtaking Cloud Forest, and the iconic Supertree Grove come together to create one of the most visually spectacular and unique attractions Singapore has to offer. Wander through each of these extraordinary spaces at your own relaxed pace and let the sheer beauty and creativity of it all leave you genuinely amazed.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Tour
activities:
After breakfast, make your way to Mount Faber and hop onto the scenic cable car for a breathtaking ride over to the vibrant island of Sentosa, where the stunning views from above set the tone for a fantastic day ahead. Spend your time at the fascinating Images of Singapore LIVE experience and then head over to the iconic Madame Tussauds Museum for some fun and memorable moments with remarkably lifelike figures. As the evening rolls in, find your spot on the beach and settle in for the spectacular Wings of Time show, a dazzling outdoor performance of light, water, and music that is genuinely hard to put into words.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and take a moment to soak in those last few precious memories of the beautiful and vibrant city of Singapore. You will then be comfortably transferred to Singapore Airport, where you board your return flight to India, carrying with you a heart full of wonderful and unforgettable memories from this truly incredible destination.

AllPackage.name: Singapore Cruise & City Elegance
AllPackage.shortDescription: Uncover the best of Asia with our Singapore Cruise Tour Package. Set sail on the Dream Cruise with Jain meals taken care of, then head out to explore Sentosa, Universal Studios, the Night Safari, the breathtaking Gardens by the Bay, and the iconic Sands Sky Park that tops it all off beautifully.

AllPackage.description: Leave the routine behind and find yourself completely drawn into the heart of Himachal Pradesh with this 4N/5D Shimla, Manali and Kasol package that brings adventure, culture, and relaxation together in a way that feels effortless and deeply rewarding. The journey starts in Manali, where snow dusted mountains and dense pine forests pull you in from the very first moment and make you feel like you have stepped straight into a dream, with visits to Hadimba Temple, Solang Valley, the Tibetan Monastery, and more keeping every day full and exciting before a breathtaking scenic drive through Kullu and Manikaran carries you into the wonderfully laid back and free spirited town of Kasol. Here you can wander through charming little villages, sit back at laid-back riverside cafes, and take in the kind of breathtaking valley views that have turned Kasol into a paradise for backpackers and wanderers from all over the world. The trip wraps up with peaceful landscapes, quiet soulful moments, and memories warm enough to remind you exactly why Himachal Pradesh never goes out of style for travelers who keep coming back for more.
