itinerary.title: Arrive in Shimla
activities:
Arrive in Shimla by road or train, and if you are coming by the charming Kalka to Shimla Railway, consider yourself in for a truly scenic and unforgettable ride through the hills before you even reach your destination. Check into your hotel, rest up, and freshen up before heading out to explore some of Shimla's most beloved spots, including the lively Mall Road, the open and breezy Ridge, the historic Christ Church, and the famous Scandal Point, each carrying its own unique charm and character.

Round off your first evening with a satisfying dinner at the cozy Café Simla Times or the popular Wake and Bake Café before settling in for a comfortable overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Kufri & Shimla Local
activities:
Head out to the charming hill resort of Kufri and spend a wonderful morning at Mahasu Peak, the Adventure Park, and enjoy a fun yak or horse ride that adds a playful and memorable touch to your day. Back in Shimla, hop onto the ropeway for a scenic ride up to the revered Jakhu Temple, where the sweeping views of the surrounding hills and town are absolutely worth the visit. Spend some time browsing through the lively Lakkar Bazaar for some unique wooden crafts and souvenirs, and then pay a peaceful visit to the Kali Bari Temple. If you are curious and have some extra time, the impressive Indian Institute of Advanced Studies is well worth a quick stop.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Shimla.

itinerary.title: Shimla - Kullu - Manali
activities:
Rise early and set off from Shimla, making your way towards Manali with some wonderful stops along the way. Pause at the serene Sundernagar Lake and the impressive Pandoh Dam before continuing to the sacred Vaishno Devi Temple for a meaningful and spiritually enriching visit. Stop at the lively Kullu Market and browse through the beautiful collection of woollens and shawls that make for perfect souvenirs to take back home.

Arrive in Manali by evening and take a refreshing stroll along the charming Mall Road, soaking in the cool mountain air and lively atmosphere before settling in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
activities:
Head out to the stunning Solang Valley and spend an action packed morning enjoying the ropeway, zipline, ATV rides, and some fun snow play that makes this place an absolute favourite for adventure lovers of all ages. Back in Manali, visit the ancient and beautifully serene Hadimba Temple, soak your tired muscles in the naturally warm waters of Vashisht Hot Water Springs, and then pay a quiet visit to the historic Manu Temple. As the evening rolls in, wander through the charming lanes of Old Manali and hop between some of its most beloved cafes, each with its own unique vibe and character.

Settle in for a cozy overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Rohtang / Atal Tunnel / Sissu (Optional Excursion)
activities:
Set off on a scenic drive through the impressive Atal Tunnel and emerge into the breathtaking Sissu, where stunning snow views, cascading waterfalls, and wonderfully peaceful landscapes make you want to stop at every turn and simply take it all in. If you are visiting during summer or fall and have secured the necessary permit, an optional trip to the iconic Rohtang Pass is absolutely worth considering for views that are nothing short of spectacular.

Head back to Manali by evening and spend your remaining time browsing through the local shops or simply unwinding at your own relaxed pace before settling in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Manali → Kasol
activities:
Hit the road and enjoy a scenic drive through the stunning Parvati Valley on your way to the laid back and charming town of Kasol. Check into your riverside stay or homestay and take a moment to soak in the incredibly peaceful surroundings before heading out to explore. Wander through the lively Kasol Market and pop into some of the beloved local cafes like Evergreen Café and Little Italy, where the food and atmosphere are genuinely worth lingering over. Lace up your shoes for a rewarding trek to the quaint Chalal village, and if you have some extra time, a visit to the sacred Manikaran Sahib Hot Springs is a deeply enriching experience that is well worth the detour.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: Rise early and begin your scenic return journey from Kasol, winding your way back through the beautiful landscapes of Bhuntar, Mandi, and Bilaspur, each offering their own unique charm and scenery that makes the drive back just as memorable as the journey up, giving you one last wonderful taste of the stunning Himachal Pradesh countryside before heading home.

AllPackage.name: Shimla Manali Kasol Adventure Triangle
AllPackage.shortDescription: Short Overview: Take in the very best of Himachal Pradesh over 7 wonderful days as you travel through Shimla, Manali, and Kasol. From dramatic mountain scenery and snowy adventures to quiet, peaceful moments by the riverside, this trip brings together nature, fun, and relaxation in all the right proportions.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Snow covered Himalayan mountains and rocky valley landscape near Shimla Manali with travelers exploring scenic winter terrain.

AllPackage.description: Think of waking up to the sound of a lion roaring far away in the Masai Mara. Picture thousands of pink flamingos covering the shores of Lake Nakuru. This isn't just a safari, its a deep dive into Kenya's most storied landscapes. Your journey begins with the quiet ripple of a boat across Lake Naivasha before moving into the rugged rhino sanctuaries of Nakuru. You will be staying in world-class luxury lodges and camps, setting out on private game drives, and dining under a sky full of stars in a way that feels almost surreal. Throw in scenic drives through breathtaking terrain, genuine cultural encounters with local communities, and the option of a spectacular hot-air balloon safari, and you have a trip that blends pure adventure with an unmatched level of comfort and luxury.
exclusions: Alcoholic beverages not listed in meals
highlights: Private boat safari on Lake Naivasha
Game drives in Lake Nakuru and Masai Mara
Stay at luxury safari lodges and camps
Candlelit bush dinners and sundowner drinks
Optional hot air balloon safari over the Mara
inclusions: Private airport transfers and inter-park travel
Professional safari guide and game drives

itinerary.title: Arrival in Nairobi – Transfer to Lake Naivasha
activities:
Upon touching down at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed and whisked away in a private vehicle for a scenic drive to your luxury lodge at the beautiful Lake Naivasha. Settle in before heading out for a private boat safari on the lake, where close encounters with hippos and a stunning variety of birdlife make for an unforgettable and truly magical experience. As the sun begins to dip towards the horizon, raise a glass of sundowner drinks by the lake and take in the golden evening views in the most relaxed and luxurious way imaginable.

Head back to the lodge for a beautifully prepared gourmet dinner that rounds off your first evening in Kenya in the most wonderful style.

itinerary.title: Lake Naivasha – Lake Nakuru National Park
activities:
After a leisurely breakfast at the lodge, hit the road and enjoy a breathtaking drive through the dramatic landscapes of the Great Rift Valley, where the sheer scale and beauty of the scenery around you is genuinely humbling. Once you arrive at Lake Nakuru National Park, set off on an exciting game drive and keep your eyes peeled for some of Africa's most iconic wildlife, including rhinos, flamingos painting the lake shores pink, lions, and elusive leopards that never fail to take your breath away when spotted.

As the day winds down, settle into your luxury lodge overlooking the stunning lake and enjoy a delicious dinner before drifting off to a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Lake Nakuru – Masai Mara Game Reserve
activities:
Rise early, fuel up with a good breakfast, and set off on a scenic drive to the world famous Masai Mara, one of Africa's most iconic and breathtaking wildlife destinations. Check into your luxury tented camp or lodge and give yourself a moment to settle in before heading out for an exhilarating afternoon game drive across the vast and stunning Masai Mara landscape, where the sheer abundance of wildlife around every corner will leave you completely in awe. As the sun begins to set over the golden savannah, raise a glass of sundowner drinks and soak in one of the most beautiful evening skies you will ever witness.

Cap off your extraordinary day with a truly magical private bush dinner under a canopy of stars, an experience that is as romantic and memorable as it gets.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Safari in Masai Mara
activities:
Start your morning in the most extraordinary way with an optional hot air balloon safari, drifting serenely above the vast Masai Mara as the sun rises and the wildlife stirs below, followed by a celebratory champagne breakfast that feels like a truly once in a lifetime experience. Head out for a full day game drive across the reserve, spending your time tracking the magnificent Big Five and soaking in the incredible diversity of wildlife that calls this stunning landscape home. Stop for a relaxed picnic lunch near the iconic Mara River, where the scenery and atmosphere make even a simple meal feel special.

As the evening arrives, unwind with sunset cocktails before treating yourself to a soothing spa session that melts away every bit of tiredness from the day. Round off your evening with a beautifully crafted three course gourmet dinner at the lodge that is every bit as memorable as the safari itself.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara – Nairobi – Departure
activities:
If time allows, rise early for one last game drive across the stunning Masai Mara, soaking in the incredible wildlife and breathtaking landscapes one final time before bidding farewell to this extraordinary destination. When you are ready, settle into a comfortable private road transfer or hop onto an optional flight back to Nairobi at your own preference.

You will then be dropped off at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your departure, heading home with a heart full of extraordinary African memories that will stay with you for a lifetime.

AllPackage.name: Kenya Private Safari Experience
AllPackage.shortDescription: Treat yourself to a truly luxurious safari experience spanning Naivasha, Nakuru, and the world-renowned Masai Mara, complete with exclusive private game drives and some of the finest lodge stays Africa has to offer.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Two giraffes crossing a dirt road beside a safari jeep during wildlife safari in Kenya.

AllPackage.description:
If you have been craving a few quiet days in the mountains, Dalhousie has a way of giving you exactly that. This trip is built around easy mornings, cool fresh air, and some of the most genuinely beautiful scenery the region has to offer, with day trips out to Khajjiar and Kalatop rounding things out nicely. You will find yourself walking through wide open meadows and under tall pine trees that make the whole place feel like it belongs in a different world. Khajjiar carries the nickname Mini Switzerland of India, and the moment you set eyes on those rolling green views, the name makes complete sense. The balance here is just right, a little sightseeing in Dalhousie, some easy exploration of the surrounding hills, and plenty of room in between to simply slow down and enjoy where you are.

This is a wonderful choice for couples, families, and friends who are not looking for anything too intense, just a short trip that leaves them feeling genuinely recharged.
exclusions: Entry tickets and adventure activities (zorbing, horse rides)
highlights: Scenic drives and peaceful mountain views
inclusions: Accommodation in hotel, homestay, or nature camp
Private vehicle or local transport for sightseeing
All sightseeing and transfers as per itinerary
Driver allowance, tolls, and parking charges

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dalhousie – Local Exploration
activities:
Arrive in Dalhousie by morning or noon, making your way via bus or train to Pathankot and then hopping into a taxi for the scenic final stretch to this charming colonial hill town. Check into your hotel or homestay and give yourself a moment to settle in before heading out to explore. Visit the peaceful Subhash Baoli, the historic St. John's Church, and the lively Gandhi Chowk Market, each offering their own unique slice of Dalhousie's character and charm. As the evening rolls in, take a leisurely walk along Garam Sadak or Mall Road and breathe in the fresh mountain air at your own relaxed pace.

Round off your first day with a satisfying dinner at a local favourite like Café Dalhousie or Old Sher-e-Punjab, and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Trip to Khajjiar & Kalatop
activities:
Set off on a scenic drive to the breathtaking Khajjiar, just 22 km away and about an hour from Dalhousie, where the lush green meadows and dense forest views welcome you with open arms. Spend your time enjoying horse riding and zorbing across the stunning meadows, and pay a peaceful visit to the Khajji Nag Temple before heading out for an optional forest trek or nature walk that lets you truly connect with the beautiful surroundings. Make your way to the Kalatop Wildlife Sanctuary, where the dense forests and incredible photo opportunities make it a nature lover's dream. If the timing works out, head up to Dainkund Peak for an optional sunset view that is absolutely worth staying for.

Head back to Dalhousie by evening and settle in for an overnight stay, or if you are feeling adventurous, spend the night camping in Khajjiar for a truly memorable nature experience.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Departure
activities:
After breakfast, start your morning with a gentle and refreshing stroll before heading out to visit the scenic Panchpula waterfalls and its surrounding memorials, followed by the beautiful Satdhara Falls, both of which make for a wonderfully peaceful last day of sightseeing. Grab a satisfying lunch or some tasty local snacks before checking out of your hotel and soaking in those last few precious moments of Dalhousie's charm.

Make your way to Pathankot for your train or bus departure, carrying with you a heart full of beautiful memories of Dalhousie's rolling hills, dense forests, and stunning meadows that will stay with you long after the trip is over.

AllPackage.name: Dalhousie Mini Switzerland Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: A laid-back journey through Dalhousie, Khajjiar, and Kalatop, where beautiful scenic views, refreshing forest walks, and a calm mountain atmosphere come together to make for the most satisfying short nature getaway.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Snow covered Himalayan peaks and pine forest hills in scenic Dalhousie, Himachal Pradesh.

AllPackage.description: Start your love story in the most beautiful place on earth with this 6-day Luxury Maldives Honeymoon Package that brings together romance, privacy, and pure indulgence from the very first moment. Think champagne welcomes, gorgeous overwater villas, and candlelit dinners beneath a sky full of stars. Spend a lazy afternoon on a private sandbank picnic, recharge together with a couples' spa session, and set sail on a dreamy sunset dolphin cruise. With seaplane transfers, gourmet dining, and handpicked experiences all taken care of, every single day is thoughtfully crafted around you and your partner. Whether you are unwinding in your villa or exploring the crystal clear turquoise lagoons, this trip promises memories just as breathtaking as the Maldives itself.
highlights: Private candle-lit dinner on the beach under the stars
Gourmet seafood BBQ dinner on the beach
Stargazing from your deck with a telescope + wine
inclusions: Daily breakfast & dinner (with romantic dinner setups included)
AllPackage.name: Maldives Grand Luxe Couple Retreat
AllPackage.shortDescription: Mark the beginning of your forever with a 6-day luxury Maldives honeymoon package featuring stunning overwater villas, scenic seaplane transfers, candlelit dinners by the ocean, blissful spa moments, and romantic island experiences that you and your partner will cherish for the rest of your lives.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Wooden walkway leading to overwater bungalows on turquoise lagoon in the Maldives.

AllPackage.description: Kerala is so much more than calm backwaters and it proves that beautifully on this 4-day adventure tour built entirely for people who love to push their limits. Forget temples and sightseeing because this trip is all about pure action across hills, open skies, rushing rivers, and dense forests, from mountain biking through Munnar's sprawling tea estates and paragliding over the stunning hills of Vagamon to scuba diving at Kovalam, surfing the waves at Varkala, jungle trekking in Wayanad, and rafting through the exciting waters of Thenmala. With certified instructors, top-notch safety gear, and the option to camp under a sky full of stars, this is hands down the ultimate Kerala experience for anyone who measures a great holiday by the number of times their heart races.
exclusions: Optional add-on activities (camping, ziplining, paintball, night safari)
highlights: Mountain biking ATV rides & forest trekking in Munnar/Wayanad
Tandem paragliding flights over Vagamon hills
Surfing & scuba diving at Varkala / Kovalam
Kayaking & bamboo rafting in Periyar / Wayanad rivers
inclusions: 3 nights stay in adventure lodges / eco-resorts (customizable)
All activity gear (helmets, harness, life jackets, boards)
Certified instructors & guides for all activities
Private cab transfers to adventure spots
First-aid and basic medical support at activity zones

itinerary.title: Hill Adventure – Munnar / Wayanad / Vagamon
activities: Get your adrenaline pumping with an exciting lineup of adventure activities set against the stunning backdrop of the hills. Pedal your way through lush tea estates and winding forest trails on a thrilling mountain biking ride, or test your nerve on the rocky cliffs with rock climbing and rappelling sessions led by certified and experienced guides. For those who love the outdoors, a forest hike or jungle trek is available in both day and night formats, each offering its own unique and unforgettable experience. Round it all off with a high energy ATV dirt track ride that is guaranteed to leave you grinning from ear to ear.

itinerary.title: Air Adventure – Vagamon / Varkala
activities:
Soar high above the rolling green meadows of Vagamon with a thrilling tandem paragliding flight, where the sweeping views of the misty hills and valleys stretching out below make for an experience you will not forget in a hurry. For those who want to take the adventure up a notch, an optional paramotoring flight over the stunning Varkala cliffs and sun soaked beaches is there for the taking, giving you a breathtaking bird's eye view of Kerala's gorgeous coastline.

As the day winds down, the evening is completely free for you to relax and soak it all in at the adventure camp or eco-resort, surrounded by nature and far away from the everyday rush.

itinerary.title: Water Adventure – Varkala / Kovalam / Thekkady
activities:
Dive headfirst into Kerala's incredible water world with a lineup of activities that caters to thrill seekers and first timers alike. Start with surfing lessons and practice sessions at the beautiful Varkala Beach, where the waves and the instructors will have you on your feet in no time. From there, explore the underwater world with a scuba diving session at Kovalam, a experience that is open even to non swimmers, making it accessible and exciting for everyone. Glide peacefully through winding rivers and backwaters on a kayaking trail that takes you deep into lush mangrove forests, offering a quieter but equally magical side of Kerala's natural beauty.

For those craving even more action, bamboo rafting or river tubing through the scenic landscapes of Periyar or Wayanad is an experience that blends fun with the raw beauty of the wilderness. And when the season is right, white water rafting at Thenmala delivers an adrenaline fueled ride through rushing rapids that is hard to match. Kerala's waters truly have something for everyone.

itinerary.title: Departure & Optional Adventure Add-ons
activities:
Kick off your final morning on a high note with a thrilling sunrise zipline ride that sends you soaring over the treetops as the first light of the day breaks across the horizon, or opt for a peaceful short trek through the misty surroundings if you prefer to ease into the morning at a gentler pace. For those who simply cannot bear to leave just yet, an optional camping extension in the lush forests of Wayanad or the serene wilderness of Gavi is available, giving you a little more time to breathe in the beauty of it all.

After a satisfying breakfast, it is time to pack up, say your goodbyes, and head home carrying a heart full of adventures and memories that will stay with you long after the trip is over.

AllPackage.name: Kerala Nature & Adventure Prestige Trail
AllPackage.shortDescription: A thrilling 4-day Kerala adventure tour packed with trekking, paragliding, surfing, scuba diving, white-water rafting, and wild jungle camping for everyone who lives for the outdoors.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Sunlit tea plantations with rolling green hills and tall trees in the scenic landscape of Kerala.

AllPackage.description: If you are looking for a gateway, this 5 day Kashmir trip is the perfect mix of chill vibes and actual adventure. You'll get to experience the total peace staying in a houseboat and taking lazy Shikara rides across Dal Lake, plus a stroll through those famous Mughal Gardens in Srinagar. Make your way through stunning scenic valleys to Pahalgam, where peaceful riverside walks and the quiet of dense pine forests create a sense of calm that is truly hard to put into words. Whether you are a honeymooner, travelling with family, or someone who loves a good adventure, this itinerary strikes the perfect balance of natural beauty, rich cultural heritage, and irresistible alpine charm.
exclusions: Personal expenses such as phone calls, laundry, beverages, etc.
Any item not mentioned under “Package Cost Includes”
inclusions: Accommodation in well-selected deluxe hotels on triple/quad sharing basis (3 persons in one room)
One night stay in a deluxe houseboat
All sightseeing tours and transfers by private tempo traveller
Daily breakfast and dinner at hotels
Running hot & cold water in all hotels
All toll taxes, parking charges, driver allowance, fuel charges, and state taxes

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jammu & Transfer to Srinagar
activities:
Upon arriving at Jammu Railway Station, our representative will be right there to meet you and get you settled into a comfortable drive towards Srinagar. Once you reach the beautiful Dal Lake, check into your charming traditional houseboat and take a moment to breathe in the serene surroundings. As the evening sets in, hop onto a Shikara for a lovely one hour ride along Nehru Park and Boulevard Road, where the calm waters and stunning views make for a truly peaceful experience.

Return to the houseboat for a warm dinner and a memorable overnight stay right on the lake.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Local Sightseeing
activities:
Spend your day discovering the timeless beauty of Srinagar, beginning with a leisurely visit to the magnificent Mughal Gardens, including Cheshma Shahi, Nishat Bagh, and Shalimar Bagh, each one a stunning blend of history and natural splendor. Make your way up to Shankaracharya Temple, where the panoramic views of Srinagar and Dal Lake spread out before you in the most breathtaking way. Round off your day with a visit to a local showroom where beautifully handcrafted Kashmiri carpets, shawls, and jewellery make for truly special keepsakes.

Head back to your hotel for a satisfying dinner and a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Excursion
activities:
Set off on a scenic drive to the breathtaking Gulmarg, lovingly known as the Meadow of Flowers, where the lush landscapes and crisp mountain air greet you the moment you arrive. Spend your time wandering through the beautiful meadows, taking a stroll around the world's highest 18 hole golf course, and soaking in the stunning ski slopes that make Gulmarg such a beloved destination. If you are feeling adventurous, hop onto the optional Gondola ride up to Kongdori or lace up your shoes for a rewarding trek to Khilanmarg.

As the day wraps up, make your way back to Srinagar for a warm dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Day trip
activities:
Hit the road and enjoy a scenic drive to Pahalgam, passing through the fragrant Pampore saffron fields, the ancient Avantipura ruins, and the bustling Anantnag town along the way, each adding its own unique charm to the journey. Once you arrive, take a leisurely riverside walk along the beautiful Lidder River, lose yourself in the lush pine forests, or browse through the local markets at your own relaxed pace.

When the day is done, head back to Srinagar for a satisfying dinner and a peaceful overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
activities: Take your morning slow and enjoy some free time for last minute shopping or a relaxed stroll through the streets, soaking in the beauty of Srinagar one last time. When you are ready, check out of the hotel and settle into a comfortable drive back to Jammu Railway Station for your onward journey home, carrying with you a heart full of beautiful Kashmir memories that will last a lifetime.

AllPackage.name: Kashmir Grand Himalayan Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Discover our Kashmir Tour Package 4N/5D featuring a cozy houseboat stay, peaceful Shikara rides, stunning Mughal Gardens, the thrilling slopes of Gulmarg, and the calm riverside beauty of Pahalgam for a truly pure alpine experience you will never forget.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Snow covered Himalayan mountains with pine trees and small wooden huts in a scenic valley of Kashmir.

AllPackage.description: Your 5 days trip to Krabi and Phuket is all about mixing island hopping with some actual downtime. We kick things off in Krabi with the famous Four Island Tour. Its exactly what you'd want getting out on the water, walking on soft sand, and seeing those bright blue waters you see in travel photos. Moving on to Phuket, a lively city tour takes you through vibrant beaches, stunning viewpoints, and the beautiful Wat Chalong temple. The absolute highlight of the whole trip though is the Phi Phi Island tour, where dramatic limestone cliffs, crystal clear waters, and powdery white sandy beaches come together to create views that honestly look straight out of a postcard. We've made sure the whole trip is easy for you, with good hotels, guide who actually know the area, and private cars to get you around. It takes all the stress out of planning so you can just enjoy the best spots in Krabi and Phuket.
exclusions: Personal expenses such as laundry, tips, or phone calls
highlights: Four Island Tour by long-tail boat in Krabi
Phuket city tour with beaches and Wat Chalong
Comfortable stays in Krabi and Phuket
inclusions: Four Island Tour with lunch (shared basis)
Phi Phi Island Tour with lunch (shared basis)
Soft drinks and fresh fruits during tours
All transfers and sightseeing on private basis

itinerary.title: Arrival at Phuket – Transfer to Krabi
activities: Touch down at Phuket Airport where our representative will be right there to welcome you with a warm and friendly greeting. From there, sit back and enjoy a smooth transfer to your resort in Krabi. Once you arrive and get checked in, the evening is completely yours to unwind and recharge however you please, soaking in the laid back and breezy Krabi atmosphere at your own pace.

itinerary.title: Krabi – Four Island Tour
activities:
After breakfast, make your way to the dock and board a long-tail boat for the wonderful Four Island Tour. The tour whisks you away to some truly stunning spots, starting with the scenic Koh Gai, also known as Chicken Island, followed by a leisurely walk along the magical sandbar stretching between Koh Tup and Koh Mawr. Spend some quality time at the gorgeous coconut lined beach of Koh Poda, where swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing in the sparkling turquoise waters feels like pure bliss. A delightful picnic lunch is included along the way to keep you refreshed and fueled throughout the day.

As the tour wraps up, head back to your hotel in Krabi and settle in for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Phuket – Enroute City Tour
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the resort and begin your transfer from Krabi to Phuket. Along the way, enjoy a delightful city tour that takes you through some of Phuket's most stunning beaches, including Patong, Karon, Kata, and Rawai. Make a stop at the scenic Karon Viewpoint where the sweeping views are absolutely worth capturing, and then spend some quiet and reflective time at the culturally rich Wat Chalong Temple.

Once you settle into your hotel, the evening is yours to enjoy freely at your own pace. Overnight stay at the hotel in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket – Phi Phi Island Tour
activities:
After breakfast, head to the dock and board a speedboat for a thrilling ride out to the magnificent Phi Phi Islands. Spend your day exploring the stunning Phi Phi Don and Phi Phi Ley, two islands that are every bit as beautiful as you imagined. Sink your toes into the soft white sandy beaches, take a refreshing dip in the crystal clear waters, and enjoy some snorkeling in one of the most gorgeous settings you will ever come across. A generous buffet lunch on the island keeps your energy up, and the free time afterwards gives you the perfect opportunity to wander around and truly soak in the tropical surroundings.

As the day winds down, jump back on the speedboat and return to your Phuket hotel for a well deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Phuket
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and take a moment to cherish those last few precious hours in beautiful Phuket. You will then be comfortably transferred to Phuket Airport, where you board your flight home with a heart full of beautiful and unforgettable memories that will stay with you for a very long time.

AllPackage.name: Krabi Phuket Island Explore
AllPackage.shortDescription: Spend 5 incredible days discovering Krabi and Phuket through exciting island tours, city sightseeing, and tropical adventures across two of the most breathtakingly beautiful destinations Thailand has to offer.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Traditional wooden houses and a longtail boat in a floating market village in Thailand.

AllPackage.description: Our 5 Nights 6 Days Uttarakhand Tour Package is a mixture of adventure, nature, and the scenic view of hills that feels just right from start to finish. The journey begins in Delhi and takes you straight to Jim Corbett National Park, where an exciting jungle safari, a visit to the peaceful Garjia Temple, and the calming stillness of the forest set the perfect tone for the days ahead. From there the trip moves to Nainital, lovingly known as the City of Lakes, where you can enjoy a relaxing boat ride on Naini Lake, take in the views from Snow View Point and Tiffin Top, explore the fascinating Eco Cave Garden, and wind down with easy evening strolls along Mall Road. The tour then carries you to Mussoorie, the Queen of Hills, where the fresh mountain air and beautiful scenery never disappoint. Spend your time visiting Kempty Falls, Company Garden, Gun Hill, and Lal Tibba, and enjoy some well-deserved leisure time at Mall Road before the journey wraps up. Whether you are travelling with family, your partner, or a group of friends, this Uttarakhand Tour Package brings the very best of the region together into one trip you will genuinely treasure.

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett
activities:
Upon arriving in Corbett, check into your hotel and give yourself some time to settle in and soak up the natural surroundings that make this destination so special. Head out to the revered Garjia Temple or the fascinating Corbett Museum, both of which offer a wonderful introduction to the rich cultural and natural heritage of this incredible region.

Head back to the hotel for a warm dinner and a peaceful overnight stay in Jim Corbett.

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett → Nainital (65 km / 2.5–3 hrs)
activities:
Rise early and kick off your morning with an optional Jeep Safari through the stunning Jim Corbett wilderness, where the thrill of spotting wildlife in their natural habitat makes for an absolutely unforgettable start to the day. Head back for a good breakfast before checking out and hitting the road towards the charming hill town of Nainital. Once you arrive and check into your hotel, spend your evening enjoying a relaxing boat ride on the beautiful Naini Lake, paying a peaceful visit to the revered Naina Devi Temple, and taking a leisurely stroll along the lively Mall Road.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital Local Sightseeing
activities:
Start your day with an exhilarating cable car ride up to the Snow View Point, where the panoramic Himalayan views are nothing short of breathtaking, and then make your way to the scenic Tiffin Top for another stunning perspective of the surrounding landscapes. Spend the rest of your morning exploring the fascinating Nainital Zoo, the impressive Raj Bhawan, and the unique Eco Cave Garden, each offering their own distinct and enjoyable experience. As the evening rolls in, head back to the beloved Mall Road and soak up the lively and charming atmosphere that makes Nainital so endearing.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Nainital.

itinerary.title: Nainital → Mussoorie (315 km / 8–9 hrs)
activities:
After an early breakfast, check out of the hotel and hit the road towards the charming queen of hill stations, Mussoorie. The drive takes you through the scenic Haridwar and Dehradun route, treating you to some lovely views along the way that make the journey genuinely enjoyable. Once you arrive in Mussoorie, check into your hotel, settle in comfortably, and breathe in the cool and refreshing mountain air.

Enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Mussoorie Local Sightseeing
activities:
Spend your day exploring some of Mussoorie's most beloved attractions, starting with the stunning Kempty Falls, the beautifully maintained Company Garden, and a scenic ropeway ride up to Gun Hill where the sweeping views of the Himalayas and the Doon Valley are genuinely breathtaking. Make your way to Lal Tibba, the highest point in Mussoorie, for yet another stunning perspective of the surrounding snow capped peaks. As the evening rolls in, head to the lively Mall Road and soak up the charming atmosphere, browsing through the local shops and enjoying the cool mountain breeze at your own relaxed pace.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Mussoorie.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and take a quiet moment to look back on all the wonderful experiences and beautiful places that made this trip so truly special. Head off for your onward journey, carrying with you a heart full of sweet and cherished memories that will stay close to your heart for a very long time.

AllPackage.name: Uttarakhand Divine Himalayan Journey
AllPackage.shortDescription: Head out on a wonderful 5N/6D trip through Uttarakhand taking in the best of Jim Corbett, Nainital, and Mussoorie. Enjoy thrilling jungle safaris, peaceful boating on Naini Lake, sweeping Himalayan views, and a lovely time exploring Mussoorie before heading back to Delhi with a heart full of beautiful memories.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Boating on Naini Lake surrounded by forested hills and scenic town views in Nainital, Uttarakhand.

AllPackage.description: Discover the raw beauty of Himachal Pradesh on this 5-day journey through Kasol, Tosh, and Kheerganga. We'll spend time chilling at riverside cafes in Kasol and wandering through the quiet lanes of Tosh. Its a kind of place where you can actually hear yourself think. Take on the rewarding 12 km Kheerganga trek and unwind in natural hot springs while taking in the stunning views of the Parvati Valley all around you. Whether you are a nature lover, a trekking enthusiast, or simply someone who is looking for the right mix of adventure and peace, this trip has everything you need.
exclusions: Bus fare to/from Delhi or Chandigarh
Entry fees, trek gear, and adventure activities
highlights: Visit Chalal Village via scenic forest hike
Discover Tosh Village and its mountain charm
Optional visit to Manikaran Sahib hot springs
Trek to Kheerganga (12 km) with stunning Parvati Valley views
Relax in natural hot springs at Kheerganga

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kasol
activities:
Arrive in Bhuntar by bus and hop onto a transfer that takes you straight to the laid back and charming town of Kasol. Check into your homestay, riverside cottage, or hostel and take a moment to soak in the incredibly peaceful surroundings. Spend your evening wandering through the Kasol Market, browsing through the local cafes, and strolling along the beautiful Parvati River at your own relaxed pace. Treat yourself to some delicious Israeli cuisine, a Kasol specialty that is genuinely worth trying, and end the night gathered around a cozy bonfire by the river under a sky full of stars.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol & Chalal Exploration
activities:
Start your morning with an invigorating hike to the quaint Chalal Village, winding your way through beautiful pine forest trails that feel wonderfully refreshing and peaceful. Once back, grab a leisurely lunch at one of the charming riverside cafes or spend some time browsing through the local market for unique finds. As the evening rolls in, enjoy a relaxed stroll or hop between some of Kasol's most beloved cafes, each with its own distinct vibe and character.

Settle in for an overnight stay in Kasol or transfer to Tosh if you are ready to move on to the next adventure.

itinerary.title: Kasol - Tosh
activities:
Make your way to Tosh via Barshaini, either by a short cab ride or on foot if you are up for a bit of a hike. Once you arrive, check in and take your time exploring the incredibly charming Tosh Village, where the stunning mountain views and laid back atmosphere make it hard to leave. If you are up for it, make a side visit to the sacred Manikaran Sahib, where the famous hot springs and community langar offer a deeply enriching experience. Round off your day with a walk to the waterfall viewpoint and settle into the iconic Pink Floyd Cafe just in time to catch the most breathtaking sunset views imaginable.

Settle in for a memorable overnight stay in Tosh.

itinerary.title: Tosh - Kheerganga Trek
activities:
Rise early and lace up for the rewarding Kheerganga trek, a beautiful 12 km journey that takes around 5 to 6 hours to complete. Choose your preferred route, either through Nakthan or Kalga, both of which offer their own stunning scenery and trail experience along the way. Once you reach the top, treat your tired muscles to a long and deeply satisfying soak in the natural hot springs, one of those simple experiences that feels absolutely magical after a full day of trekking. Stay a little longer to watch the sun dip below the horizon over the gorgeous Parvati Valley, painting the sky in the most beautiful colors.

Settle into your camp at Kheerganga and enjoy a cozy and well deserved overnight stay under the stars.

itinerary.title: Kheerganga - Kasol / Bhuntar - Departure
activities:
Pack up your camp and begin the trek back down to Barshaini before making your way to Kasol or Bhuntar to catch your bus back to Delhi or Chandigarh. The journey home gives you plenty of time to sit back, reflect, and relive all the incredible moments from the trip, from the pine forest trails and riverside cafes to the hot springs and starlit nights in the mountains.

And just like that, your Parvati Valley adventure comes to a close, leaving you refreshed, recharged, and carrying a heart full of beautiful mountain and forest memories.

AllPackage.name: Kasol Tosh Adventure Expedition
AllPackage.shortDescription: A 5-day Himachal escape that takes you through Kasol's peaceful riverside charm, the raw mountain village feel of Tosh, and the thrilling Kheerganga trek with its natural hot springs and sweeping valley views.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Parvati River flowing through pine forests with Himalayan mountains near Kasol in Himachal Pradesh.

AllPackage.description: This 5-day Krabi and Phuket tour brings together island hopping, city sightseeing, and laid-back tropical relaxation in one well-rounded package. Your journey kicks off in Krabi with the beloved Four Island Tour, where you get to discover stunning beaches and some of the most gorgeous turquoise waters you will ever see. From there, head over to Phuket for a city tour that covers lively beaches, scenic viewpoints, and the beautiful Wat Chalong temple. The real showstopper of the trip is the Phi Phi Island tour, where towering limestone cliffs, crystal clear waters, and powdery white sandy beaches come together to create views that honestly look like they belong on a postcard. With comfortable accommodations, knowledgeable guides, and private transfers throughout, this package makes it incredibly easy to experience the very best of both Krabi and Phuket without any hassle.
exclusions: Personal expenses (tips, laundry, mineral water, drinks, calls).
Optional island hopping tours (Phi Phi, James Bond Island, Railay Beach — extra cost).
Water sports & adventure activities (scuba diving, snorkeling, kayaking, zip-lining).
Any meals not mentioned in inclusions.
Local transfers not mentioned in itinerary.
highlights: Four Island Tour by long-tail boat in Krabi
Phuket city tour with beaches and Wat Chalong
Comfortable stays in Krabi and Phuket
inclusions: Phi Phi Island Tour with lunch
Soft drinks and fresh fruits during tours
All transfers and sightseeing on private basis

itinerary.title: Arrival at Phuket – Transfer to Krabi
activities: Touch down at Phuket Airport where our representative will be right there to welcome you with a warm and friendly greeting. From there, sit back and enjoy a comfortable transfer to your hotel in Krabi. Once you arrive, check in and give yourself some time to unwind and get comfortable. The evening is completely free, so relax at your own pace and let the laid back Krabi vibes wash over you.

itinerary.title: Krabi – Four Island Tour
activities:
After breakfast, make your way to the dock and board a long-tail boat for the much loved Four Island Tour. The tour takes you to some truly stunning spots, starting with Koh Gai, also known as Chicken Island, followed by a walk along the magical sandbar stretching between Koh Tup and Koh Mawr. Spend some relaxed time at the gorgeous coconut lined beach of Koh Poda, where swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing in the sparkling turquoise waters feels absolutely effortless. A lovely picnic lunch is included along the way to keep you refreshed and energized throughout the day.

As the tour wraps up, head back to your hotel in Krabi and settle in for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Phuket – Enroute City Tour
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel and begin your transfer from Krabi to Phuket. The journey is made even more enjoyable with a city tour along the way, taking you through some of Phuket's most beautiful beaches including Patong, Karon, Kata, and Rawai. Stop at the scenic Karon Viewpoint for some breathtaking views that are absolutely worth capturing, and then pay a visit to the serene and culturally rich Wat Chalong Temple.

Once you arrive and settle into your hotel, the evening is yours to enjoy freely at your own pace. Overnight stay at the hotel in Phuket.

itinerary.title: Phuket – Phi Phi Island Tour
activities:
After breakfast, head to the dock and jump aboard a speedboat for an exciting ride out to the stunning Phi Phi Islands. Spend your time exploring both Phi Phi Don and Phi Phi Ley, two islands that are as beautiful as they look in pictures. Sink your toes into the white sandy beaches, take a dip in the crystal clear waters, and enjoy some snorkeling in one of the most picturesque settings imaginable. A delicious buffet lunch on the island keeps you going, and the free time afterwards gives you a chance to wander around and soak in the tropical surroundings at your own pace.

As the day winds down, hop back on the speedboat and return to your Phuket hotel for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Phuket
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and take a moment to soak in your last few hours in beautiful Phuket. You will then be transferred to Phuket Airport, where you board your flight home carrying a heart full of wonderful and unforgettable memories.

AllPackage.name: Krabi Phuket Island Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Spend 5 wonderful days exploring Krabi and Phuket through island tours, city sightseeing, and tropical adventures across two of Thailand's most breathtakingly beautiful destinations.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Longtail boats lined along a sandy beach in Krabi with turquoise water and towering limestone cliffs on a tropical island in Thailand.

AllPackage.name: Himalayan Do Dham Blessings Journey
AllPackage.description:
Do Dham Yatra Package this journey starts from Haridwar

This Do Dham Yatra Package from Haridwar is deisgned for the travellers who want to visit the two most famous dhams , Kedarnath and Badrinath. The journey starts from Haridwar and ends in Haridwar, which is widely as the gateway of char dham yatra . Our 6 Nights and 7 Days Do Dham Yatra package is designed keeping in mind the needs of families, senior citizens, and travelers who are looking for a peaceful, comfortable, and budget-friendly spiritual experience.

Destinations will be covered in Do Dham Yatra Package

This tour takes you through some of the most significant religious and scenic destinations in Uttarakhand, including Haridwar, Guptkashi / Sitapur, Kedarnath, Badrinath, Mana Village, and Rudraprayag / Srinagar. Each of these places carries deep spiritual importance and treats you to stunning views of the Himalayas.

Kedarnath Temple is among the most revered shrines of Lord Shiva and holds a special place as one of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas in India.

Kedarnath Temple is one of the holiest shrines of Lord Shiva and a major part of the Char Dham circuit. Sitting at a high altitude surrounded by snow-covered peaks, Kedarnath creates a deeply spiritual atmosphere that is hard to put into words. Pilgrims can reach Kedarnath by trek (18 km), pony or palki, or helicopter, with the latter two available at an additional cost. Besides the main temple, many devotees also visit Bhairavnath Temple located just above Kedarnath, which is believed to watch over the shrine during the winter months.

Badrinath Temple Darshan - is dedicated to Lord Vishnu

This temple stands as one of the most important Vaishnavite pilgrimage places for followers of Vishnu in india. Before entering the temple, many pilgrim take a dip in Tapt Kund. Nearby places to visit include Mana Village which is known as the last village of india, along with Vyas Gufa, Bhim Pul, Saraswati River, Vasudhara Waterfall, and the Last Tea Shop of India. Each of these spots adds its own layer of spiritual and cultural richness to the yatra.

Haridwar Sightseeing and Ganga Aarti Experience

Haridwar is one of ties in India. It is known as an important starting point for Himalayan pilgrimages. Some of the main places to visit in Haridwar are Har Ki Pauri and Mansa Devi Temple. Attending the Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri in the evening is one of those experiences that stays with you, leaving a feeling of deep peace and quiet joy.

Accommodation in Economy and Guesthouses

Stay are avilable in comfortable economy hotels and guesthouses with quad sharing rooms that are clean, hygienic, and well maintained. Rooms have running hot and cold water, and if a listed hotel is unavailable, a similar property is arranged in its place. All accommodations are chosen keeping comfort, cleanliness, and closeness to the main pilgrimage routes in mind.

Meals Included in Do Dham Yatra Package

Daily breakfast and dinner are included throughout the tour. Only pure vegetarian meals are served, prepared in keeping with the religious practices followed during the Char Dham Yatra.

Transportation Facilities Included

All sightseeing and transfers are handled by tempo traveller with an experienced hill driver at the wheel. Fuel charges, toll tax, parking, and state taxes are all part of the package. Travel is kept safe and comfortable, and no night driving is done in hilly areas.

Best Time to Visit Kedarnath and Badrinath

The best time to plan your most spiritual trip for Do Dham Yatra is between May and October, depending on weather conditions. May and June tend to be especially popular as the weather is pleasant and the temples have just opened for the season.

Important Guidelines for Do Dham Yatra

Only vegetarian food is served during the tour. Alcohol and smoking are strictly not allowed. Air conditioning works only in the plains. Check-in time is 12:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM. Room upgrades are available at an extra cost. The tour may be affected by weather or road conditions, and no refund is provided for services missed due to natural calamities.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Set off on a soul-stirring 6 Nights / 7 Days Do Dham Yatra from Haridwar, visiting the sacred shrines of Kedarnath and Badrinath with comfortable stays, wholesome meals, sightseeing, and smooth transfers arranged throughout the trip so you can travel with a calm and undivided mind.
highlights: Start and end your yatra from Haridwar
Kedarnath trek by foot, pony, palki, or helicopter (extra cost).
inclusions: Accommodation in Pointed Mentioned Hotels on Quad sharing
Parking and all expenses of transport
All sightseeing Tours, transfers by Tempo traveller (except in the hills when the airconditioner will be switched off)
Running hot & cold water in all hotels
All Toll Taxes, Parking, driver Allowance, Fuel Charges, State Taxes
exclusions: All expenses of personalised nature like phone calls, laundry, cool drinks etc.,
Anything not mentioned in the “ Cost Includes”

itinerary.title: Day 01 – Arrival in Haridwar
activities:
As soon as you step off at Haridwar Railway Station, our representative will be there to greet you and escort you to your hotel. Once you have checked in and freshened up, head out to explore some of Haridwar's most beloved spots, including the iconic Har Ki Pauri and the revered Mansa Devi Temple. As evening rolls in, make your way back to Har Ki Pauri to witness the breathtaking Ganga Aarti, a moment that is truly hard to put into words.

After a fulfilling day of sightseeing, return to the hotel and settle in for a peaceful night stay.

itinerary.title: Day 02 – Journey from Haridwar to Guptkashi / Sitapur / Rampur (Approx.225 km / 8–9 hrs)
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel and hit the road towards Guptkashi or Sitapur. The drive treats you to some really beautiful scenery, with Moolgarh and Lambgaon adding a lovely touch to the journey along the way. Once you reach your destination, check into your hotel room, unwind, and give yourself some time to relax.

Enjoy a restful overnight stay at Guptkashi or Sitapur.

itinerary.title: Day 03 – Guptkashi to Kedarnath
activities:
Wake up around 4 AM and get moving towards Kedarnath without much delay. You will first hit the base point and from there, the 18 km journey to Kedarnath begins. Whether you choose to trek, ride a pony or palki, or take a helicopter (available at an extra cost), pick whatever suits your comfort and energy levels best. Once you arrive, check into your camp or hotel, freshen up, and then make your way to Kedarnath Temple for a deeply moving darshan experience. If you have some energy left, a visit to Bhairav Temple is well worth it too.

Settle in for a peaceful overnight stay at Kedarnath.

itinerary.title: Day 04 – Kedarnath to Guptkashi
activities:
After your morning darshan, lace up and begin making your way down the trek towards Guptkashi. Once you arrive, get your hotel check-in done, settle into your room, and allow yourself some well deserved rest after the long and fulfilling day.

Enjoy a comfortable overnight stay at Guptkashi.

itinerary.title: Day 05 – Guptkashi to Badrinath
activities:
After breakfast, get on the road and drive your way towards Badrinath. Upon arrival, check into the hotel and take a little time to settle in before heading out. Make your way to Tapta Kund for a holy bath, a wonderfully refreshing experience, and then walk over to Badrinath Temple to attend darshan and soak in the deeply spiritual atmosphere.

Once done, head back to the hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 06 – Badrinath to Rudraprayag / Srinagar
activities:
After breakfast, make your way to Mana Village and spend some quality time exploring its wonderful attractions, including Bhim Pul, Vyas Gufa, the Saraswati River, Vasudhara Waterfall, and the charming Last Tea Shop. It is a place that feels genuinely special, so take your time and enjoy every bit of it. Once you are done, hit the road and drive towards Rudraprayag or Srinagar.

On arrival, settle into your hotel room and enjoy a relaxing night stay.

itinerary.title: Day 07 – Departure
activities: After breakfast, it is time to bid farewell as you begin your return journey towards Haridwar Railway Station for your onward departure.

AllPackage.imageAlt: Pilgrims entering the colorful Badrinath Temple in the Himalayas during the sacred Do Dham blessings journey.

AllPackage.description: Experience the breathtaking charm of Kashmir with our 6 night 7 day tour package, designed to offer something truly special at every turn. From peaceful Shikara rides on Dal Lake in Srinagar to the wide open meadows of Sonmarg, the snow-dusted slopes of Gulmarg, and the absolutely breathtaking valleys of Pahalgam, this journey brings together nature, adventure, and relaxation in the most beautiful way. Along the way you will also get to wander through historic Mughal Gardens, visit ancient temples, soak in the warmth of the local culture, and settle in each night at cozy hotels or a charming traditional houseboat.
exclusions: Personal expenses such as phone calls, laundry, beverages, etc.
Any item not mentioned under “Package Cost Includes”
inclusions: Accommodation in well-selected deluxe hotels on triple/quad sharing basis (3 persons in one room)
One night stay in a deluxe houseboat
All sightseeing tours and transfers by private tempo traveller
Daily breakfast and dinner at hotels
Running hot & cold water in all hotels
All toll taxes, parking charges, driver allowance, fuel charges, and state taxes

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar
activities:
Upon arriving at Srinagar Airport or Railway Station, our representative will be right there to welcome you warmly and escort you to your hotel for a smooth check-in. Once you have settled in and freshened up, head out in the evening for a delightful Shikara ride on the serene Dal Lake, gliding gently past Nehru Park and Boulevard Road while the calm waters and beautiful surroundings create a truly magical atmosphere.

Head back to your hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Srinagar.

itinerary.title: Srinagar → Sonmarg → Srinagar
activities: Set off on a wonderful full day excursion to the breathtaking Sonmarg, lovingly known as the Meadow of Gold, located about 84 km from Srinagar. Spend your time soaking in the stunning beauty of Sindh Valley and make your way to the magnificent Thajiwas Glacier, either on foot or by pony ride, available at your own cost. Once you have taken it all in, begin your drive back to Srinagar and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Srinagar → Gulmarg
activities:
Set off on a scenic two hour drive to the stunning Gulmarg, sitting about 56 km from Srinagar, where the fresh mountain air and breathtaking landscapes welcome you with open arms. Spend your time taking in the gorgeous scenery, strolling around the world's highest golf course, and exploring the famous ski slopes that make Gulmarg such a special destination. If you are up for a little extra adventure, hop onto the optional Gondola ride up to Kongdori or set off on a rewarding trek to Khilanmarg for some truly unforgettable views.

Settle into your hotel in Gulmarg and enjoy a cozy and relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg → Pahalgam
activities:
Hit the road and enjoy a picturesque drive that takes you through the charming Pampore saffron fields, the historically rich Avantipura ruins, and the lively town of Anantnag, all of which make the journey feel genuinely interesting and rewarding. As you get closer to Pahalgam, the scenic ride along the beautiful Lidder River adds a wonderfully peaceful touch to the drive. Once you arrive, the evening is completely yours to enjoy at your own relaxed pace.

Settle into your hotel in Pahalgam and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Local Sightseeing
activities:
Head out for a wonderful excursion to some of Pahalgam's most stunning natural gems, including Chandanwadi, the breathtaking Betaab Valley, and the serene Aru Valley, all available at your own cost. Take your time wandering through the dense pine forests, breathing in the fresh mountain air, and soaking in the gorgeous river views that make this part of Kashmir feel truly magical.

Head back and settle into your hotel in Pahalgam for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam → Srinagar
activities:
Make your way back to Srinagar and spend a fulfilling day exploring the timeless Mughal Gardens, including the beautifully manicured Cheshma Shahi, Shalimar Bagh, and Nishat Bagh, each offering a unique and serene escape. Head up to Shankaracharya Temple for some sweeping views of the city and then browse through a local handicrafts showroom where exquisite carpets, shawls, and jewelry make for truly memorable souvenirs.

Settle into your charming Srinagar houseboat and enjoy a unique and peaceful overnight stay on the lake.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a lovely breakfast on the houseboat, soak in those last few precious moments of the serene Dal Lake before packing up and heading out. You will then be comfortably transferred to Jammu Railway Station or Srinagar Airport, where your journey home begins, carrying with you a heart full of sweet and beautiful Kashmir memories that will stay with you for a lifetime.

AllPackage.name: Heavenly Kashmir Signature Journey
AllPackage.shortDescription: Wander through breathtaking valleys, serene lakes, and stunning gardens with our Kashmir Tour Package 6N/7D, taking you all the way through Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam, and Sonmarg.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Snow covered meadow with cozy wooden cabin and pine trees under moonlight in scenic Kashmir valley.

AllPackage.description:
Rajasthan offers far more than just a glimpse of its forts and past, and this 3N/4D adventure tour showcases its many facets in a truly exhilarating manner. Every day is packed with adventure. Picture yourself careening over the dunes in Jaisalmer, zipping across the impressive Mehrangarh Fort, and then floating above Jaipur in a hot-air balloon. The Aravalli hills beckon for a trek, and afterward, it's off to Ranthambhore for those unforgettable tiger safaris, right in the middle of the wild.

Whether you are travelling as a group, with your partner, or completely on your own, this package is built for anyone who wants to skip the sightseeing and dive straight into the raw, untamed, and wildly exciting side of Rajasthan that most people never get to see.

Camel safari (sunrise or sunset ride)
Quad biking and sandboarding

AllPackage.name: Rajasthan Adventure Trail
AllPackage.shortDescription: Get your heart pumping with dune bashing, camel rides, ziplining, hot-air ballooning, trekking, and thrilling tiger safaris all packed into Rajasthan's most exciting 3N/4D adventure trip.

AllPackage.description: Discover the best of Dubai with our 5 Nights and 6 Days tour package. We've put together an itinerary that hits all the highlights, in the city's most iconic landmarks, from the awe-inspiring Burj Khalifa and the sprawling Dubai Mall to the heart-pumping Desert Safari, a relaxing Marina Dhow Cruise, the wonders of Abu Dhabi and Ferrari World, and a splashing good time at Aquaventure Waterpark. Our package wraps everything up neatly with comfortable hotel stays, daily breakfast, guided sightseeing tours, smooth transfers, and helpful Dubai E-Visa assistance every step of the way. Sit back and enjoy a truly seamless and memorable vacation put together with real care through our expertly crafted Dubai Tour Package.
exclusions: Optional Tours & Extra Meals not mentioned
Tourism Dirham Fee payable directly at the hotel
inclusions: Sightseeing Tours & Entry Tickets as per itinerary
Transfers in AC Vehicles with Driver

itinerary.title: Arrival at Dubai – Dhow Cruise at Marina
activities:
Touch down at Dubai International Airport where our representative will be right there to welcome you and take you comfortably to your hotel for check-in. Give yourself some time to relax and freshen up after the journey before heading out for the evening. As the sun goes down, board a beautiful Dhow Cruise at Dubai Marina and treat yourself to a delicious buffet dinner accompanied by lively entertainment, all while gliding past the glittering Dubai skyline.

Return to the hotel afterwards and settle in for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Half-Day Dubai City Tour & Evening Desert Safari
activities:
After breakfast, set off on a fascinating guided city tour that takes you through some of Dubai's most iconic spots, including the beautiful Jumeirah Mosque, the impressive Sheikh Zayed Road, the historic Dubai Creek, the legendary Burj Al Arab, and the stunning Jumeirah Beach. As the afternoon gives way to evening, head out into the golden desert for an unforgettable safari experience packed with thrilling dune bashing, camel rides, optional sandboarding, and a delicious BBQ dinner under the open sky. The live Tanoura and Belly dance performances add a magical cultural touch that rounds off the evening beautifully.

Head back to the hotel and enjoy a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi Grand Tour with Ferrari World
activities:
After breakfast, set off on an exciting day trip to Abu Dhabi, beginning with a visit to the breathtaking Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, one of the most magnificent structures you will ever lay eyes on, followed by a scenic drive past the impressive Presidential Palace. Head over to Ferrari World next and buckle up for an adrenaline fueled experience, including the legendary Formula Rossa, the world's fastest roller coaster that is guaranteed to leave you breathless.

As the day wraps up, make your way back to Dubai and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Dubai Mall & Burj Khalifa Experience
activities:
After breakfast, the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace as you explore Dubai's incredible shopping scene, from the charming traditional souks filled with gold and spices to the sprawling modern malls that have everything you could possibly wish for. As evening approaches, make your way to the iconic Burj Khalifa and head up to the breathtaking 124th floor observation deck, where the views of the city stretching out below are truly jaw dropping. Round off your evening with the mesmerizing Dubai Fountain Show at Dubai Mall, a spectacular display that is guaranteed to leave you in awe.

Head back to the hotel and enjoy a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Aquaventure Waterpark & The Lost Chambers Aquarium
activities:
After breakfast, get ready for an absolutely thrilling full day at the iconic Atlantis The Palm. Spend your time conquering the exhilarating rides and slides at Aquaventure Waterpark, where the fun and excitement never seem to run out no matter how long you stay. Take some time to explore the fascinating Lost Chambers Aquarium, where an incredible underwater world filled with exotic marine life will leave you genuinely amazed.

Head back to the hotel as the day winds down and enjoy a well deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Departure from Dubai
activities: After a leisurely breakfast, check out of the hotel and take a moment to soak in those last few beautiful memories of your Dubai experience. You will then be comfortably transferred to Dubai Airport, where you board your flight home carrying a heart full of wonderful and unforgettable memories from this truly remarkable city.

AllPackage.name: Dubai Luxury Desert & Skyline Escape
AllPackage.shortDescription: Experience the best of Dubai with our 5 Nights 6 Days getaway. We've lined up everything from a peaceful Dhow Cruise and a wild desert safari to the stunning Sheikh Zayed Mosque and Ferrari World over in Abu Dhabi. Add in the iconic Burj Khalifa, the buzzing Dubai Mall, the exciting Aquaventure Waterpark, and a whole host of unforgettable experiences, and you have yourself one incredible trip.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Dubai Marina skyline at night with illuminated skyscrapers and waterfront reflections in Dubai, UAE.

AllPackage.name: Alluring Andaman Island Adventure
AllPackage.description:
Four days in the Andaman Islands is not a long time, but this 3 Nights 4 Days tour covering Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Neil Island makes every day count. It moves at a pace that feels natural rather than rushed, touching on some of the best beaches, most meaningful historical sites, and most charming island destinations the archipelago has to offer.

The journey opens in Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman Islands, with a visit to Corbyn's Cove Beach, a relaxed and pretty spot by the sea where coconut trees lean over a coastline that invites you to slow down from the very first hour. The afternoon heads in a more reflective direction with a visit to the Cellular Jail, a place that sits at the heart of India's freedom struggle and gives you a lot to think about long after you have walked back out through its gates. The Light and Sound Show, a highlight of the evening, recounts the prison's past. It pays tribute to the sacrifices made by freedom fighters, and the presentation is both educational and deeply affecting.

A ferry transfer the next morning carries travelers across to Havelock Island, where Radhanagar Beach is waiting with its well-deserved reputation fully intact. The sand is soft and white, the water runs through every shade of turquoise imaginable, and the sunsets have a way of drawing a crowd of people who all go quiet at roughly the same moment. It consistently ranks among the best beaches in Asia, and spending time there makes it very easy to understand why.

Neil Island offers a more relaxed, less frenetic experience. Sitapur Beach, Bharatpur Beach, and Laxmanpur Beach each have their own unique appeal, but they all share the same serene beauty and natural allure that makes Neil Island a wonderful place to spend a day discovering.

Whether you are walking the shoreline, watching the light change over the water, or simply finding a comfortable spot to sit and do nothing in particular, the island rewards that kind of easy, unplanned exploration.

After island hopping through some of the Andamans' finest destinations, travelers make their way back to Port Blair for departure. Though brief, this tour offers a real glimpse into the unique allure of these islands. It's an excellent choice for couples, families, and anyone with a tight schedule who still wants a genuine taste of the Andaman Islands.

AllPackage.name: Blaze of Andaman & Nicobar Islands
AllPackage.description:
The Andaman Islands consistently manage to impress, and this 5-night, 6-day itinerary, encompassing Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Neil Island, is a prime example of a trip that exceeds its initial appeal.

It brings together the right mix of history, stunning coastline, and island adventure without overloading any single day, and the result is a trip that feels both full and relaxed in equal measure.

The journey opens in Port Blair, the capital city of the Andaman Islands, with a visit to Corbyn's Cove Beach, a calm and scenic spot by the water that does a fine job of easing you into island life. The day gains momentum with a trip to the Cellular Jail, a site steeped in the history of India's fight for independence, often leaving visitors contemplative. When night falls, the Light and Sound Show takes center stage, recounting the jail's past and honoring the freedom fighters. The presentation is both poignant and expertly done, making it a truly unforgettable experience.

The next day, a delightful ferry ride transports visitors to Havelock Island, a destination where the beaches truly deliver.

Radhanagar Beach is the undisputed highlight, with its brilliant white sand, richly coloured turquoise water, and the kind of sunsets that people photograph knowing the image will never quite capture the real thing. Elephant Beach adds an energetic and rewarding excursion to the mix, with snorkeling conditions that put you right among some of the most vibrant coral reefs the islands have to offer.

Neil Island's journey unfolds with a gentler, more relaxed pace.

Bharatpur Beach is ideal for a relaxed swim or a bit of gentle water activity in calm, clear conditions, while Laxmanpur Beach earns its reputation at the end of each day when the light drops low over the coastline and the whole scene turns into something that is very hard to look away from.

From the ferry connections between islands to the accommodation and the sightseeing arrangements, the practical side of this tour is handled smoothly throughout, which means travelers can focus entirely on enjoying where they are rather than managing the logistics of getting there. For couples, families, and honeymooners, this itinerary offers a personal, unhurried exploration of the Andaman Islands, ensuring every single day spent there is truly worthwhile.

AllPackage.name: Seaside Serenity Andaman Islands
AllPackage.description:
The Andaman Islands possess a quiet allure, and this four-night, five-day tour of Port Blair and Havelock Island is designed to let you savor it at your leisure. The schedule is well-planned, striking a balance between discovery, downtime, and the sheer pleasure of the breathtaking scenery, without cramming too much into each day.

The journey begins in Port Blair, the Andaman Islands' capital, with a visit to Corbyn's Cove Beach. This tranquil, picturesque beach provides a perfect, easygoing introduction to the islands. The afternoon takes a different turn, leading us to the Cellular Jail. This place, steeped in history, provides a profoundly personal view of India's struggle for freedom, far removed from a mere list of events.

The evening rounds off on a reflective note with the Light and Sound Show, which narrates the story of the jail and the people imprisoned within it through a presentation that is thoughtful, moving, and genuinely worth staying up for.

A ferry transfer the following morning brings travelers to Havelock Island, one of the most talked-about islands in the entire Andaman chain, and it earns that reputation without trying too hard. Radhanagar Beach is the centrepiece, a long and open sweep of soft white sand backed by trees, with water so clear and richly coloured that it takes a moment to feel real. The sunsets here have their own following, and once you have seen one, you will understand why.

The leisure day built into the Havelock portion of the trip is one of its strongest features. There is no fixed plan, just the island and the freedom to use the day however feels right. For those who want a bit of action, Elephant Beach is an easy and rewarding optional excursion, offering some of the best snorkeling conditions in the area with healthy coral reefs and plenty of marine life to discover just below the surface.

Kalapathar Beach offers a contrasting experience to the rest of Havelock, its unique black rocks setting a scene that feels more secluded and intimate than the island's more popular locations.

It is a great place to slow down, take a few photographs, and appreciate the kind of natural scenery that does not need any embellishment.

After a few days of island life, the return to Port Blair for the onward journey feels like a smooth and unhurried conclusion to a trip that delivered exactly what it set out to. Whether you are travelling as a couple, with family, or simply in need of a proper break somewhere genuinely beautiful, this tour gets the balance right.

The itinerary includes visits to Corbyn’s Cove Beach, the historic Cellular Jail with the Light & Sound Show, and a ferry transfer to Havelock Island to explore the famous Radhanagar Beach.

AllPackage.name: Gangtok Lachung Escape
AllPackage.description:
Certain trips leave an indelible mark, and this Gangtok and Lachung adventure is certainly one of those.

For those who love to get their heart racing, this destination delivers on every front. Hiking through mountain trails, trekking into high altitude terrain, white water rafting, paragliding over valleys, mountain biking, skiing, mountaineering, and kayaking are just some of the activities waiting for you here. Whether you prefer a gentle walk through nature or a full blown adrenaline rush, Gangtok and Lachung have something made just for you.

Browse through our detailed day by day itinerary to get a clear picture of everything this package has to offer and reach out to us today to get your booking started.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Explore the best of Gangtok and Lachung on this luxury tour package. Pristine lakes, lush green hills, ancient monasteries, and thrilling adventures like trekking, rafting, and paragliding await you.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Snow-covered Himalayan peaks in Sikkim with sharp ridges and clear blue sky over a high altitude landscape
