itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) to Gangtok (130 km / 4 hrs drive)
activities:
Your adventure begins the moment you step off the train or plane at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. Our representative will be right there to welcome you and from that point on everything is taken care of. Settle into the vehicle and enjoy the scenic drive to Gangtok as the road winds its way up through thick green forests and rolling hillsides. Every curve in the road reveals a little more of Sikkim's natural beauty and by the time you reach the city the excitement of what lies ahead will already be well and truly alive.

On arrival check into your hotel, freshen up, and give yourself a little time to relax and settle in. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace.

When you are ready head out to MG Marg, the heart and soul of Gangtok. This bustling and beloved street is one of the most vibrant places in the entire city. Stroll along at a leisurely pace and let the energy of the place wash over you. The street is lined with shops and stalls offering a wonderful variety of local treasures including intricately carved handicrafts, beautifully hand woven shawls, colourful woollen clothing, and rich Tibetan carpets that make for truly special souvenirs to bring back for friends and family.

As you walk through MG Marg take a moment to admire the elegant Victorian buildings that line the street, standing as graceful reminders of a history that stretches back centuries. The atmosphere here is warm, lively, and full of character and an evening stroll along this stretch is the perfect way to get your first real feel for Gangtok.

Return to your hotel when you are ready and settle into a comfortable and restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Tsomgo Lake Excursion and Baba Mandir)
activities:
Wake up early, sit down to a healthy breakfast, and get ready for a day that is going to give you stories worth telling for years. Today takes you to two of the most extraordinary and deeply meaningful destinations in all of Sikkim.

Your first stop is the legendary Tsomgo Lake, sitting at a remarkable elevation of 12,400 feet above sea level. This stunning glacial lake is one of those places that genuinely stops you in your tracks the moment it comes into view. The water is impossibly clear and the surrounding landscape of rocky slopes and mountain peaks creates a scene of raw and untouched natural beauty. A sacred temple built right along the shoreline adds a spiritual dimension to the visit and the lake is deeply revered by the local community as a holy site. Whether you come here for the beauty, the spirituality, or simply the experience of standing at such a height, Tsomgo Lake delivers on every level.

From there the journey continues up to Baba Harbhajan Mandir, perched at an elevation of 13,200 feet. This deeply moving memorial is dedicated to Harbhajan Singh, a brave Indian Army soldier who lost his life after drowning in a nearby stream. His story is one that has captured the hearts of countless Indians over the decades. Many believe that his spirit continues to serve and protect the nation even after his passing and for every member of the Indian Army a visit to this shrine is considered an absolute must. Spending time here is a quietly emotional and genuinely humbling experience.

Please note that Baba Harbhajan Mandir sits close to the Nathula Pass, one of the highest motorable roads in the world and a historic border crossing connecting Sikkim with China. An optional visit to Nathula Pass can be arranged on the same day at an additional cost and with a special permit for those who wish to experience this remarkable and historically significant landmark.

After a truly memorable day of exploration you will be driven back to Gangtok for a well deserved and restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Lachung (116 km / 6 hrs drive)
activities:
Start your morning with a filling breakfast before checking out of your Gangtok hotel and setting off toward one of the most charming and remote destinations on this entire journey. Today you head to Lachung, a beautiful mountain village sitting at an elevation of 8800 feet and nestled close to the Tibetan border. Surrounded by apple orchards and dramatic mountain scenery, Lachung has a quiet and unhurried character that feels worlds away from the bustle of city life. The village is also home to the historic Lachung Monastery, a 19th century Buddhist site that adds a deep sense of heritage and spiritual calm to this already extraordinary place.

The six hour drive to Lachung is anything but ordinary. The road takes you through some of the most stunning landscapes in North Sikkim and there are a couple of stops along the way that are not to be missed.

First up is Singhik Viewpoint, a truly spectacular vantage point that offers sweeping views of both Mount Kangchenjunga and Mount Siniolchu rising magnificently against the sky. After the noise and energy of the city this peaceful spot feels like a genuine escape and the views from here are the kind that make you stop talking and just stare.

A little further along the route the Seven Sisters Waterfall comes into view, one of the most pristine and captivating waterfalls in the entire region. The waterfall gets its name from the way it cascades down in seven distinct and beautiful stages, each one flowing gracefully into the next. It is a truly mesmerising sight and well worth taking a few extra minutes to appreciate.

Break for lunch at Namok where you can refuel properly before continuing the journey. A short and relaxing tea break at Chungthang gives you another chance to stretch your legs and take in the surroundings before the final stretch to Lachung.

On arrival check into your hotel, get comfortable, and sit down to a warm and delicious dinner served right there in the lodge. After a long and scenic day on the road a good meal and a restful overnight stay is exactly what you need.

itinerary.title: Lachung to Yumthang Valley to Gangtok (24 km / 1 hr drive)
activities:
Today is the day you visit one of the most extraordinary natural landscapes in all of northeastern India. Start your morning with a satisfying breakfast, check out of your Lachung hotel, and head out early toward Yumthang Valley, sitting at a breathtaking elevation of 11,800 feet above sea level.

From the moment Yumthang Valley comes into view it is impossible not to feel completely overwhelmed by its beauty. Known as the Valley of Flowers, this remarkable nature sanctuary is one of those rare places that genuinely looks like something out of a dream. A pristine river winds its way through the valley floor while natural hot springs bubble up quietly nearby. Rolling meadows stretch out across the landscape, dotted with grazing yaks, horses, and billy goats that wander freely in the open air. A stunning variety of Rhododendron trees burst into vivid colour during the blooming season and the entire valley is framed on all sides by the towering presence of the Himalayan mountains standing guard in every direction. Every single corner of this place is worth photographing and no matter how many pictures you take it still feels impossible to fully capture what you are seeing.

After spending meaningful time soaking in the valley, stop for lunch at one of the charming little cafes in the area before beginning the drive back toward Gangtok.

On the way back keep your eyes open for Bheema Waterfall and Twin Waterfalls, two absolutely stunning cascades tucked deep within the dense forest on either side of the road. Unlike many of the more commercialised sights on this trip these waterfalls feel raw, natural, and completely unspoiled. The sound of the rushing water echoing through the trees makes stopping here feel like a genuinely special moment.

Please note that an optional visit to Zero Point can be arranged on request at an additional cost. Perched at an incredible altitude of 15,300 feet, Zero Point is the last point of human habitation in this part of Sikkim and the landscape up there is as dramatic and otherworldly as you would expect from a place at the very edge of civilisation.

After a day packed with natural wonders make your way back to Gangtok, check into your hotel, and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) (130 km / 4 hrs drive)
activities: Your Sikkim adventure comes to a close today. Enjoy a final breakfast, check out, and our representative will drive you comfortably to NJP or Bagdogra Airport. Travel safe and we hope to see you again soon.

AllPackage.name: Sikkim Hills Explorer
AllPackage.description:
Some trips are good. Some trips are great. And then there are trips like this one that manage to be both at the same time. This 5 nights and 6 days journey through Gangtok and Darjeeling is the kind of experience that refreshes you completely, from the inside out, and leaves you wondering why you did not come sooner.

Gangtok is the kind of city that surprises you the moment you arrive. Perched at 1,650 meters, this delightful hill station boasts an impressive level of cleanliness, a well-ordered layout, and a genuine warmth that many Indian cities struggle to achieve. At 6700 feet, this iconic spot, known as the Queen of Hills, has been a magnet for visitors worldwide for more than a hundred years. The appeal is readily apparent.

The experience of rising before dawn to witness the sun's initial light caressing the snow-dusted Kangchenjunga peaks is a memory that lingers. Together Gangtok and Darjeeling make for one of the most complete and satisfying mountain journeys you can take in India. This tour brings the very best of both worlds to you in a single well crafted package that is designed to leave you refreshed, inspired, and already planning your return.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Explore the magic of Gangtok and Darjeeling on this 5 nights 6 days tour. Clean hill stations, stunning Kangchenjunga views, ancient monasteries, lush tea gardens, and the iconic Toy Train make this a truly unforgettable journey.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) to Gangtok (130 km / 4 hrs drive)
activities:
Your Gangtok and Darjeeling adventure begins the moment you step off the train or plane at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. Our representative will be right there waiting to greet you with a warm and friendly welcome before taking charge of everything from that point on. Sit back and enjoy the scenic four hour drive to Gangtok as the road climbs steadily through lush green forests and winding mountain roads, offering little glimpses of the beautiful world that awaits you over the coming days.

On arrival check into your hotel, freshen up, and allow yourself some time to rest and settle in after the journey. The remainder of the day is completely yours to enjoy at your own pace.

As the evening comes in make your way to MG Marg, the lively and beloved main street of Gangtok. This cheerful and vibrant stretch is the perfect place to get your first real feel for the city. Stroll at a leisurely pace, browse through the local shops, pick up a few souvenirs, grab a warm cup of tea, and soak in the energy and warmth of Gangtok as it comes alive in the evening light.

Return to your hotel when you are ready and settle in for a peaceful and comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Full Day Sightseeing
activities: After a satisfying breakfast, get ready to spend the day exploring Gangtok, the capital city of Sikkim sitting at an elevation of 1650 metres and serving as the main gateway into the state. Your first stop is Bakthang Waterfall, a wide and impressive cascade that is easily one of the most photogenic spots in the city. From there head to Tashi Viewpoint where the far reaching views of Kangchenjunga, the third highest mountain in the world, are absolutely stunning and on clear mornings the sunrise over the peaks is something truly special. Next visit Ganesh Tok, a charming hilltop Hindu temple that offers mesmerizing views of the surrounding landscape and a peaceful atmosphere that is hard to leave behind. Enchey Monastery comes next, a sacred site believed to be watched over by the protective deities Khangchendzonga and Yabdean, carrying a calm and spiritual energy throughout. Round off the morning with a cable car ride on the Ropeway for a breathtaking bird's eye view of the city and the hills stretching out below. The remaining attractions covered during the day include the Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom, Do Drul Chorten Stupa, Institute of Tibetology, Flower Show, and the beautiful Banjhakri Falls. After a wonderful day of sightseeing drive back to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Excursion to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir)
activities:
Today is going to be a day you will not forget in a hurry. Head out early at around 8 am toward Tsomgo Lake, a stunning high altitude lake sitting at 3750 metres and about a three hour drive from Gangtok. The lake is genuinely beautiful with snow covered peaks and wild flowers surrounding it on all sides, and it holds deep religious importance for both Hindus and Buddhists. In winter the whole lake freezes over while in spring colourful flowers bloom around its shores and bring it back to life. After spending time at the lake drive over to Baba Harbhajan Mandir, a heartfelt shrine dedicated to the brave Indian soldier Baba Harbhajan Singh who laid down his life while serving his nation with complete dedication. After the excursion head back to the hotel in Gangtok and spend the rest of the day however you please. Overnight stay at the hotel.

Note: Nathula Pass can also be visited on the same day at an additional cost. It is one of the highest motorable passes in the world and a historic trading route that once connected Tibet and India, making it a fascinating stop for history and adventure lovers alike.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Darjeeling (110 km / 4 hrs drive)
activities: After a good breakfast, pack your bags and get ready to head toward Darjeeling, one of the most beloved hill stations in the entire country. Once you arrive our representative will be right there to welcome you and help you settle into your hotel without any hassle. Spend the night comfortably at the hotel and let the cool mountain air of the Queen of Hills ease you into a peaceful rest.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling Full Day Sightseeing
activities: Today is going to be one of those days that stays with you for a very long time. Set your alarm for around 4 in the morning because the day begins with a drive up to Tiger Hill, the highest point in Darjeeling at 2042 metres. The reason for the early start becomes clear the moment you arrive and watch the sunrise slowly paint the snow covered peaks of Kangchenjunga in shades of gold and amber. It is one of the most breathtaking natural spectacles you will ever witness and well worth every minute of lost sleep. On the way back stop at Batasia Loop, a scenic spiral railway track set in a wonderfully picturesque location, and then visit Ghoom Monastery, one of the oldest and most revered monasteries in the region. Grab a warm and satisfying breakfast before continuing to the Japanese Temple, a beautifully crafted Buddhist pilgrimage site known for its elegant and traditional Japanese architecture that creates a wonderfully calm and meditative atmosphere. The rest of the day takes you through more of Darjeeling's finest attractions including Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, which is closed on Thursdays, the legendary Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, Tenzing Rock, the serene Peace Pagoda, and an outer view of the beautiful Chitrey Tea Garden. Round off the evening with a relaxed and enjoyable stroll along MG Road, the lively main street of Darjeeling where the town truly comes alive after dark.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) (88 km / 3 hrs drive)
activities: The last day of this wonderful journey has arrived. After a relaxed breakfast check out of the hotel and get ready to head toward NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport for the three hour drive back through the hills. As the mountains slowly fade behind you take a moment to think back on everything this trip brought your way. The golden sunrise over Kangchenjunga, the sacred lakes, the ancient monasteries, the laughter, the warmth, and all the little moments in between that made this journey truly special. It has been a pleasure travelling with you and we hope to see you again very soon on your next great adventure.

AllPackage.name: Char Dham Supreme Journey 2026
AllPackage.description:
Char Dham Yatra Package from Haridwar – 11 Nights 12 Days Tour 2026

This Char Dham Yatra Ex Haridwar package is put together for travelers who wish to complete all four sacred temples of Uttarakhand in a comfortable and well-organized manner. The journey starts from Haridwar and takes you through the four holy shrines of Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath. Accommodation, meals, transportation, and sightseeing are all taken care of so pilgrims can give their full attention to the spiritual experience without stressing over the day-to-day arrangements.

Char Dham Yatra Starts From Haridwar

This package cover Haridwar, Barkot, Yamunotri, Uttarkashi, Gangotri, Guptkashi, Kedarnath, Badrinath, and Rudraprayag / Srinagar

Yamunotri Temple Visit Details

Yamunotri is where the Char Dham journey begins, and it holds a special place as the abode of Maa Yamuna. You drive up to Jankichatti and from there walk a 6 km trek to reach the temple. For those who need it, pony and palki services are available at an extra cost. Before entering the temple for darshan, devotees take a holy dip at Jamunabai Kund, which is a meaningful ritual in itself.

Gangotri Temple Darshan Details

The second dham on this journey is Gangotri Temple, dedicated to Goddess Ganga. Along the way, you can stop at Gangnani to soak in the natural hot water spring, which many travelers find refreshing. The road passes through the lovely Harshil Valley with mountain scenery all around. After temple darshan of gangotri temple the group returns to Uttarkashi for an overnight stay.

Kedarnath Temple Visit Details

Kedarnath is one of the most revered temples of Lord Shiva and holds its place among the twelve Jyotirlingas. From the base point, the 18 km stretch to the temple can be covered on foot or through pony, palki, or helicopter services available at additional cost. Once darshan is done, many visitors also visit o Bhairavnath Temple.

Badrinath Temple Visit Details

Badrinath Temple, dedicated to Lloand most famous dham for Lord Vishnu, marks the fin. A holy dip at Tapta Kund before entering the temple is something most pilgrims look forward to. While here, nearby spots like Mana Village, Bhim Pul, Vyas Gufa, and the Saraswati River are worth visiting.

Haridwar Sightseeing and Return Journey

The tour starts and wraps up in Haridwar, which is rightly known as the gateway to Char Dham. On the way back, travelers may get the chance to visit Dhari Devi Temple, Devprayag, and Rishikesh depending on how the schedule works out.


Hotel Accommodation Details

itinerary.title: Day 01- Delhi to Haridwar ( 220 Kms / 5 Hrs)
activities:
Your journey begins with a pickup before 12 noon from the New Delhi Airport or Railway Station, where our driver will be right there to welcome you and help you get started on a smooth and comfortable ride to Haridwar. Once you arrive, check into the hotel, settle in, and give yourself some time to unwind after the travel.

Later in the evening, head over to Har ki Pauri to witness the magical Ganga Aarti, an experience that stays with you long after it ends. Return to the hotel for dinner and a restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 02- Haridwar to Barkot (205km 7/8 hrs)
activities:
After breakfast, hit the road from Haridwar and make your way towards Barkot. The drive is packed with wonderful stops along the way, including Shiv Mandir, the lively hill town of Mussoorie, and the gorgeous Kempty Falls. Do not miss Bhatta Falls and the famous Maggie Point in Mussoorie where the Maggie is honestly worth every bite, and take a leisurely stroll along Mall Road before continuing your journey.

Once you reach Barkot, check into your hotel, get comfortable in your room, and settle in for a peaceful night stay.

itinerary.title: Day 03- Barkot-Yumnotri- Barkot(45km+45km 2hrs Drive+2Hrs trek)
activities:
Wake up early, have a good breakfast, and drive to Jankichatti. The Yamunotri Temple is about 6 km from there, and you can either hop on a horse or trek your way up, with most people reaching the temple in around 2 hours. Once you arrive, take a refreshing bath at Jamunabai Kund, visit the temple, and seek the blessings of Maa Yamuna during darshan. Head back to Jankichatti by horse, palki, or on foot, whichever suits you best.

By evening, make your way back to your hotel in Barkot, rest up, and enjoy a warm dinner before settling in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 04- Barkot- Uttarkashi(85km /3hrs)
activities:
After breakfast, check out of the hotel and hit the road towards Uttarkashi. On the way, stop by Shivgufa Temple for a quick and peaceful visit before continuing your drive. Once you arrive in Uttarkashi, head straight to the Kashi Vishwanath Temple, fondly known as Chota Kashi Temple in Uttarakhand, and spend some time soaking in its spiritual warmth. Afterwards, check into your hotel, kick back, and relax.

Enjoy a satisfying dinner and a restful overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 05- Uttarkashi - Gangotri – Uttarkashi(97km 3 to 4hrs)
activities:
After breakfast, head out from Uttarkashi and make your way towards Gangotri Temple. During the drive, stop at Gangnani for a relaxing hot water bath before getting back on the road. As you continue, the stunning views of Harshil Valley and Lanka Bridge make the journey feel like a treat in itself. Once you reach Gangotri, visit the temple and take in the peaceful spiritual atmosphere.

After the temple visit, begin your drive back to Uttarkashi, where a warm dinner and a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel will be waiting for you.

itinerary.title: Day 06 Uttarkashi to Guptkashi (203km-8/9hrs)
activities: After breakfast, check out of the hotel and begin your drive towards Guptkashi. The route takes you past the charming spots of Moolgarh and Lambgoan, so keep your eyes open and enjoy the scenery along the way. By evening, arrive at your hotel in Guptkashi, check in comfortably, and settle in for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 07 Guptkashi to Kedarnath( 30km Drive/18km Trek)
activities:
Start your day bright and early and make your move towards Kedarnath Temple. The 18 km trek can be covered in whatever way works best for you, whether that is walking, riding a horse or palki, or taking a helicopter if you want to save time and energy (available at an extra cost). By afternoon, check into your hotel or camp in Kedarnath, freshen up, and then head to the temple for darshan of Lord Shiva, one of the 12 Jyotirlingas. Do not miss the Bhairav Temple either, sitting just above Kedarnath and absolutely worth the short climb.

Once you are done, make your way back down and drive to Guptkashi for a peaceful overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: Day 08 Kedarnath to Guptkashi
activities: In the morning, make your way down the trek to Gaurikund and then hit the road towards Guptkashi, where a satisfying dinner and a comfortable night stay will be ready to welcome you.

itinerary.title: Day 09 Guptkashi to Badrinath
activities: After breakfast, check out and begin your drive from Guptkashi towards Badrinath. Once you arrive, check into the hotel and settle in before heading over to Tapta Kund for a relaxing and spiritually refreshing dip in the warm waters.

itinerary.title: Day 10 Badrinath to Rudraprayag/Srinagar
activities:
After breakfast, head out to Mana Village, a place that is truly special and well known for its Last Tea Shop, Vasundara Falls, Bhim Pul, Vyas Gufa, and the serene Saraswati River. Take your time exploring each of these spots as they each carry their own unique charm. Once you are done with the sightseeing, continue your journey towards Rudraprayag and make sure to stop at Narsingh Temple in Joshimath along the way.

By evening, arrive at your hotel, check in, and settle down for a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 11 Rudraprayag to Haridwar
activities: After breakfast, pack up and begin your drive towards Haridwar. The journey itself is full of meaningful stops, including the Dhari Devi Temple, the sacred confluence at Devprayag, and the spiritually vibrant town of Rishikesh, all of which make the drive back a memorable one. Once you reach Haridwar, check into your hotel and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Day 12 Haridwar to Delhi
activities: After a relaxed breakfast, it is time to wrap up the trip as you get transferred to the Delhi Airport or Railway Station for your journey back home.

AllPackage.name: Sikkim Hills Explorer
AllPackage.description:
Gangtok, Sikkim's capital, sits at an elevation of 5,500 feet, a location that feels like a world unto itself. The city beckons with the breathtaking presence of Kangchenjunga, and it's clear why a trip to Sikkim feels incomplete without a proper exploration of Gangtok.

Further north, you'll find Lachung, a charming little town perched at approximately 9,600 feet. It's where two tributaries of the Teesta River converge. The scenery is nothing short of breathtaking, and Lachung acts as the entry point to Yumthang Valley, a place renowned for its stunning natural beauty.

For those who prefer to step away from the noise and energy of busier destinations, Pelling is exactly what you are looking for. Nestled in West Sikkim, this peaceful hill station is surrounded by sparkling lakes, dramatic waterfalls, and beautifully crafted monasteries. It is an offbeat gem that leaves every visitor quietly grateful they made the detour.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Discover Sikkim's finest on this 8 day journey. Visit vibrant Gangtok, the breathtaking Yumthang Valley via Lachung and the offbeat tranquil hill station of Pelling.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Snow-covered Himalayan peaks reflecting in a calm alpine lake during sunrise with dramatic clouds and icy shoreline in Sikkim.
exclusions: Personal expenses (heater, laundry, calls, tips, water, drinks, entry fees).
Extra sightseeing or additional vehicle usage.
Costs due to landslides, road blocks, or political disturbances (payable on the spot).

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) to Gangtok (130 km / 4 hrs drive)
activities:
Your journey into the heart of the Himalayas begins the moment you arrive at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. Our representative will be right there to greet you with a warm welcome and take care of everything from the very first moment. From there you will settle in for a scenic four hour drive to Gangtok, beautifully perched at an elevation of 1437 metres above sea level. As the city comes into view after a winding mountain drive, you will already sense that something special awaits you here.

On arrival check into your hotel and give yourself some time to freshen up and unwind. The journey has been long and a little rest goes a long way before the real adventure begins.

As the evening rolls in head out for a gentle stroll along MG Marg, the vibrant main street of Gangtok. This lively stretch is where the city truly comes alive with local shops, cosy cafes, cheerful crowds, and the unmistakable energy of a mountain town that loves to welcome its guests. It is the perfect introduction to Gangtok and a wonderful way to ease yourself into this beautiful destination.

Return to your hotel and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok Sightseeing (Full Day)
activities:
Wake up to a delicious breakfast and get ready for a day that will show you exactly why Gangtok is one of the most loved destinations in the entire northeastern Himalayas. Today is all about the city and its remarkable attractions.

Your first stop is Ganesh Tok, a deeply revered temple that has been a place of faith and devotion for the local community for generations. Beyond its spiritual significance the temple offers one of the finest views of Kangchenjunga, the third highest mountain in the world, rising magnificently on the horizon. On a clear day this view alone is worth the entire trip.

Next head over to Banjhakri Waterfall, a stunning and lively spot that is a favourite among locals for a reason. The waterfall tumbles down beautifully into its surroundings and the green landscape around it makes for a wonderfully refreshing stop.

A visit to the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology offers a fascinating look into the world of Tibetan culture, Buddhist philosophy, and stunning traditional architecture. It is the kind of place that makes you slow down and appreciate the depth of a civilization that has thrived in these mountains for centuries.

After that experience a completely different kind of thrill on the Gangtok Ropeway. Gliding above the city and the surrounding hills the ropeway offers sweeping and uninterrupted views of the mountain landscape that are simply hard to beat.

The rest of the day takes you through more of Gangtok's finest attractions. The grand Do Drul Chorten Stupa encircled by 108 prayer wheels carries a powerful spiritual presence. The roaring Bakthang Waterfall is a spectacular sight that never fails to impress. Tashi Viewpoint offers yet another breathtaking panorama of the Himalayan range. The ancient Enchey Monastery welcomes you with its calm and centuries old energy. The Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom is the perfect place to admire and take home the finest local craftsmanship. And if you are visiting during the blooming season the Flower Show is a colourful and joyful celebration of Sikkim's incredible natural diversity.

As evening approaches our representative will drive you back to your hotel for a well deserved and comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Excursion to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir)
activities: Begin your day on the earlier side, around 8 am, setting out for the stunning Tsomgo Lake sitting at 12,400 ft/3750 m, roughly a 3 hour drive away, along with a visit to the well regarded Baba Harbhajan Mandir at 13,200 ft/4000 m. Stop along the way for a quick breakfast before continuing on the scenic mountainous route, which is a pleasant drive in itself. The lake, perched at its considerable height, carries a quiet, almost sacred beauty that locals have revered for generations. In winter it takes on an almost otherworldly appearance as snow wraps around it completely, while spring brings it back to life with colourful flowers filling the surroundings. Baba Harbhajan Mandir holds a special place in Sikkim, built in honour of Baba Harbhajan Singh, a courageous Indian soldier who lost his life in severely harsh weather while carrying supplies to a remote outpost. After the excursion, our representative will escort you back to Gangtok for a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel. For those interested, the Nathula Pass tour is available on the same day at an additional cost. Standing at 14,140 feet, Nathula Pass is one of India's most famous motorable mountain passes and once served as a significant trade route connecting India and Tibet.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Lachung (116 km / 6 hrs drive)
activities:
Start your morning with a hearty breakfast before setting off on one of the most scenic drives of the entire trip. Today you leave Gangtok behind and make your way to Lachung, a charming little village nestled deep in the mountains of North Sikkim and surrounded on all sides by towering snow capped peaks.

Lachung is the kind of place that feels like it belongs in a painting. It is well known for its orchards of apple, peach, and apricot trees that dot the hillsides in beautiful colour during the right season. Cascading waterfalls tumble down the surrounding slopes and clear mountain streams weave their way through the village. The Lachung Chu river flows right through the heart of the settlement, quietly dividing it into two distinct halves and giving the village a character that is entirely its own.

The drive up is filled with wonderful stops along the way. At Singhik Viewpoint pull over and take in the commanding views of Mount Siniolchu, one of the most beautiful peaks in the Sikkim Himalayas. A little further along the road the Seven Sister Waterfall comes into view, a breathtaking cascade that is one of the most photographed sights on this route. Take a lunch break at Namok where you can refuel and enjoy the mountain surroundings before continuing the journey. A relaxing tea break at Chungthang gives you another chance to stretch your legs and soak in the scenery before the final stretch to Lachung.

On arrival check into your hotel, freshen up, and let yourself unwind after the long but deeply rewarding drive. The evening is yours to enjoy at your own pace. If you feel like stepping out, the local handicraft centre is a wonderful place to browse and pick up beautifully woven rugs and blankets that make for truly meaningful souvenirs. The Lachung Gompa, a historic monastery built in 1880, is also well worth a quiet visit as the evening light settles over the village.

Return to your hotel for a delicious dinner and a peaceful overnight stay in the cool mountain air of Lachung.

itinerary.title: Lachung to Yumthang Valley (24 km / 1 hr drive) to Lachung to Gangtok
activities:
Rise early this morning because the earlier you set off the better. Yumthang Valley rewards those who arrive with fresh eyes and the soft light of the early hours makes everything look even more magical than it already is.

The drive from Lachung takes just about an hour but the moment Yumthang Valley opens up before you, every minute of the journey feels completely worth it. Sitting at an elevation of 11,800 feet, this extraordinary valley is popularly known as the Valley of Flowers and it lives up to that name in every possible way. Sweeping stretches of greenery are dotted with a stunning variety of wildflowers and trees in full bloom, creating a landscape so vivid and alive that it almost does not feel real. A gentle river winds its way through the valley floor while wide grassy plains stretch out on either side. And if you are lucky you will spot horses, yaks, and goats grazing peacefully in the open, adding a wonderfully natural and unhurried charm to the whole scene. Every corner of this valley is a photograph waiting to be taken.

Spend as much time here as you need before heading back to Lachung for a satisfying lunch break.

The drive back to Gangtok is just as rewarding as the journey up. Along the way you will pass the Twin Waterfalls and Bheema Waterfalls, two spectacular sights that make for a beautiful end to a truly unforgettable day.

Arrive back in Gangtok and check into your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

Please note that a visit to Zero Point can also be arranged on the same day at an additional cost for those who want to push the adventure a little further.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Pelling (120 km / 5.5 hrs drive) via Namchi Char Dham and Samdruptse Statue
activities:
After a satisfying breakfast, check out and begin your journey toward Pelling, a picturesque little town nestled among pine forests in West Sikkim. But today the journey is far more than just a drive from one destination to another. The route takes you through some of the most spiritually significant and visually stunning stops in all of Sikkim.

As you wind through fragrant tea gardens, open mountain landscapes, and sweeping valley views, your first major stop will be Namchi, a town whose very name means top of the sky and which lives up to that description with commanding views of the surrounding mountains and valleys stretching out below.

Here you will visit the sacred Namchi Char Dham, a remarkable pilgrimage site that is home to a magnificent 108 feet tall statue of Lord Shiva along with faithful replicas of all 12 Jyotirlingas. The scale and spiritual energy of this place is truly humbling and it is the kind of site that leaves a deep impression regardless of your faith or background.

From Namchi head to Samdruptse Hill, known locally as the wish fulfilling hill, where you will stand before the world's largest statue of Guru Padmasambhava, the beloved patron saint of Sikkim. Rising to an incredible 118 feet, this golden statue presides over the landscape with a quiet and powerful grace that is unlike anything else you will encounter on this trip.

After these extraordinary stops continue the drive toward Pelling. As the town comes into view the iconic silhouette of Kangchenjunga dominates the horizon, reminding you once again of just how close you are to some of the greatest peaks on earth. Pelling is also home to several ancient monasteries that carry centuries of Buddhist heritage within their walls.

Check into your hotel on arrival and spend the rest of the evening completely at leisure. Sit back, breathe in the pine scented air, and let the beauty of your surroundings settle around you as you rest for the night.

itinerary.title: Pelling Sightseeing
activities:
After a delicious breakfast, step out into the crisp mountain air and get ready to spend a full day discovering the many wonderful sides of Pelling. This town has a quiet and unhurried charm about it and today you will get to experience it up close.

Begin your morning at Kanchenjunga Waterfalls, a truly refreshing start to the day. The sight and sound of the water tumbling powerfully down into the lush green surroundings instantly clears your head and fills you with energy. It is one of those natural spots that just makes you feel good to be alive.

From there make your way to Sewaro Rock Garden, a beautifully maintained space where fountains, flowers, and carefully arranged greenery come together to create a peaceful and visually delightful environment. It is a lovely place to slow down and simply enjoy the beauty around you.

Next on the list is Darap Valley, a scenic and serene retreat that showcases the gentler and more intimate side of Sikkim's natural landscape. The fresh air here is wonderfully clean and the views across the valley are quietly stunning. Take your time, breathe it all in, and let the surroundings do their work.

After a relaxed lunch break the afternoon sightseeing continues with a visit to Pema Yangtse Monastery, one of the oldest and most important monasteries in Sikkim. Perched on a hilltop with sweeping views all around it, the monastery carries a deep sense of history and spiritual calm that makes it one of the most memorable stops of the entire trip.

Head next to the Helipad Ground which offers wide open and unobstructed views of the Himalayan peaks that frame Pelling so beautifully. It is a great spot to pause and appreciate just how extraordinary your surroundings truly are.

Rimbi Waterfalls comes next, a charming and picturesque cascade tucked within the forested hillside that adds yet another layer of natural beauty to an already stunning day.

The sacred Khecheopalri Lake is one of the most spiritually significant stops on today's itinerary. Revered by both Buddhists and Hindus, this tranquil and pristine lake sits within a forest that feels almost enchanted. The silence here is profound and the sense of peace you feel standing beside it is something you will carry with you long after you leave.

Round off the day at the Rabdentse Ruins, the remains of the ancient capital of the former Kingdom of Sikkim. Walking through these historic ruins with the mountains rising behind them is a quietly powerful experience that connects you to the rich and layered history of this remarkable land.

As the evening light fades drive back to your hotel for a comfortable and well deserved overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pelling to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) (88 km / 3 hrs drive)
activities: Your tour comes to a beautiful end today. Enjoy a final breakfast, check out of the hotel, and our representative will drive you comfortably to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. As the mountains fade behind you, carry forward the memories, the moments, and the magic of this unforgettable Sikkim journey.

After a leisurely breakfast on the water you will head back to Kochi for your onward journey, taking with you the warmth of Kerala's landscapes and the kindness of its people. From cool misty hills to still golden backwaters, this package gives you a honeymoon that truly feels like something out of a dream.

This is not just a trip, it is the kind of memory the two of you will carry for a lifetime.

activities: You are picked up from Cochin Airport or Railway Station and driven towards the lovely hill station of Munnar. The road there is half the experience, rolling past streams, thick forests, tumbling waterfalls and sprawling plantations that make you want to slow down and just look. Arrive, check into your hotel, and let the mountain air do its thing. The evening is completely yours. Overnight stay in Munnar.

activities: After a warm breakfast, step out and let Munnar show you what it is made of. Wander through rolling tea gardens, pause at misty waterfalls, and take in the local attractions that give this hill station its quiet, unhurried character. Stop at a few viewpoints and just breathe in the calm that surrounds you on every side. Head back to the hotel as the day winds down. Overnight stay in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady (120 Kms – 4 Hrs)
activities: After breakfast, hit the road toward Thekkady at a comfortable pace. Once you arrive, check into your hotel and give yourself a little time to just breathe and settle in. The afternoon takes you through fragrant spice plantations where cardamom, cinnamon, pepper, coffee and tea grow almost effortlessly in the warm hill air. Later, head out onto the calm waters of Periyar Lake for a relaxed boat ride, keeping your eyes on the tree lined banks where elephants and other wildlife often wander into view. Overnight stay in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey (138 Kms – 4 Hrs)
activities: After breakfast, make your way to Alleppey where a private houseboat is ready and waiting just for the two of you. Step on board and let the backwaters take over as you slowly drift through narrow canals, open paddy fields, and swaying coconut lagoons that feel like they belong in a painting. As the evening settles in, sit down together for a candlelight dinner on deck and retire to a beautifully decorated honeymoon bed with the gentle sound of water all around you. Overnight stay on the houseboat.

itinerary.title: Departure
activities: After a leisurely breakfast on the water, it is time to check out of your houseboat and soak in one last look at the backwaters before you go. You will then be transferred comfortably to Cochin Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey, carrying with you the warmth of Kerala and memories that will stay close to your heart for a long time to come.

AllPackage.description:
This nine-day, eight-night excursion through the Andaman Islands begins in Port Blair, then moves on to Swaraj Dweep (Havelock Island), Shaheed Dweep (Neil Island), and Baratang Island. The adventure starts in Port Blair, with stops at Corbyn’s Cove Beach and the Cellular Jail, culminating in the evening's evocative Light and Sound Show. Following this, a ferry transports you to Havelock Island, where you can relax on the famous Radhanagar Beach.

Next, it's on to Neil Island, with Bharatpur Beach and Laxmanpur Beach on the agenda. After returning to Port Blair, the plan is to head to either Jolly Buoy Island or Red Skin Island. Both of these locations are situated within the Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park, a place renowned for its colorful coral reefs and varied marine life.

The itinerary includes a city tour, which will take in the Chatham Saw Mill, the Forest Museum, and a few other local museums.

A day excursion to Baratang Island allows visitors to travel through mangrove creeks to reach the Limestone Caves. The tour concludes with an excursion to North Bay Island and Ross Island before departure from Port Blair.

AllPackage.name: Ultimate Andaman & Nicobar Explorer
AllPackage.description:
Not every memorable getaway has to be a marathon, and this 3 Nights 4 Days tour centered on Port Blair, including a day trip to Havelock Island, proves the point. It packs a lot of substance into a brief period, exploring the history, the beaches, the vibrant marine life, and the stunning island landscapes that make the Andamans such a captivating place to visit.

The journey begins in Port Blair, the Andaman Islands' capital, with a stop at Corbyn's Cove Beach. The serene, scenic location by the water instantly sets a laid-back, welcoming tone for the days ahead.

The afternoon is set aside for the Cellular Jail, a place of profound historical significance in India. It's best appreciated with a sense of reflection, not rushed.

As evening arrives, the Light and Sound Show fills in the human stories behind those walls, narrating the sacrifices of the Indian freedom fighters in a way that is genuinely affecting and well worth staying for.

The ferry trip to Havelock Island is one of the clear highlights of the whole itinerary. Radhanagar Beach, waiting at the other end of that crossing, has a reputation that it more than lives up to, with soft white sand, water so clear and turquoise it almost looks painted, and a natural setting that regularly earns it a place among the finest beaches anywhere in Asia.

The full day excursion to North Bay Island and Ross Island adds two very different but equally rewarding experiences to the mix. North Bay Island brings color and energy, with vibrant coral reefs visible through glass-bottom boats and snorkeling that puts you right in the middle of a genuinely impressive marine world. Ross Island then slows things back down, its old British colonial ruins now wrapped in greenery and shared with local wildlife, giving the whole place a quietly haunting and very photogenic atmosphere.

Taken together, this tour manages to feel both compact and complete, which is not always easy to pull off in four days. For anyone looking for a short tropical break that still delivers a real and varied taste of the Andamans, this itinerary covers all the right bases.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Discover the beauty of the Andaman Islands with this 3 Nights 4 Days tour covering Port Blair and a day trip to Havelock Island. The itinerary includes visits to Corbyn’s Cove Beach, the historic Cellular Jail with the Light & Sound Show, and a ferry excursion to Havelock Island to explore the famous Radhanagar Beach. Travelers also enjoy a full-day trip to North Bay Island for coral reef viewing and marine activities along with a visit to Ross Island. This short tour offers a perfect mix of beaches, marine experiences, and island sightseeing.

AllPackage.name: Lovers’ Paradise Andaman Islands
AllPackage.description:
The Andaman Islands have long been one of those destinations that honeymoon couples discover and then spend years telling other people about, and this 4 Nights 5 Days tour covering Port Blair and Havelock Island gives you a genuinely lovely way to experience them together. It brings together quiet beaches, a little history, and some real island adventure into a package that feels romantic without being over-choreographed.

The trip starts in Port Blair, the capital city of the Andaman Islands, with a visit to Corbyn's Cove Beach, a peaceful and pretty coastal spot shaded by coconut trees with clear blue water lapping gently at the shore. It is the kind of place that asks nothing of you except to slow down and enjoy it. The afternoon adds a more meaningful dimension with a visit to the Cellular Jail, a landmark deeply tied to India's freedom struggle that is well worth taking your time with. As the day winds down, the Light and Sound Show brings the history of the jail and the stories of the freedom fighters to life in a presentation that is both powerful and beautifully put together.

A ferry crossing the next morning takes couples over to Havelock Island, and from the moment you arrive it is clear why this island has such a strong reputation. Radhanagar Beach is everything people say it is, with silky white sand, water in shades of turquoise that seem almost too vivid to be natural, and sunsets that turn the whole sky into something worth watching together. Kalapathar Beach presents a different experience altogether. The beach's distinctive black rocks, coupled with its calm, easygoing atmosphere, makes it a spot where you could easily lose track of time, perfectly happy to remain there for hours on end.

North Bay Island brings a burst of colour and energy to the itinerary, with snorkeling and glass-bottom boat rides giving couples a close-up look at some of the most vibrant coral reefs and marine life the islands have to offer. Ross Island follows with a completely different kind of charm, its old British colonial ruins now softened by thick greenery and populated by friendly local wildlife, creating an atmosphere that is atmospheric, a little mysterious, and quietly romantic in its own way.

After a few days of beaches, boat rides, and island wandering, the return to Port Blair for departure brings the trip to a natural and unhurried close. For newly married couples looking for a honeymoon that balances relaxation with discovery, this tour covers exactly the right ground in exactly the right amount of time.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Enjoy a romantic 4 Nights 5 Days Andaman honeymoon tour covering Port Blair and Havelock Island. The trip includes visits to Corbyn’s Cove Beach, the historic Cellular Jail with the Light & Sound Show, and ferry transfers to Havelock Island to explore the famous Radhanagar Beach and Kalapathar Beach.

AllPackage.name: Gangtok Short Escape
AllPackage.description:
Gangtok, nestled in Sikkim's embrace, has a way of lingering in your memory. It's a place where energy and peace coexist in a way that's hard to describe. Stroll through its streets, and you'll find a unique mix of culture and appeal, something that's not so common in India's hill stations. Beyond the city limits, the scenery transforms into something extraordinary. Gentle valleys stretch out, while majestic, snow-capped peaks loom above, quietly keeping their vigil over the world below.

Gangtok's true allure? The landscapes, undeniably. Waterfalls roar down the mountainsides, cascading over ancient rocks. This holiday package has been put together with people like you in mind. People who want to experience every corner of this remarkable place, not just see it from a distance. So let us set off together and explore all that this magnificent land has to offer.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Escape the crowds and discover Gangtok, where misty valleys, roaring waterfalls, and snow-capped peaks create a Himalayan paradise unlike any other.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station(NJP)/Bagdogra Airport(IXB) – Gangtok (130 km/4 hrs drive)
activities:
Your adventure kicks off the moment you land at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. As you step out and take in your first breath of that cool northeastern air, you will already sense that this trip is going to be something different. You will not have to figure out anything on your own because one of our friendly team members will be right there to greet you and take care of everything from that point on.

From there, you will begin the scenic drive toward Gangtok, a charming hill city sitting at an elevation of 1437 meters above sea level. The four hour journey itself is a treat, with the roads winding through lush green landscapes that slowly reveal the character of Sikkim. By the time you reach the city and settle into your hotel, you will feel both refreshed and ready for what lies ahead.

If the excitement of being in a new place keeps you from sitting still, head out to MG Marg for a relaxed evening stroll. This lively stretch is the heart of Gangtok and a wonderful place to soak in the local culture, watch people go about their evening, and get a feel for the city at your own pace.

When you return, a warm dinner will be waiting for you. Eat well, rest easy, and let the comfort of your room carry you into a good night of sleep because tomorrow the real exploration begins.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Full day local sight seeing)
activities:
Your second day in Gangtok is where the trip truly comes alive. After a good night of rest, wake up refreshed and ready because the city has a lot in store for you today.

Your first stop is Bakthang Waterfall, located just three kilometres from the city centre. Fed by the waters of Ratey Chu, this wide and powerful waterfall has a way of instantly putting you at ease. The sound of the water and the fresh air around it make for a genuinely calming start to the day.

From there, head over to Tashi Viewpoint, one of the finest spots in Gangtok to take in the grandeur of the Himalayan range. The panoramic views here are extraordinary, so keep your camera ready and take your time soaking it all in.

Next up is Ganesh Tok, a charming ancient temple dedicated to Lord Ganesha. On a clear day, the view of Gangtok from here is simply stunning. The temple itself has a warm and peaceful atmosphere, and the colourful prayer flags and decorations surrounding it make it a joy to explore.

You will then visit Enchey Monastery, a two hundred year old spiritual site that was originally founded as a small gompa by the revered Lama Drupthob Karpo. The name translates to the Solitary Temple and it is currently home to around ninety monks. The monastery houses a rich collection of religious artefacts and offers a genuine glimpse into Tibetan Buddhist culture.

After that, make your way to the Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom, situated at the Zero Point of the city. This is the perfect place to appreciate the skill and creativity of local artisans. You can browse and pick up beautifully crafted items including Thanka paintings, hand woven carpets, and intricately carved wooden sculptures.

Standing tall on a hilltop, Do Drul Chorten Stupa is your next destination. Built in 1945, this is the largest stupa in Sikkim and is encircled by 108 prayer wheels. Walking around it is a quietly moving experience that many visitors find deeply memorable.

Following your spiritual exploration, head to the Institute of Tibetology, one of the most respected centres of Tibetan scholarship in the entire world. Researchers from across the globe come here to study the Tibetan language, culture, and traditions. The on-site museum and library hold an impressive collection of rare texts and artefacts that bring the richness of Tibetan heritage to life.

If you happen to be visiting during the blooming season, the International Flower Festival is an experience you simply cannot miss. Organised by the local community as a celebration of Sikkim's incredible floral diversity, the festival showcases breathtaking blooms gathered from every corner of the state. It is a visual treat that nature lovers will cherish for years.

To wrap up the day on a high note, hop onto the Gangtok Ropeway for a scenic ride that leads you to Banjhakri Falls. This seventy foot waterfall is nestled within a dense forest and carries deep meaning for the local community, who have long believed in its healing and sacred qualities. Seeing it in person, it is not hard to understand why.

After a day packed with beauty, history, and culture, you will be driven back to your hotel. Sit down to a hot and satisfying dinner, then settle into your room and rest well because more wonderful places are waiting for you tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Tsomgo Lake Excursion and Baba Mandir)
activities:
The final day of your Gangtok adventure calls for an early start. Set your alarm for around 8 in the morning because today you will be visiting two of the most iconic and unforgettable destinations the region has to offer. Make sure you are well rested and ready to go because this day is going to leave a lasting mark on you.

Your first destination is the legendary Tsomgo Lake, perched high in the mountains at an elevation of 12,400 feet above sea level. The drive up takes around three hours but every minute of it is worth it. As you climb higher and the landscape grows more dramatic, the anticipation builds naturally. When the lake finally comes into view, it is one of those rare moments that genuinely takes your breath away. Known locally as a sacred body of water, Tsomgo holds deep spiritual significance for the people of Sikkim. The stillness of the lake, framed by towering snow dusted peaks and reflected skies, creates a scene so beautiful that you will find yourself reaching for your camera again and again. This is the kind of view you want to hold onto forever.

From there, your journey takes a deeply moving turn as you make your way to Baba Harbhajan Mandir. Situated at an altitude of 4000 metres, this shrine is dedicated to Captain Harbhajan Singh, a soldier of the Indian Army whose story continues to stir the hearts of all who hear it. Captain Singh lost his life during the Indo Pak conflict of 1965, but to this day he is believed by many to remain a watchful and protective presence in these mountains. The shrine built in his honour is visited by thousands of Indians every year, not just as a place of worship but as a powerful reminder of devotion, courage, and the enduring bond between a soldier and his homeland. Spending time here is a quietly emotional experience that is difficult to put into words.

As the day draws to a close, you will be brought back to your hotel for one last warm and delicious meal. Take your time over dinner, reflect on everything you have seen and felt over these past few days, and then get a good night of sleep. Tomorrow morning you will pack your bags and head back to your everyday life, but something tells us you will be carrying a piece of Gangtok with you for a very long time.

itinerary.title: Gangtok – New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP)/BagdograAirport (IXB) ( 130km/4 hrs drive)
activities:
It is time to head home. Enjoy your last meal, pack your bags, and make sure you have everything before setting off toward NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport.

As you drive back, let your mind wander through all the memories you have made. The mountain air, the stunning lakes, the peaceful monasteries, and the warmth of Gangtok will stay with you long after this journey ends.

Travel safe and we hope to see you back here again soon.

AllPackage.name: Paradise Voyage Andaman Islands
AllPackage.description:
Seven days in the Andaman Islands is enough time to really settle into the rhythm of the place, and this 6 Nights 7 Days tour covering Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Neil Island is put together in a way that lets you do exactly that. It moves through history, beaches, marine life, and island exploration without ever feeling like it is ticking boxes, and the overall experience feels genuinely well-rounded from the first day to the last.

Everything starts in Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman Islands, with a visit to Corbyn's Cove Beach, a lovely coconut palm lined stretch of coastline where the pace of everyday life seems to drop a gear the moment you arrive. The afternoon takes a more serious and meaningful turn at the Cellular Jail, one of the most important landmarks connected to India's freedom struggle and a place that rewards anyone who takes the time to really engage with what they are seeing. Come evening, the Light and Sound Show brings those stories to life with real warmth and gravity, honoring the sacrifices of the freedom fighters in a presentation that is hard to walk away from unmoved.

A full day excursion to North Bay Island and Ross Island adds two very distinct flavors to the Port Blair portion of the trip. North Bay Island is a treat for anyone drawn to the water, with snorkeling and glass-bottom boat rides revealing a coral reef world that is genuinely colorful and alive. Ross Island then offers something completely different, its old British colonial ruins now softened by years of encroaching greenery and populated by deer and birds that seem entirely unbothered by visitors. It is atmospheric, quietly beautiful, and unlike anywhere else on the itinerary.

A ferry transfer brings travelers to Havelock Island, and the island announces itself immediately with the kind of scenery that makes people consider not going home. Radhanagar Beach is the main event, with its wide sweep of white sand, famously clear turquoise water, and unhurried sunsets that seem to belong to a different, slower world. Elephant Beach adds an adventurous note to the Havelock stretch, with shallow crystal-clear water sitting above healthy coral reefs that make for some of the most rewarding snorkeling on the entire trip.

Neil Island offers a more serene and reflective end to the trip. Bharatpur Beach, with its tranquil atmosphere, is perfect for swimming and leisurely water pursuits. Laxmanpur Beach, however, truly shines in the evening, as the setting sun casts a golden light across the shoreline, creating a scene that seems almost intentionally beautiful.

Throughout the entire tour, comfortable accommodation, smooth ferry connections between islands, and well-organized sightseeing keep everything running without any friction. For couples, families, or those on a honeymoon, this itinerary offers a complete Andaman experience, designed to be both easy to follow and truly unforgettable.

AllPackage.name: Sun-Kissed Andaman & Nicobar
AllPackage.description:
The Andaman Islands do not need much of an introduction, and this 5 Nights 6 Days tour covering Port Blair and Swaraj Dweep (Havelock Island) gives you a really well-rounded way to experience them. The itinerary moves at a comfortable pace, mixing laid-back beach time with a couple of excursions and a few historical stops that add real depth to the whole trip.

It all begins in Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman Islands, with a visit to Corbyn's Cove Beach, a relaxed and scenic spot by the water that sets a nice tone for the days ahead. The afternoon takes a more thoughtful direction with a trip to the Cellular Jail, one of the most significant landmarks in the entire story of India's freedom movement. It is not a cheerful place, but it is an important one, and most people come away from it glad they went. The evening wraps up with the Light and Sound Show, which fills in the history of the jail and pays tribute to the freedom fighters in a presentation that is both informative and quietly moving.

A ferry transfer the following morning brings travelers to Swaraj Dweep, the island most people call Havelock, and the scenery shifts dramatically the moment you arrive. Radhanagar Beach is the obvious highlight, with its wide stretch of soft white sand, water so clear and turquoise it almost looks edited, and sunsets that draw a small crowd every single evening for good reason. Kalapathar Beach offers a different kind of beauty, calmer and more secluded, with distinctive black rocks scattered along the coastline and a generally unhurried atmosphere that makes it ideal for photography or simply switching off for a while.

One of the best parts of this itinerary is the leisure day built into the Havelock stretch. There is no agenda, no schedule to keep, just the island and however you want to spend the day. For those who want to make the most of it, an optional trip to Elephant Beach opens up some of the best snorkeling in the area, with healthy coral reefs and a lively underwater world that is well worth getting into the water for.

Back in Port Blair, the tour has a couple more strong cards to play. North Bay Island delivers a genuinely exciting few hours with colorful coral reefs visible through glass-bottom boats and plenty of snorkeling for those who prefer to get a closer look. Ross Island brings things to a quieter, more reflective close, its old British colonial ruins now wrapped in greenery and shared with local wildlife, giving the whole island a character that is hard to find anywhere else.

The trip ends with an airport transfer from Port Blair, and by that point most travelers have collected enough good memories to last well beyond the journey home. Whether you are here as a couple, a family, or just someone in need of a proper island holiday, this tour covers all the right bases without ever feeling like it is trying to do too much at once.

The itinerary includes visits to Corbyn’s Cove Beach, the historic Cellular Jail with the Light & Sound Show, and a ferry transfer to Havelock Island to explore Radhanagar Beach and Kalapathar Beach.

AllPackage.name: Tropical Treasure Andaman Islands
AllPackage.description:
If you have been looking for a trip that genuinely delivers on multiple fronts, this 5 Nights 6 Days Andaman tour package covers all the right ground, from the busy, characterful streets of Port Blair to the quiet shores of Havelock Island, the raw wilderness of Baratang, and the underwater world waiting around North Bay and Ross Island.

The trip starts in Port Blair, the capital city of the Andaman Islands, and wastes no time getting into the swing of things. First up is Corbyn's Cove Beach, a lovely coconut palm lined stretch of coastline that is equally good for a quiet walk or an afternoon of photography. The evening shifts the mood considerably with a visit to the Cellular Jail, one of those places that stays in your mind long after you have left, followed by the Light and Sound Show, which brings the stories of India's freedom fighters to life in a way that is both powerful and deeply respectful.

The following day, a ferry crossing takes travelers over to Swaraj Dweep, known to most as Havelock Island, and widely regarded as one of the most beautiful islands in the whole of Asia. Radhanagar Beach lives up to every good thing said about it, with its bright white sand, vivid turquoise water, and unhurried sunsets that seem to go on forever. Kalapathar Beach adds a quieter, more photogenic note to the day, the kind of spot where you sit down with no particular plan and enjoy every minute of it.

The adventure then takes a wilder turn with a day trip to Baratang Island, which involves traveling through dense forest and narrow mangrove creeks by boat before arriving at the Limestone Caves. These natural formations, shaped slowly over thousands of years, are genuinely impressive up close and well worth the journey to get there.

North Bay Island brings a completely different kind of excitement, with snorkeling, scuba diving, and a range of water activities set against some of the most colorful coral reefs and marine life the islands have to offer. Ross Island rounds out the day on a more contemplative note, its old British colonial ruins now largely overtaken by thick greenery and local wildlife, giving it a quietly haunting charm that is hard to find anywhere else.

Taken all together, this tour covers history, nature, beaches, and real adventure without ever trying too hard to do everything at once. It works just as well for couples and families as it does for groups of friends. The trip wraps up with a smooth transfer to Port Blair Airport, and the general feeling among most travelers is that six days was just enough to fall in love with these islands and just short enough to leave wanting more.

AllPackage.name: Crystal Waves Andaman Islands
AllPackage.description:
The Andaman Islands have a way of surprising people, and this 5 Nights 6 Days tour covering Port Blair, Swaraj Dweep (Havelock Island), and Shaheed Dweep (Neil Island) gives you just enough time to understand why. It pulls together beautiful beaches, relaxed ferry travel between islands, and some genuinely meaningful historical stops into one trip that feels balanced from start to finish.

Everything begins in Port Blair, the Andaman Islands' capital. The initial destination is Corbyn's Cove Beach. This tranquil, picturesque stretch of coast is lined with coconut palms and boasts clear, inviting waters.

It is a good introduction to the pace of island life. The afternoon brings a visit to the Cellular Jail, a landmark that carries enormous significance in the story of India's freedom struggle and deserves to be seen slowly and thoughtfully. As evening sets in, the Light and Sound Show picks up where the jail visit leaves off, narrating the journeys of the freedom fighters with enough detail and emotion to make it one of the more memorable parts of the whole trip.

A ferry transfer the next morning opens up Swaraj Dweep, the island most travelers know as Havelock, and it does not take long to see why it attracts so much attention. Radhanagar Beach greets you with soft white sand, water that shifts between every shade of blue and green, and sunsets that genuinely stop conversations. There is plenty of time to simply be on the island, and for those who want to add a bit more to the day, an optional trip to Elephant Beach brings snorkeling, coral reefs, and a lively marine world right to your doorstep.

From Havelock, the journey continues by ferry to Shaheed Dweep, better known as Neil Island, which has a noticeably quieter and more unhurried personality. Bharatpur Beach is great for getting into the water, with calm, clear conditions and plenty of activity around the reefs just below the surface. Laxmanpur Beach saves its best moment for the end of the day, when the light drops low over a coastline that looks almost too picturesque to be real.

After a couple of days on Neil Island, travelers make their way back to Port Blair for the final airport transfer. It is one of those trips that manages to feel both full and relaxed at the same time, covering enough ground to give you a real sense of the Andamans without ever rushing you through it. Whether you are traveling as a couple, a family, or simply looking for a proper island escape, this tour delivers exactly what it promises.

AllPackage.name: Sunset Lovers’ Andaman Islands
AllPackage.description:
There is something quietly special about the Andaman Islands, and this 4 Nights 5 Days tour covering Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Neil Island gives you a genuine and well-paced introduction to what makes this archipelago so hard to forget. It balances sightseeing with downtime, history with nature, and island hopping with the kind of slow beach days that remind you why you booked a holiday in the first place.

The journey starts in Port Blair, the Andaman Islands' capital. Corbyn's Cove Beach is the place to start, a destination celebrated for its relaxed atmosphere and stunning views.

Then, a visit to the Cellular Jail, a place that offers a stark but essential perspective on India's struggle for freedom, a truly moving experience.

The evening brings the Light and Sound Show, which narrates the story of that independence movement with enough detail and emotion to make it one of the more affecting experiences of the entire trip.

From Port Blair, a ferry transfer opens up Havelock Island, and the island makes an immediate and lasting impression. Radhanagar Beach is the kind of place that travel writers run out of new ways to describe, and rightly so. The sand is soft and white, the water shifts through shades of turquoise that seem almost too vivid to be natural, and the sunsets draw a quiet crowd every single evening who all seem to arrive with the same unspoken understanding that something worth watching is about to happen.

Neil Island follows with a character all of its own, smaller and more laid-back than Havelock but no less rewarding for it. Bharatpur Beach offers calm, clear water that is well suited to swimming and gentle water activities, while Laxmanpur Beach comes into its own toward the end of the day when the coastal scenery catches the fading light in a way that makes it genuinely difficult to leave.

The ferry transfers between islands run smoothly, the accommodation is comfortable throughout, and the sightseeing is organized in a way that takes the stress out of moving between destinations. For couples, families, and honeymooners looking for a trip that gets the balance right between adventure and relaxation, this tour covers exactly the right ground in exactly the right amount of time.

AllPackage.name: Sikkim Darjeeling Explorer
AllPackage.description: Sikkim is one of those places where you will genuinely struggle to find something that does not pull you in. This package brings together three of the most charming towns the state has to offer, the bustling capital city of Gangtok, the quietly beautiful Pelling and the rich and rewarding Darjeeling. Travelling through these destinations gives you a deeper connection with nature and hands you a front row seat to one of the most stunning corners of the world. All three sit close to the mighty foothills of Kanchenjunga, which adds a certain grandeur to everything you see along the way. At its heart, this holiday is a close up look at nature's raw beauty, the warmth of Indian culture, the state's colourful and layered history and the kind of ancient monuments that make you stop and stare. The art and sculptures you come across here have a way of leaving you genuinely speechless. Our carefully put together itinerary walks you through the very finest that North East India has to offer, covering all the sights and sounds that make this region so unforgettable. Whether you are heading out with a group of friends, planning a family getaway or dreaming of a romantic honeymoon, this package is flexible enough to fit around what you and your travel companions are looking for.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Sikkim surprises at every turn. This package takes you through Gangtok, Pelling and Darjeeling, where stunning landscapes, rich culture and ancient monuments come together for an unforgettable trip built around you.
