itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP)/ Bagdogra Airport (IXB) – Gangtok (130 km / 4 Hours Drive Approximately)
activities:
North East India has a warmth to it that you feel the moment you arrive. On the first day of this Gangtok Pelling Darjeeling tour, you will land at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport and make your way straight to Gangtok, a town sitting at 1,437 meters that has a way of making every kind of traveller feel right at home. Check in at the hotel, put your bags down and give yourself a moment to breathe. The rest of the day is yours to enjoy at your own pace. We would suggest stepping out and getting a feel for the area around you, because Gangtok is the kind of place that rewards a little wandering. The marketplaces and eateries here are plentiful, and a slow walk through the narrow lanes, traditional gatherings and busy bazaars gives you a genuine glimpse into the soul of this town.

MG Marg

MG Marg is where most people end up and for very good reason. Goods from across India sit comfortably alongside Tibetan market finds, giving you plenty to browse through. Make sure you try some of the local food while you are at it, and take a few minutes to just sit on one of the street benches and watch the whole lively scene unfold around you. Head back to the hotel when the evening draws in, enjoy a good dinner and get a solid night of sleep before the adventures ahead.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Tsomgo Lake Excursion and Baba Mandir)
activities:
Get an early start with a good breakfast and head out for another day that is going to leave a real mark on you.

Tsomgo Lake

Tsomgo Lake rests at an elevation of 12,400 feet above sea level and carries a sense of calm that is hard to describe until you are actually standing there. A temple built along its shore is believed to be the reason locals hold it as a sacred place, and the lake itself adds to that feeling by shifting into different colours as the seasons change around it.

Baba Harbhajan Mandir

Perched at 13,200 feet, Baba Harbhajan Mandir is a shrine built in honour of an Indian soldier who is believed to continue serving and protecting the nation even after his passing. The national anthem plays here every half hour, and for every Indian Army personnel, a visit to this memorial is not optional but a matter of deep respect and duty.

Optional Tour to Nathula Pass / Additional Charges / Special Permit For those who want to stretch the day a little further, an optional visit to Nathula Pass can be arranged separately. Sitting close to the Indo-China border, it is one of those places that carries a weight and significance that you feel the moment you arrive. After a day this full and rewarding, head back to the hotel in Gangtok and give yourself the rest you have genuinely earned.

itinerary.title: Half Day Sightseeing and Transfer from Gangtok – Pelling (120 km / 5.5 Hours Drive Approximately)
activities:
On the third day of your Darjeeling Gangtok Pelling tour, start with a relaxed and delicious breakfast, check out of the hotel in Gangtok and hit the road toward the wonderfully scenic town of Pelling. The drive itself comes with a couple of stops that are well worth your time.

Namchi Char Dham Temple

A short detour off the main route brings you to the Namchi Char Dham Temple, a significant religious and cultural landmark where the central temple is dedicated to Lord Shiva. It is widely believed that a sincere visit here washes away one's sins, and there is a certain peaceful energy about the place that makes that very easy to believe.

Samdruptse Statue

Sitting atop a hill at 7,000 feet is the towering Samdruptse Statue, a giant figure of Sikkim's beloved patron saint Guru Padmasambhava that commands your attention the moment it comes into view. Local belief holds that the hill beneath it is a sleeping volcano and that only the power of prayer keeps it at rest. What makes this place even more remarkable is that the foundation stone was laid by none other than the Dalai Lama himself. After taking in both these wonderful spots, continue the drive to Pelling. Check in at the hotel on arrival, let the evening unfold however you like and settle in for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Full Day Local Sightseeing in Pelling
activities:
Start the day early with a satisfying breakfast and get ready to see what Pelling is truly made of.

Darap Valley

The first stop is Darap Valley, a charming little hamlet that has a very warm and unhurried feel to it. It makes for a lovely spot to slow down, have a casual chat with the locals and get a real taste of everyday Sikkimese life and food.

Rimbi Waterfalls and Kanchenjunga Waterfalls

These two perennial waterfalls are among the most loved spots in town for very good reason. There is something genuinely refreshing about standing near them, and beyond just the views, they are also popular for recreational activities like fishing.

Rock Garden and Khecheopalri Lake

The Rock Garden is a delightful place to walk through, with gardens and pools tucked along its winding footpaths that make every turn a little surprise. Nearby, the Khecheopalri Lake sits quietly within a dense forest and is widely regarded as one of the most sacred water bodies in Pelling. It is clean, still and incredibly picturesque in a way that feels almost untouched.

Rabdentse Ruins

The Rabdentse Ruins carry the weight of Sikkim's rich and glorious past within every weathered stone. For anyone who loves history or archaeology, this is the kind of place you could spend hours in without realising it.

Pema Yangtse Monastery

Just a short walk from the ruins sits Pema Yangtse Monastery, offering some of the most stunning views of the Kanchenjunga ranges that you will find anywhere in the region.

Helipad Ground

The Helipad Ground rounds off the day beautifully as one of the finest viewpoints around for gazing at the snow capped peaks. The sunset from here is the kind that stops all conversation and just makes everyone stand still. Head back to the hotel in the evening and enjoy a peaceful overnight stay in Pelling.

itinerary.title: Pelling – Darjeeling (75 km / 3.5 Hours Drive Approximately)
activities: Sit down for a lovely breakfast, finish checking out of the hotel in Pelling and get ready for a drive that has its own quiet charm. The road to Darjeeling winds through hilly terrain with the sounds of summer all around you and sweeping panoramic views of Mt. Kanchenjunga accompanying you along the way. There is a certain anticipation that builds naturally as the hills roll past and Darjeeling draws closer, and that feeling is very much part of the experience. On arrival, check in at the hotel, shake off the journey and let the rest of the day be entirely yours. Spend the evening however feels right and drift off to sleep in the comfort of a cosy hotel room.

itinerary.title: Full day Local Sightseeing in Darjeeling
activities:
Tiger Hill

Set your alarm early because the day begins at 4 a.m. with a drive up to Tiger Hill. At 2,590 meters, this is where you will witness one of the most breathtaking sunrises you will ever see in your life. Watch as the first light of the morning spills across the dark sky and slowly illuminates the mighty Mt. Kanchenjunga, the third highest peak in the world. It is the kind of moment that stays with you long after the trip is over.

Ghoom Monastery and Batasia Loop

On the way back down, stop by the Ghoom Monastery, a beautifully placed spiritual landmark surrounded by some truly stunning natural scenery. The Batasia Loop nearby is widely regarded as one of the most scenic train routes in all of Darjeeling and is well worth a few minutes of your time. Head back to the hotel, sit down for a proper breakfast and then head out again for the rest of the day.

Himalayan Mountaineering Institute

A visit to the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute gives you a fascinating look into the world of mountaineering and the spirit of pushing human limits, with a strong focus on inspiring the younger generation to take up the sport.

Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park

The Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park, closed on Thursdays, is home to a wonderful variety of Himalayan wildlife and species that you are unlikely to spot anywhere else quite so easily.

Tenzing Rock

Adventure lovers will feel right at home at Tenzing Rock, a well known and much loved rock climbing site that draws thrill seekers from all over.

Japanese Temple and the Peace Pagoda

On the way to the Japanese Temple and Peace Pagoda, take a moment to enjoy the outer view of Chitrey Tea Garden, the very ground where Darjeeling's world famous aromatic tea comes to life. The temple and pagoda carry a deep sense of calm, and the panoramic views of the landscape and Kanchenjunga range from the top of the pagoda are absolutely stunning.

Chowrasta and Mall Road

Round off the evening with a relaxed stroll through Chowrasta and Mall Road, two of Darjeeling's most beloved market areas. Pick up some bamboo and cane crafts, pottery, hand stitched jackets or woven shawls to take back as reminders of this beautiful town. Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) (160 km / 6 Hours Drive Approximately)
activities: The last morning has quietly arrived, and just like that, your Sikkim holiday is drawing to a close. Pull up a chair for one final breakfast, let the memories of the past few days wash over you, and then take care of the check out formalities before heading off. Your transfer to the railway station, bus station or airport will all be sorted out as per your travel plan, so there is nothing left to worry about. You are heading home with stories worth telling, souvenirs worth showing off and memories worth revisiting on even the most ordinary of days. It was truly a pleasure having you with us and we hope that the next time travel comes calling, we get to be part of that journey too.

AllPackage.name: Heavenly Andaman & Nicobar Voyage
AllPackage.description:
This 7-night, 8-day Andaman tour promises a laid-back island getaway, showcasing the Andaman and Nicobar Islands' most stunning locales. Port Blair, Swaraj Dweep (Havelock Island), and Shaheed Dweep (Neil Island) are all on the itinerary. The trip blends picturesque beaches, island adventures, and historical sites, ensuring a travel experience you'll remember.

The journey begins in Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Our first destination is Corbyn's Cove Beach, a beautiful stretch of sand framed by palm trees that dance in the breeze and the shimmering sea.

Next, we'll focus on the Cellular Jail, a place heavy with history and forever associated with India's struggle for freedom.

As night falls, the renowned Light and Sound Show commences, bringing to life the poignant tales of the freedom fighters who endured imprisonment there.

The next phase of the trip takes us across the water to Swaraj Dweep, or Havelock Island, a destination much-loved by Andaman Island adventurers. Upon arrival, the famous Radhanagar Beach awaits. Renowned for its stunningly clear blue waters, powdery white sand, and sunsets that take your breath away, Havelock Island offers a perfect escape. A single day there presents a wealth of possibilities: lounging on the beach, discovering the island's hidden corners, or simply soaking up the tranquil, tropical atmosphere.

The next leg of the trip takes you to Shaheed Dweep, also known as Neil Island, a charming destination known for its pristine scenery and laid-back atmosphere. From there, visitors can explore Bharatpur Beach, famous for its coral reefs and remarkably clear waters, and Laxmanpur Beach, where stunning views and unforgettable sunsets are the main attractions.

Upon their return to Port Blair, visitors can take in a city tour. This excursion highlights several key sights. Among them are the Chatham Saw Mill, a historic and sizable sawmill, and the Naval Marine Museum. The Anthropological Museum and the Fisheries Museum also feature, offering glimpses into the Andaman Islands' marine ecosystems, tribal heritage, and historical context.

The itinerary also features a thrilling trip to North Bay Island, celebrated for its lively coral reefs and various water-based pursuits. Then, there's Ross Island, a place steeped in history, where the British once held sway as the Andaman Islands' administrative center.

This adventure is ideal for families, couples, and honeymooners alike, all hoping to experience the Andaman Islands' tropical charm, its beautiful beaches, lively marine life, and fascinating history. The journey wraps up with a departure from Port Blair, giving travelers a chance to carry the memories of their island adventure with them.

AllPackage.name: Andaman Islands Paradise Shores
AllPackage.description:
Some trips stay with you long after you've unpacked. The Andaman Islands are that kind of place.

This six-night journey weaves together everything that makes travel worthwhile — raw natural beauty, quiet beaches, layers of history, and the kind of stillness you didn't know you were looking for. Port Blair, the lively capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, is where it all begins. The journey then unfolds, not as a series of tasks, but as a story.

Your first afternoon takes you to Corbyn's Cove Beach. Picture palm trees, their trunks curving over the sand, and the sea, a canvas for the fading light. It's the sort of place that naturally encourages you to unwind. As night falls, the atmosphere changes at the Light and Sound Show, a poignant homage to the freedom fighters who were imprisoned here during British colonialism. The story isn't an easy one, but it's a necessary one, presented with a quiet grace that resonates.

From Port Blair, a ferry carries you across the water to Swaraj Dweep — better known as Havelock Island. The moment you arrive, you understand what all the fuss is about. Radhanagar Beach greets you with water so blue it looks almost unreal, sand that's impossibly soft underfoot, and sunsets that seem to linger on purpose. Regularly counted among the finest beaches in all of Asia, it's the kind of place where hours disappear without apology.

Next comes Shaheed Dweep, or Neil Island — smaller, quieter, and utterly charming in its own right. There's no rush here. Bharatpur Beach draws you in with its calm, clear waters and coral reefs teeming with color, while Laxmanpur Beach earns its reputation at dusk, when the horizon turns into something you'll be reaching for your camera to capture.

Back in Port Blair, the adventure takes a different turn toward Baratang Island. Getting there is half the experience — a boat journey through dense forest and winding mangrove waterways that feels genuinely wild. At the journey's conclusion, the Limestone Caves await, a testament to the slow artistry of geology, where formations defy easy description. Within, a sense of awe is almost unavoidable.

The trip also encompasses North Bay Island, a haven for those who cherish the ocean, thanks to its vibrant coral reefs and the myriad creatures that call them home. Then there's Ross Island, where the echoes of colonial architecture are slowly being swallowed by the jungle's relentless advance, and deer wander the decaying structures with an effortless elegance. A land of quiet peculiarities, this place is slowly being reclaimed by the relentless march of time.

Whether you're traveling as a family, as a couple, or on a honeymoon, the Andamans have a way of giving everyone exactly what they came for. And when it's finally time to leave Port Blair, most people find themselves doing a little mental cataloguing — the color of the water, the feel of the sand, the way the islands looked just before the sun went down.

Some trips you forget on the flight home. This one, you carry with you.

AllPackage.name: Sikkim Darjeeling Trail
AllPackage.description:
Some destinations defy description, and Sikkim is certainly one of them. This compact yet remarkable Indian state, nestled in the northeast, possesses an allure that seems both ancient and unspoiled. Sikkim's deep cultural heritage and stunning scenery present a beauty that lingers in memory. Celebrated as India's sole fully organic state, everything here feels untainted and vibrant, from the air to the produce cultivated in its terraced gardens.

If you're drawn to the great outdoors, crave adventure, and yearn to witness the Himalayas at their most spectacular, this eight-day, seven-night trip through Gangtok, Pelling, and Darjeeling is tailor-made. Prepare to discover some of the most breathtaking spots the eastern Himalayas have to offer.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Explore the magic of Sikkim and Darjeeling on this 7 nights 8 days tour. From Gangtok's mountain charm to Darjeeling's misty hills, every moment is unforgettable.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Winding snowy mountain road at Nathula Pass with tourists, prayer flags, and Indian Army buildings in the high Himalayas of Sikkim.
exclusions: Personal expenses (heater, laundry, calls, tips, water, drinks, entry fees).
Extra sightseeing or additional vehicle usage.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) to Gangtok (130 km / 4 hrs drive)
activities:
Your Sikkim adventure begins the moment you step off the train or plane at NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. Our representative will be right there to welcome you with a warm greeting and take charge of everything from that point on. You will then begin the scenic four hour drive to Gangtok, sitting at an elevation of 1437 metres, as the landscape around you gradually transforms into something truly special.

On arrival, check into your hotel and give yourself some time to freshen up and unwind after the journey. Once you are feeling rested, head out for a relaxed evening walk along MG Marg, the lively heart of Gangtok where you can soak in the local atmosphere, browse through the shops, and get your first real taste of the city. Return to the hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Excursion to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir)
activities:
Start your morning with a relaxed breakfast before heading out at around 8 am for one of the most memorable days of your trip. Today you will make your way to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Harbhajan Mandir, two destinations that are as spiritually powerful as they are visually stunning.

The drive to Tsomgo Lake takes around three hours along a winding road that cuts through rugged mountain terrain. Every twist and turn reveals a more dramatic view than the last. Sitting at an altitude of 12,400 feet, the lake is a truly sacred place for the local people and it is easy to see why. Its beauty changes with every season. In winter the entire lake freezes over under a thick blanket of snow while in spring the surrounding slopes burst into colour with blooming wildflowers that reflect in the still water. No matter when you visit, the sight of it stays with you.

From there you will head up to Baba Harbhajan Mandir at 13,200 feet, a shrine dedicated to the memory of Baba Harbhajan Singh, a courageous Indian Army soldier who lost his life near Nathula Pass while carrying supplies to a remote outpost in difficult weather conditions. The shrine built in his honour is considered one of the most sacred and emotionally moving sites in all of Sikkim and a visit here leaves a deep and lasting impression on every traveller.

After the excursion you will be driven comfortably back to Gangtok for an overnight stay at your hotel.

Please note that Nathula Pass can also be visited on the same day at an additional cost. Located at 14,140 feet, it is one of the highest motorable passes in India and one of the oldest trading routes connecting India and Tibet, making it a fascinating stop for history lovers and adventure seekers alike.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Full Day Sightseeing Tour)
activities:
After a satisfying breakfast, get ready for a full day of exploration as you discover the very best that Gangtok has to offer. Today is packed with incredible stops and each one brings something completely different to the table.

Your first stop is Ganesh Tok, a beloved temple that has drawn visitors for generations. Beyond its spiritual significance, the temple offers some of the most breathtaking views of the mighty Kangchenjunga on a clear day, making it a wonderful place to pause and take it all in.

From there head over to Banjhakri Waterfall, a stunning natural spot that is perfect for spending some relaxed and joyful time surrounded by the sounds and sights of cascading water and lush greenery.

Next on the list is the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology, one of the most respected centres for the study of Tibetan culture and Buddhist traditions in the world. The architecture alone is worth admiring and the collection inside offers a genuine window into a rich and ancient way of life.

You will then take a ride on the Gangtok Ropeway, which glides smoothly over the city and surrounding hills offering sweeping mountain views that are hard to match from anywhere on the ground.

The rest of the afternoon is filled with more wonderful sights including the powerful Bakthang Waterfall, the grand Do Drul Chorten Stupa encircled by its 108 prayer wheels, the scenic Tashi Viewpoint, the creative displays at the Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom, the peaceful and ancient Enchey Monastery, and the vibrant and colourful Flower Show that celebrates the incredible floral diversity of Sikkim.

After a truly full and rewarding day, you will head back to your hotel for a well deserved overnight rest.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Pelling (120 km / 5.5 hrs drive)
activities:
After a good breakfast, it is time to bid farewell to Gangtok and set off toward your next destination. The drive to Pelling stretches over roughly five and a half hours but it is far from an ordinary road journey. Along the way you will pass through sprawling tea gardens that carpet the hillsides in deep green, catch glimpses of majestic mountain ridges rising in the distance, and roll through some of the most peaceful and scenic landscapes Sikkim has to offer. It is the kind of drive where you find yourself constantly looking out of the window and forgetting to check your phone.

Pelling itself is a charming little town nestled among tall pine forests in West Sikkim. What makes it truly special is the unobstructed view it offers of the snow capped peaks and the towering presence of Kangchenjunga standing proud on the horizon. The town is also home to several ancient monasteries that carry centuries of history and quiet spiritual energy within their walls.

After the long and scenic drive, you will check into your hotel and have the rest of the day completely to yourself. Take a slow walk, sit by the window with a warm cup of tea, or simply rest and recharge. Pelling has a way of making you feel calm the moment you arrive and tonight is the perfect time to let that feeling sink in.

itinerary.title: Pelling (Full Day Local Sightseeing)
activities:
After a relaxed breakfast, step out and get ready to discover everything that makes Pelling such a special destination. Today is a full day of sightseeing and every stop on the list is worth looking forward to.

Begin your morning at Kanchenjunga Waterfalls, a powerful and refreshing sight that instantly lifts your energy. The roaring water surrounded by dense green forest creates an atmosphere that feels both wild and deeply calming at the same time. It is the perfect way to start the day.

From there make your way to Sewaro Rock Garden, a beautifully landscaped space full of lush greenery and natural charm. It is a lovely spot to slow down, wander around, and appreciate the quieter side of Pelling.

Next up is Darap Valley, a scenic and peaceful retreat that offers a glimpse into the unhurried rural life of Sikkim. The surroundings here are gentle and beautiful and the valley has a calming quality that is hard to resist.

After a satisfying lunch break, the afternoon sightseeing continues with a visit to Pema Yangtse Monastery, one of the oldest and most significant monasteries in Sikkim. Its spiritual atmosphere and stunning hilltop setting make it a truly memorable stop.

You will then visit the Helipad Ground which offers sweeping views of the Himalayan range before heading to the charming Rimbi Waterfalls tucked within the forested hillside.

The deeply sacred Khecheopalri Lake comes next, a serene and holy body of water that holds great importance for both Buddhists and Hindus in the region. The peace you feel standing beside it is unlike anything else on this trip.

Finally round off the day with a visit to the Rabdentse Ruins, the remains of the ancient capital of the former Kingdom of Sikkim. Walking through these historic ruins with the mountains as a backdrop is a quietly powerful experience that connects you to the long and rich history of this land.

As evening settles in you will be driven back to your hotel for a comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pelling to Darjeeling (73 km / 3 hrs 37 min)
activities:
After a warm breakfast and a final look at the beautiful surroundings of Pelling, it is time to pack up and head toward the legendary hill station of Darjeeling. The drive covers around 73 kilometres and while the road may not always be the smoothest, the journey itself is anything but boring.

As you wind your way through the hills you will pass through some truly lovely scenery. Vast stretches of green tea gardens roll across the slopes as far as the eye can see. Rivers glisten below as you cross old bridges that look like they have stood there for a hundred years. Small and charming villages dot the hillside, offering a candid and unhurried glimpse into everyday mountain life in this part of the world.

By the time you reach Darjeeling and check into your hotel, the beauty of the drive will already have set the perfect mood for the days ahead. Settle in, take some time to rest, and let the cool mountain air of one of India's most beloved hill stations welcome you for an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling (Full Day Local Sightseeing)
activities:
This is a day that begins before the sun does. Set your alarm for around 4 in the morning because today starts with one of the most breathtaking experiences this entire trip has to offer. You will drive up to Tiger Hill, the highest point in Darjeeling at 2590 metres, to witness the sunrise over the magnificent Kangchenjunga. As the first light of dawn spills across the sky and slowly illuminates the snow covered peaks in shades of gold and orange, you will understand why people travel from all over the world just for this single moment. It is the kind of sunrise that stays in your memory for the rest of your life.

On the way back down, make a stop at Batasia Loop, a beautifully landscaped spiral railway loop that offers lovely views of the surrounding hills and the famous Darjeeling toy train winding its way through the landscape. Just nearby is Ghoom Monastery, one of the oldest and most revered monasteries in the Darjeeling region, where the peaceful early morning atmosphere makes the visit feel especially meaningful.

Return to your hotel for a well earned and hearty breakfast before heading out again to continue exploring the city.

Your next stop is the Japanese Temple, a stunning structure that reflects traditional Japanese Buddhist architecture and serves as an important pilgrimage site. The calm and meditative energy of the temple grounds is a wonderful contrast to the excitement of the early morning.

The afternoon takes you through a wonderful mix of attractions. The Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park is home to some rare and endangered Himalayan species including the red panda and snow leopard, making it a fascinating visit for wildlife lovers. Please note that the park remains closed on Thursdays. Right next door is the Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, a legendary institution that has trained some of India's finest mountaineers and houses a remarkable museum dedicated to the history of Himalayan expeditions.

From there head to Tenzing Rock, a natural rock formation used for climbing practice and named after the legendary Tenzing Norgay who conquered Everest alongside Edmund Hillary. The Peace Pagoda is your next stop, a gleaming white structure set against the hills that radiates a sense of calm and stillness that is hard to find elsewhere.

Round off the afternoon with a scenic outer view of Chitrey Tea Garden, where endless rows of tea bushes stretch across the hillside in a shade of green so vivid it almost does not look real.

As the evening comes in, make your way to Mall Road for a leisurely stroll. This is the beating heart of Darjeeling where you can browse local shops, sip a warm cup of the world famous Darjeeling tea, watch the evening unfold around you, and soak in the last moments of a truly unforgettable day.

Return to your hotel for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) (88 km / 3 hrs drive)
activities:
The final morning has arrived. After eight days of mountain air, stunning landscapes, sacred lakes, ancient monasteries, and memories that will last a lifetime, it is time to make your way back home.

Start the day with a leisurely breakfast and take your time soaking in the last views of beautiful Darjeeling before checking out of the hotel. Our representative will be there to ensure your luggage is taken care of and your journey back to NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport is smooth and comfortable.

As the car winds down through the hills and the mountains slowly fade into the distance behind you, let your mind drift back through everything this trip gave you. The golden sunrise over Kangchenjunga from Tiger Hill. The sacred stillness of Tsomgo Lake high in the clouds. The warmth of the monasteries. The thunder of the waterfalls. The kindness of the people and the quiet magic of the mountains at every turn.

Sikkim and Darjeeling have a way of leaving a piece of themselves with every traveller who passes through and we have no doubt that this journey has done exactly that for you.

It has been an absolute pleasure travelling with you. Take care, travel safe, and we truly hope to see you again on your next great adventure.

AllPackage.name: Coral Wonders of Andaman Islands
AllPackage.description:
Three nights, four days. Sometimes, that's all it takes.

This Port Blair and Havelock Island tour proves that a short trip to the Andamans can be deeply satisfying. It finds the sweet spot, delivering a carefully planned experience that doesn't feel hurried. You'll get a taste of history, some beach time, and the island's distinctive atmosphere, ensuring you feel like you've genuinely connected with the place.

The journey starts in Port Blair, the Andaman Islands' capital, with a visit to the Cellular Jail. This historic site, with its rich past, offers more than many places do in a whole city.

It is one of the most significant sites connected to India's freedom struggle, and walking through it is a sobering and worthwhile experience that puts the rest of the trip in a meaningful context. As the evening settles in, the Light and Sound Show takes over, telling the stories of the freedom fighters who endured imprisonment here during the colonial period with a quiet intensity that tends to leave a lasting impression.

A ferry transfer the following morning brings travelers to Havelock Island, and the shift in scenery is immediate and dramatic. Radhanagar Beach greets you with everything its reputation promises, wide stretches of soft white sand, water in shades of turquoise that look almost unreal in the afternoon light, and sunsets that genuinely stop you in your tracks. Kalapathar Beach offers a different but equally appealing experience, tucked away behind lush greenery with its characteristic black rocks framing a coastline that feels private, calm, and completely removed from the noise of everyday life.

After a couple of unhurried days on Havelock Island, travelers make their way back to Port Blair for the onward journey. For couples, families, or anyone looking for a quick but genuinely rewarding tropical escape, this tour delivers a surprisingly full Andaman experience within a compact and very manageable timeframe.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Enjoy a relaxing 3 Nights 4 Days Andaman tour covering Port Blair and Havelock Island. The trip includes visits to the historic Cellular Jail with the Light & Sound Show in Port Blair and a ferry journey to Havelock Island to explore the famous Radhanagar Beach and the scenic Kalapathar Beach. This short island getaway offers a perfect combination of beach relaxation, island travel, and local sightseeing.

AllPackage.name: Sikkim Darjeeling Grand Tour
AllPackage.description:
If you've ever yearned to see the eastern Himalayas, this eight-night, nine-day tour is the perfect fit. It weaves together the timeless charm of Sikkim and the renowned beauty of Darjeeling. This journey offers a unique chance to experience two of India's most cherished mountain locales, all in one memorable trip.

Gangtok, the vibrant and captivating capital of Sikkim, warrants a visit all its own. Its quaint allure, lively thoroughfares, and stunning views of the Kangchenjunga massif position. Pelling, nestled within West Sikkim, often takes visitors' breath away. Then there's Darjeeling, the Queen of Hills, a title it's more than earned. Tucked away in the West Bengal hills, this quintessential Victorian town is among India's most renowned hill stations.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Explore the very best of Sikkim and Darjeeling on this 8 nights 9 days tour. From Gangtok's mountain charm and Lachung's scenic beauty to Darjeeling's iconic tea gardens and Toy Train, every moment is magical.

itinerary.title: New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) to Gangtok (130 km / 4 hrs drive)
activities:
Your Sikkim and Darjeeling adventure begins the moment you touch down at Bagdogra Airport or step off the train at NJP Railway Station. Our representative will be right there to greet you with a warm welcome and take care of everything from that very first moment. Settle comfortably into the vehicle and enjoy the scenic four hour drive to Gangtok, a charming hill city beautifully positioned at an elevation of 1437 metres above sea level. As the road winds its way up through lush green forests and misty hillsides the excitement of the days ahead will begin to build naturally.

On arrival check into your hotel and give yourself a little time to freshen up and unwind after the journey. The mountains have a way of making you feel relaxed almost immediately and this is the perfect time to let that feeling settle in.

As the evening rolls in head out for a gentle and unhurried stroll along MG Marg, the vibrant heart of Gangtok. This lively and welcoming street is the perfect introduction to the city. Browse through the local shops, soak in the cheerful atmosphere, grab a warm cup of tea, and get your very first taste of what makes Gangtok such a special place to be.

Return to your hotel for a peaceful and comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok (Excursion to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir)
activities:
After a relaxed and satisfying breakfast, set off at around 8 in the morning for one of the most anticipated days of the entire trip. Today takes you to two destinations that are as different from each other as they could possibly be and yet both leave an equally deep and lasting impression.

The drive to Tsomgo Lake winds through a stunning mountainous landscape that makes the three hour journey feel like a pleasure rather than a commute. As you climb higher and the air grows crisper the anticipation builds beautifully. Sitting at an elevation of 12,400 feet, Tsomgo is a high altitude glacial lake of remarkable beauty and deep spiritual significance. The local community holds it sacred and it is easy to understand why the moment you lay eyes on it. The lake has a wonderful quality of changing its character with the seasons. In the depths of winter it freezes over completely, transforming into a vast sheet of ice and snow. Come spring and the surrounding hillsides burst into life with colourful wildflowers that reflect in the still and glittering water. Whenever you visit Tsomgo never looks the same twice and that is part of what makes it so captivating.

From there the journey continues up to Baba Harbhajan Mandir, perched at 13,200 feet. This deeply moving shrine was built to honour the memory and courage of Baba Harbhajan Singh, a brave Indian Army soldier who lost his life while carrying supplies to a remote outpost near Nathula Pass in extremely harsh weather conditions. His story has touched the hearts of countless visitors over the years and the shrine dedicated to him carries a quiet and powerful emotional weight that is genuinely hard to put into words. For many travellers this turns out to be one of the most memorable stops of the entire journey.

After a truly meaningful day of exploration our representative will drive you comfortably back to Gangtok for a restful overnight stay at your hotel.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Lachung (116 km / 6 hrs drive)
activities:
After a good breakfast check out and set off toward Lachung, one of the most enchanting mountain villages in all of North Sikkim. Sitting at an elevation of 8800 feet and hemmed in on all sides by towering snow capped peaks, Lachung is the kind of place that feels genuinely removed from the rest of the world. The village is famous for its lovely waterfalls tumbling down the hillsides, clear glistening streams that run through the landscape, and beautiful orchards of apricot, peach, and apple trees that give the surroundings a warm and fruitful character. The Lachung Chu river flows right through the heart of the village, quietly dividing it into two distinct halves and lending it a charm that is entirely its own.

The six hour drive up to Lachung is filled with wonderful moments along the way. Your first stop is Singhik Viewpoint, a breathtaking vantage point that offers sweeping and unobstructed views of the magnificent Mount Siniolchu rising against the sky. It is the kind of view that makes you want to stand still and simply stare for a while.

A little further along the road the Seven Sisters Waterfall comes into view. This stunning cascade is one of the most awe inspiring natural sights on the entire route and the way it tumbles down in seven dramatic stages makes it unlike any other waterfall you are likely to encounter on this journey. Take your time here and let the sight of it sink in properly.

Stop for a satisfying lunch at Namok before continuing the drive and enjoy a relaxed tea break at Chungthang where you can stretch your legs and take in the peaceful surroundings one more time before the final stretch to Lachung.

On arrival check into your hotel, freshen up, and give yourself some time to simply relax and absorb the beauty of your surroundings. When you feel ready the evening offers a couple of wonderful options to explore. The historic Lachung Gompa, dating all the way back to 1880 and nestled picturesquely among apple orchards, is well worth a quiet and contemplative visit. The local handicraft centre is another lovely stop where you can browse and pick up beautifully hand woven blankets and rugs that make for truly meaningful souvenirs to take home.

Return to the hotel for a delicious dinner served right there on the premises and settle in for a peaceful and comfortable overnight stay in the cool mountain air of Lachung.

itinerary.title: Lachung to Yumthang Valley (24 km / 1 hr drive) to Lachung to Gangtok
activities:
Rise early this morning because today takes you to one of the most spectacular natural wonders in all of northeastern India. Set off from Lachung and make your way up to Yumthang Valley, sitting at an elevation of 11,800 feet and popularly known as the Valley of Flowers. The short one hour drive is just enough time to build the anticipation before this extraordinary landscape reveals itself in full.

The moment you enter the valley the sheer scale and beauty of the place takes over completely. Vast stretches of lush greenery roll out across the valley floor, dotted with a wonderful variety of wildflowers and trees that bring vivid colour to the landscape in every direction. A gentle and crystal clear river winds its way peacefully through the middle of it all, adding to the dreamlike quality of the surroundings. And if you look across the wide grassy plains you will spot yaks, goats, and horses grazing freely and unhurriedly in the open air, completing a scene that feels almost too perfect to be real. This is the kind of place where time slows down and every single moment feels worth savouring.

After spending as much time as you need in the valley head back to Lachung for a satisfying lunch before beginning the drive back toward Gangtok.

The return journey brings its own rewards. Along the way the beautiful Bheema Waterfall and Twin Waterfalls appear beside the road, their waters rushing powerfully through the dense surrounding forest. These are natural and largely unspoiled sights that feel like a wonderful final gift from the mountains before the day comes to a close.

Arrive back in Gangtok, check into your hotel, and settle in for a restful and comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Pelling (120 km / 5.5 hrs drive)
activities:
After a satisfying breakfast bid farewell to Gangtok and set off toward your next destination. Today you make your way to Pelling, a beautifully situated town nestled within the pine forests of West Sikkim. The drive stretches over five and a half hours but it is far from a dull one. As the road winds through fragrant tea gardens, open mountain landscapes, and sweeping scenic surroundings the journey itself becomes a pleasure worth looking forward to. Every stretch of the road offers something new to admire and the changing scenery keeps you engaged from start to finish.

Pelling is one of those destinations that immediately wins you over. The town sits in a location that offers some of the most unobstructed and magnificent views of Kangchenjunga you will find anywhere in Sikkim. On a clear day the sight of this iconic peak dominating the horizon is nothing short of breathtaking. Beyond the views Pelling is also home to several ancient monasteries that carry centuries of Buddhist heritage and a quiet spiritual energy that adds real depth to the destination.

On arrival check into your hotel and take the rest of the day at your own pace. After more than five hours on the road a little rest is well deserved. Sit by the window with a warm drink, breathe in the cool pine scented mountain air, and let the peaceful atmosphere of Pelling ease you into a gentle and relaxing evening.

Settle in for a comfortable overnight stay and get ready for a full day of sightseeing tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Pelling (Full Day Local Sightseeing)
activities:
After a warm and satisfying breakfast step outside and get ready to spend a full and rewarding day discovering everything that makes Pelling such a wonderful destination. Today is packed with beautiful and meaningful stops and each one brings something completely unique to the experience.

Begin your morning at Kanchenjunga Waterfalls, a refreshing and invigorating start to the day. The sight of the water cascading powerfully through the lush green surroundings has an instantly calming effect and the atmosphere around it is ideal for slowing down and simply enjoying the moment. It is exactly the kind of natural spot that reminds you why you travel in the first place.

From there make your way to Sewaro Rock Garden, a beautifully peaceful space where carefully arranged greenery, natural rock formations, and a general sense of tranquility come together to create a setting that is both visually lovely and deeply relaxing.

Next head over to Darap Valley, a scenic and unhurried retreat that gives you a genuine glimpse into the quieter and more intimate side of Sikkim. The fresh mountain air here is wonderfully clean, the surrounding scenery is gentle and beautiful, and the whole valley carries a sense of calm that is difficult to find anywhere else.

After a satisfying lunch break the afternoon continues with a rich selection of sightseeing that covers some of the finest attractions Pelling has to offer.

Pema Yangtse Monastery is one of the oldest and most revered monasteries in Sikkim. Perched on a hilltop with panoramic views stretching out in every direction, this sacred site carries centuries of Buddhist history and a spiritual atmosphere that is genuinely moving to experience.

The Helipad Ground offers wide open and uninterrupted views of the Himalayan peaks that frame Pelling so magnificently. It is a wonderful spot to pause, breathe deeply, and appreciate just how extraordinary your surroundings truly are.

Rimbi Waterfalls is your next stop, a charming and picturesque cascade nestled within the forested hillside that adds yet another layer of natural beauty to an already stunning day.

The sacred Khecheopalri Lake is one of the most spiritually significant places on today's itinerary and one of the most peaceful spots in all of Sikkim. Revered deeply by both Buddhists and Hindus, this pristine and tranquil lake sits within a forest that feels almost enchanted. The silence here is profound and the sense of stillness you feel standing beside it is something you will carry with you long after you leave.

Finally round off the day at the Rabdentse Ruins, the ancient remains of the former capital of the Kingdom of Sikkim. Walking through these historic ruins with the mountains rising dramatically in the background is a quietly powerful experience that connects you to the rich and layered history of this remarkable land.

As the evening light fades our representative will drive you back to your hotel for a well deserved and comfortable overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Pelling to Darjeeling
activities:
After a good breakfast and a final look at the beautiful surroundings of Pelling it is time to pack up and make your way toward one of the most iconic and celebrated hill stations in all of India. Today you head to Darjeeling, fondly known as the Queen of Hills, and the anticipation of arriving in such a legendary destination makes the journey feel exciting from the very start.

The road to Darjeeling is not always the smoothest and there are stretches where the drive demands a little patience. But every twist and bump in the road is more than made up for by what you see along the way. Lush tea gardens carpet the hillsides in deep uninterrupted green. Rivers rush noisily below as you cross old bridges that look as though they have been standing there for a century or more. Small and traditional villages appear along the roadside, offering a candid and unhurried glimpse into the everyday life of the people who call these mountains home. The scenery shifts and changes constantly and there is rarely a dull moment from start to finish.

By the time Darjeeling comes into view and the cool mountain air of this beautiful town greets you, the drive will already feel completely worth it. Check into your hotel, settle in comfortably, and let the legendary charm of the Queen of Hills welcome you for a peaceful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling (Full Day Local Sightseeing)
activities:
Today begins before the sun does and that is entirely intentional. Set your alarm for around 4 in the morning and make your way up to Tiger Hill, the highest point in Darjeeling at 2590 metres. What awaits you at the top is one of the most breathtaking sunrise experiences anywhere in the world. As the first light of dawn slowly spreads across the sky and touches the snow covered peaks of Kangchenjunga, turning them from silver to gold in a matter of minutes, you will find yourself completely lost in the moment. It is the kind of sight that no photograph can fully capture and no words can adequately describe. This alone makes the early start more than worth it.

On the way back down make a stop at Batasia Loop, a beautifully landscaped spiral railway track that offers lovely views of the surrounding hills and the charming Darjeeling toy train winding its way through the landscape. Just nearby is Ghoom Monastery, one of the oldest and most sacred monasteries in the Darjeeling region. The peaceful early morning atmosphere here makes the visit feel especially quiet and meaningful.

Head back to your hotel for a well earned and hearty breakfast before setting out again to continue exploring the city.

Your next destination is the Japanese Temple, a stunning and serene Buddhist pilgrimage site that stands out for its beautifully preserved traditional Japanese architecture. The calm and meditative energy of the temple grounds offers a wonderfully peaceful contrast to the excitement of the early morning.

The afternoon takes you through a rich and varied collection of Darjeeling's finest attractions. The Padmaja Naidu Himalayan Zoological Park is home to some of the rarest and most fascinating Himalayan wildlife including the red panda and snow leopard. Please note that the park remains closed on Thursdays. Right alongside it sits the legendary Himalayan Mountaineering Institute, a world renowned institution dedicated to the history and pursuit of Himalayan climbing. The museum here houses a remarkable collection of expedition memorabilia that is fascinating for anyone with even a passing interest in adventure and exploration.

From there head to Tenzing Rock, a natural rock formation named after the legendary Tenzing Norgay and used as a practice climbing site. It is a fitting tribute to one of the greatest mountaineers the world has ever known. The Peace Pagoda is your next stop, a gleaming white structure that radiates a profound sense of calm and stillness against the backdrop of the surrounding hills.

Wrap up the afternoon with a scenic outer view of Chitrey Tea Garden where endless rows of neatly trimmed tea bushes stretch across the hillside in a shade of green so vivid it almost does not look real.

As evening settles over the city make your way to Mall Road and Chowrasta for a leisurely and enjoyable stroll. This is where Darjeeling truly comes alive in the evening. Browse through the local shops, stop for a warm cup of the world famous Darjeeling tea, watch the city unwind around you, and soak in every last moment of a truly wonderful day.

Return to your hotel for a peaceful and restful overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Darjeeling to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) / Bagdogra Airport (IXB) (88 km / 3 hrs drive)
activities: Explore the best of Sikkim and Darjeeling on this 8 nights 9 days tour. From Gangtok's mountain charm, Lachung's scenic villages, and peaceful Pelling to Darjeeling's iconic tea gardens and Toy Train, this journey covers it all in one unforgettable Himalayan experience.

AllPackage.name: Aqua Paradise Andaman & Nicobar
AllPackage.description:
This 6 Nights 7 Days Andaman tour puts together a really satisfying mix of sun-soaked beaches, island hopping, and some genuinely fascinating history, all without ever feeling rushed. The trip kicks off in Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, where the first stop is the peaceful Corbyn's Cove Beach, a great place to settle into the island rhythm before the day picks up pace. From there, a visit to the Cellular Jail adds real weight to the afternoon, a historic landmark that sits at the heart of India's freedom struggle and deserves more than just a passing look. As the sun goes down, the Light and Sound Show takes over, walking visitors through the deeply human stories of the freedom fighters who were once held within those very walls.

The journey then moves on with a ferry ride across to Swaraj Dweep, better known as Havelock Island, and the change of scenery does not disappoint. The island is well known for its incredibly clear water and soft white sandy beaches, and Radhanagar Beach sits right at the top of that list, frequently named among the finest beaches anywhere in Asia. It is the kind of place where you sit down for a few minutes and suddenly realize an hour has gone by. For those who want a bit more action, an optional trip to Elephant Beach opens up a whole afternoon of snorkeling, swimming, and water sports.

Next on the itinerary is Shaheed Dweep, also called Neil Island, which has a noticeably quieter and more unhurried feel to it. Bharatpur Beach is worth every minute spent there, with its shallow, calm waters sitting above some beautiful coral reefs, while Laxmanpur Beach does something special at the end of each day, when the sunset light catches the natural rock formations along the coast in a way that is genuinely hard to describe.

Back in Port Blair, the tour holds back a few of its most appealing destinations for the final stretch. North Bay Island, a lively spot, draws in those seeking marine life and water sports, a vibrant mix of activity. Ross Island, on the other hand, provides a contrasting experience: a serene, overgrown echo of the British colonial period. Here, old administrative structures are now enveloped by dense jungle and the presence of inquisitive wildlife.

This tour is a natural fit for couples, families, and honeymooners who are chasing that combination of beautiful beaches, rich marine life, and a touch of history that the Andamans do so well. The trip wraps up with a departure from Port Blair, and most people leave with the same feeling, that the islands gave them a lot more than they were expecting.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Experience the beauty of the Andaman Islands with this 6 Nights 7 Days tour covering Port Blair, Swaraj Dweep (Havelock Island), and Shaheed Dweep (Neil Island). The journey begins in Port Blair with visits to Corbyn’s Cove Beach and the historic Cellular Jail followed by the Light and Sound Show.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Visitors enjoying water activities and jet skis along a palm-lined beach in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.

AllPackage.name: Island Bliss Andaman & Nicobar
AllPackage.description:
This 6-night, 7-day Andaman tour promises a blend of island paradise, showcasing everything from untouched beaches and lush landscapes to a fascinating colonial past, all expertly curated. The adventure begins in Port Blair, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands' capital. Here, you'll find Corbyn's Cove Beach, a relaxed spot where coconut palms sway and the ocean's whispers are the main attraction. The day then shifts gears, offering a more somber experience at the Cellular Jail, a site that resonates deeply with anyone familiar with India's struggle for freedom.

Come evening, the Light and Sound Show fills in the details, narrating the real human stories behind those prison walls in a way that genuinely moves you. The journey then rolls on with a ferry crossing to Swaraj Dweep, widely known as Havelock Island, and honestly one of the most naturally beautiful places you can find yourself in this part of the world. Radhanagar Beach is waiting there, with its famously clear turquoise water, powder-soft white sand, and the kind of sunsets that make you forget you were ever in a hurry. After that, the itinerary heads to Shaheed Dweep, or Neil Island, a slower, softer kind of destination that feels untouched in the best possible way. Bharatpur Beach draws visitors in with its calm, reef-rich waters, while Laxmanpur Beach earns its reputation every single evening when the sky above the coast turns into something worth watching. Back in Port Blair, a city tour fills in another side of the islands altogether, starting with the Chatham Saw Mill, one of the oldest and largest sawmills anywhere in Asia, followed by the Anthropological Museum, which offers a genuine and thoughtful look into the lives and traditions of the Andaman's indigenous communities, and rounding off at the Fisheries Museum, where the underwater world of these islands gets the spotlight it deserves. The tour also covers North Bay Island, a go-to spot for coral reef exploration and water activities, alongside Ross Island, where old British colonial ruins sit quietly among thick greenery and wandering deer, giving the whole place a hauntingly beautiful atmosphere. Whether you are traveling as a couple, a family, or on a honeymoon, this tour covers everything that makes the Andamans so hard to forget, the beaches, the islands, the marine life, and the history. The trip wraps up with a departure from Port Blair, and while the bags get packed, the memories of those sparkling waters and picture-perfect islands have a way of staying with you long after you have left.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Explore Andaman with this 6N/7D tour covering Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Neil Island. Visit Radhanagar Beach, Cellular Jail, Bharatpur Beach, North Bay Island, and Ross Island.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Rocky beach in Andaman with clear blue water, gentle waves and distant islands under a bright sky

AllPackage.name: Sikkim Short Escape
AllPackage.description:
Nestled beneath the imposing Kangchenjunga, Gangtok seems to exist in its own realm. The capital of Sikkim, sometimes called the lost kingdom, has been a magnet for explorers from all over the world for quite some time, and it's easy to see the appeal. If exploring this beautiful city has been on your mind then this 6 days and 5 nights package is exactly what you have been looking for. Designed to give you the most complete and satisfying experience of the region, this tour takes you through the very best of Gangtok while also giving you the opportunity to discover the stunning attractions of Pelling, a destination that is every bit as charming and rewarding as the capital itself.

Throughout this six day journey the magnificent Kangchenjunga will be your constant companion on the horizon, watching over you as you wind through lush green tea estates, ancient monasteries, sparkling lakes, and scenic viewpoints that take your breath away at every turn.
AllPackage.shortDescription: Discover the magic of Gangtok and Pelling on this carefully crafted 6 days 5 nights package. From sweeping mountain views and ancient monasteries to lush tea gardens, every moment of this journey is pure bliss.
AllPackage.imageAlt: Colorful hillside town overlooking deep valleys with the snow-covered Kanchenjunga mountain range in the background, Sikkim.
exclusions: Personal expenses (heater, laundry, calls, tips, water, drinks, entry fees).
Extra sightseeing or additional vehicle usage.
Costs due to landslides, road blocks, or political disturbances (payable on the spot).

itinerary.title: The journey begins: Drive from NJP or Bagdodra to Gangtok (130 km/4 hrs drive)
activities: Once you step off at NJP Railway Station or Bagdodra Airport in Siliguri, our team will be right there to welcome you and take care of everything so you can settle in without any stress. Rest up, freshen yourself, and take it slow for a bit. As the evening rolls in, head over to MG Marg for a relaxed walk where you can browse through local handlooms, pick up a few souvenirs, or grab some beautiful handicrafts to take back home. Wind down the night at your hotel and sleep well in a room that feels just right after a long day of travel.

itinerary.title: Spend time visiting the local attractions in Gangtok
activities:
Start small, it gets better as the days pass by… Waterfalls, hill-top, monastery and cable car rides, experience them all in Gangtok.

Kick the morning off with a hearty breakfast at the hotel before anything else. Once you are full and ready to go, our team will take you around to soak in everything Gangtok has to offer. The day will take you through some truly wonderful spots including Enchey Monastery, Bakthang Waterfalls, Ganesh Tok, Tashi Viewpoint, Do Drul Chorten Stupa, the Directorate of Handicraft and Handloom, Flower Show, Institute of Tibetology, Banjhakri Falls and the Ropeway. It is quite a full day out, so when you finally get back to your room at night, that pillow is going to feel really well deserved.

itinerary.title: Up above the sea level, unwind at Tsongmo Lake (3750 m, 3hrs drive)
activities: If you are in Gangtok, a trip to Tsomgo Lake is something you simply cannot skip. The lake is so breathtaking that it feels like you have walked straight into a painting. Around 8 in the morning, our team will pick you up from the hotel and take you on the drive up to Tsomgo Lake and Baba Harbhajan Mandir. The three hour uphill drive itself is a beautiful experience you will carry with you long after the trip is over. Sitting at 12,400 feet above sea level, Tsongmo Lake holds a deep sense of calm and is considered sacred by both Hindus and Buddhists in the region. You will then make your way to Baba Harbhajan Mandir, perched at 13,200 feet, where the atmosphere feels nothing short of spiritual. When you have taken it all in, our team will bring you back to the hotel. Sit down to a warm and filling dinner, then stretch out and get a good night of sleep because the days ahead are only going to get better.

itinerary.title: A breathtaking drive to Pelling from Gangtok (120 km/5.5 hrs drive)
activities:
Start Day 4 with a heavy breakfast as this day awaits travelling and sightseeing umpteen. On your journey to Pelling you will come across various sightseeing destinations of religious importance in Namchi and Ravangla.

Our team will come pick you up from the hotel in the morning and set off toward Pelling, a quiet and charming little hamlet tucked away in west Sikkim. Along the way, you will get to stop at Namchi Char Dam and the Samdruptse Statue, two places that sit at the very heart of Sikkim's culture and spiritual life. After spending some time there soaking it all in, the journey continues to Ravangla where Buddha Park and the Temi Tea Gardens are waiting to be explored. The views of the Greater Himalayas from Ravangla are the kind that genuinely stop you in your tracks. Once you have had your fill of all of this, you will finally roll into Pelling and check in at the hotel. A good meal and a comfortable night of rest will set you up perfectly for whatever the next day brings along.

itinerary.title: Spend the day exploring nature's wonders at Pelling
activities:
You will get the chance to visit the best of Pelling… It's a beautiful hill station adorned with some of the most beautiful waterfalls, monastery, lakes and valleys.

After breakfast, the day opens up beautifully as our team takes you around to discover what makes Pelling so special. You will visit Darap Valley, Rimbi Waterfalls, Rock Garden, Kanchenjunga Waterfalls and the sacred Khecheopalri Lake, all of which are the kind of places that remind you just how stunning the natural world can be. Take your time in each spot and let the surroundings sink in. The day also brings you to Rabdentse Ruins, Pema Yangtse Monastery and the Helipad Ground, places that carry a quiet sense of history and give you a real feel of the rich Buddhist culture that runs deep through this land. When the sightseeing wraps up, our team will bring you back to the hotel. Treat yourself to some authentic Sikkimese food for dinner, then lie back and let the memories of the day wash over you as you drift off to sleep.

itinerary.title: Drive back to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station (NJP) or Bagdogra Airport (IXB) from Pelling (160km/6hrs drive)
activities:
Well, every story has an end… With packed bags of goodies and memories umpteen, journey back home.

On the final day, check out of the hotel and make your way back to where this whole adventure first began, either NJP Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport. The bags may be heavier with little goodies and souvenirs picked up along the way, but it is the memories tucked inside your heart that weigh the most. Every laugh, every view, every quiet moment up in those hills, hold onto all of it. And on those days when life feels a little too loud and you need a breather, just flip back through these pages and let those memories bring a warm smile back to your face. They always will.

AllPackage.name: Ocean Dreams Andaman Islands
AllPackage.description:
The Andaman Islands pack a surprising amount of variety into a relatively small space, and this 4 Nights 5 Days tour covering Port Blair, Havelock Island, and Baratang Island does a great job of showing you just how different each part of the archipelago can feel. Between the beaches, the history, the jungle, and the sea, it is the kind of trip that keeps offering something new right up until the last day.

Things get started in Port Blair, the capital of the Andaman Islands, with a visit to Corbyn's Cove Beach, a pretty, coconut tree lined spot by the water where the pace of life immediately starts to slow down. The afternoon moves into more significant territory with a visit to the Cellular Jail, a place that holds a central place in India's freedom struggle and rewards anyone who takes the time to really look around and take it in. Come evening, the Light and Sound Show brings the jail's history to life with a retelling of the freedom fighters' stories that is powerful enough to stay with you well into the next day.

The itinerary then takes travelers by ferry to Havelock Island, home to the world-famous Radhanagar Beach. With its wide open stretch of soft white sand, water shifting between brilliant shades of turquoise, and unhurried sunsets that seem to belong on a postcard, it is easy to see why Radhanagar consistently gets mentioned among the finest beaches anywhere in Asia. A few hours here feels both too long and not long enough at the same time.

Baratang Island brings a completely different mood to the trip. Getting there involves traveling through thick rainforest and narrow mangrove creeks by boat, which is an experience in itself before you even arrive at the main attraction. The Limestone Caves at the end of that journey are genuinely worth the effort, with natural formations built up slowly over thousands of years that feel ancient and alive all at once.

North Bay Island adds an exciting aquatic chapter to the tour, with snorkeling and glass-bottom boat rides giving visitors a front row view of some seriously colorful coral reefs and the marine life that calls them home. Ross Island follows with a quieter, more atmospheric kind of appeal, its old British colonial ruins now largely consumed by nature, with deer and birds moving freely through what was once a seat of administrative power. It is a strangely beautiful place.

After everything the islands have offered over the past few days, the return to Port Blair for the airport transfer feels like a natural full stop to a trip that covered a lot of ground without ever feeling rushed. For anyone looking to get a genuine sense of what the Andamans are really about, this tour covers the history, the nature, the beaches, and the adventure in a way that is hard to improve on.
